dab lnga babyu pa' dkar chag :shes phyin/ 〈li (97)na015 shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong phrag nyi shu lnga pa/ ༷ 3dang po/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi dbang du byas pa rab 'byor gyi le'u/ 3gleng gzhi/ 3sems bskyed bshad pa/ 60'dun pa dang ldan pa sa lta bu/ 60bsam pa dang ldan pa gser bzang po lta bu/ 62lhag pa'i bsam pa dang ldan pa zla ba tshes pa lta bu/ 62sbyor ba dang ldan pa me lta bu/ 65sbyin pa dang ldan pa gter chen po lta bu/ 65tshul khrims dang ldan pa rin po che'i 'byung gnas lta bu/ 66bzod pa dang ldan pa rgya mtsho chen po lta bu/ 66brtson 'grus dang ldan pa rdo rje lta bu/ 661

bsam gtan dang ldan pa ri bo lta bu/ 67shes rab dang ldan pa sman chen po lta bu/ 67thabs dang ldan pa dge ba'i bshes gnyen lta bu/ 67smon lam dang ldan pa yid bzhin gyi nor bu lta bu/ 69stobs dang ldan pa nyi ma lta bu/ 70ye shes dang ldan pa sgra dbyangs snyan pa lta bu/ 71mngon par shes pa dang ldan pa rgyal po chen po lta bu/ 75bsod nams dang ye shes dang ldan pa bang mdzod lta bu/ 77byang chub kyi phyogs dang ldan pa lam chen po lta bu/ 79zhi gnas dang lhag mthong dang ldan pa bzhon pa lta bu/ 79gzungs dang spobs pa dang ldan pa bkod ma lta bu/ 82chos kyi dga' ston dang ldan pa sgra dbyangs snyan pa lta bu/ 86bgrod pa gcig pa'i lam dang ldan pa chu bo'i rgyun lta bu/ 90chos kyi sku dang ldan pa sprin lta bu/ 100gdachabs ngag badza/nga/ pa/ 109(1nga nga bab ba/tshodaskyabab nga 109bden pa bzhi la gdams pa/ 125dkon mchog gsum la gdams pa/ 139sangs rgyas dkon mchog la gdams pa/ 1na9chos dkon mchog la gdams pa/ 143dge 'dun dkon mchog la gdams pa/ 162skyab stunazug pa 'ab gang/skya ba nga 179yongs su mi ngal ba la gdams pa/ 181lam yongs su 'dzin pa la gdams pa/ 183:snazug lnga ba ba/pa/skyabs nga 185mngon par shes pa drug la gdams pa/ 196mthong ba'i lam la gdams pa/ 219sgom pa'i lam la gdams pa/ 2892

nges par 'khyed pa bshad pa/ 299drod du gtogs pa ra po'i dmigs pa dang rnam pa'i ga par/ 299rtse mor gtogs pa r+ṣa po'i dmigs pa dang rnam pa'i khyad par/ 320bzod pa chen po'i dmigs pa dang rnam pa'i ga par/ 351chos kyi mchog r+ṣa po'i dmigs pa dang rnam pa'i ga par/ 366gzung ba'i rtog pa dang po/ drod du gtogs pa'i rnam par rtog pa dgu/ na74stsong ba'i rtog pa gnyis pa/ rtse mor gtogs pa'i rnam par rtog pa dgu/ na82'dzin pa'i rtog pa dang po/ bzod par gtogs pa'i rnam par rtog pa dgu/ 385'dzin pa'i rtog pa gnyis pa/ chos mchog tu gtogs pa'i rnam par rtog pa dgu/ 386yongs su 'dzin pa dang po/ thabs la mkhas pas yongs su zin pa/ na97yongs su 'dzin pa gnyis pa/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis yongs su zin pa/ 404/spyo/ba thab/re /stecad/ gtsamadrod du gtogs pa'i rten/ 424rtse mor gtogs pa'i rten/ 'tsho5bzod par gtogs pa'i rten/ 'tsho5chos kyi mchog tu gtogs pa'i rten/ 427mthong ba'i lam gyi rten/ 'tsho9bsgom pa'i lam gyi rten/ zhen0gnyen po'i phyogs kyi rten/ 4lda4mi mthun pa'i phyogs spong ba'i rten/ 4na4gnyen po dang mi mthun pa'i phyogs kyi rnam par rtog pa spong ba'i rten/ 4na5shes rab dang snying rje'i rten/ 436thun mong ma yin pa'i yon tan gyi rten/ 4na6gzhan gyi don gyi go rim gyi rten/ 4na7ye shes lhun byus grub par 'jug pa'i rten/ ga7bsgrub pa'i dmigs pa/ 4 8'jig rten pa'i dge ba'i chos 4na8'jig rten pa'i mi dge ba'i chos 4403

lung du ma bstan pa'i chos 440'jig rten pa'i chos 440'jig rten las 'das pa'i chos 441zag pa dang bcas pa'i chos 444zag pa med pa'i chos 444'dus byas kyi chos/ 445'dus ma byas kyi chos/ 445thun mong gi chos/ 45thun mong ma lags pa'i chos 446sgrub pa'i ched du bya ba/ 446sezugs byebyen po/ 46spong ba chen po/ zhes 2rtogs pa chen po/ dzi5go cha'i sgrub pa/ zhes 9dang po/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa drug pa'i go cha/ na9gnyis pa/ tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa drug pa'i go cha/ 463gsum pa/ bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa drug pa'i go cha/ 465bzhi pa/ brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa drug pa'i go cha/ 467lnga pa/ bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa drug pa'i go cha/ 469drug pa/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa drug pa'i go cha/ gre2'jug pa'i sgrub pa/ 476bsam gtan dang gzugs med pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa la snyoms par 'jug pa dang ldan pa'i 'jug pa/ 476pha rol tu phyin pa drug gi 'jug pa/ gye8'phags pa'i lam la 'jug pa/ 479tshad med pa la 'jug pa/ 480mi dmigs pa la sbyor ba'i 'jug pa/ na3'khor gsum yongs su dag pa la 'jug pa/ na5

ched du bya ba la 'jug pa/ 485mngon par shes pa la 'jug pa/ dzi8rnam pa thams cad mar+ṣa pa nyid la 'jug pa/ na9tshogs kyi sgrub pa/ 49 0snying rje'i tshogs/ 'tsho0sbyin pa'i tshogs/ 'tsho3(phyo khrims kyi tshogs/ 495bzod pa'i tshogs/ 'tsho6brtson 'grus kyi tshogs/ 498bsam gtan rmi tshogs/ 499shes rab kyi tshogs/ 500zhi gnas kyi tshogs/ 50tsho lhag mthong gi tshogs/ 505zung du khel bar 'jug pa'i lam gyi tshogs/ 511thabs la mkhas pa'i tshogs/ 519yeshes kyi tshogs/ 522bsod nams kyi tshogs/ ༷ 529lam gyi tshogs/ 550gzungs kyi tshogs/ 573sa:re ——gas/ ༷ 577gnyen po'i tshogs/ 608nges 'byung sgrub pa/ 631ched du bya ba'i nges par 'byung ba/ 631mnyam pa nyid du nges par 'byung ba/ 6gosems can gyi don du nges par 'byung ba/ 655'bad pa med par nges par 'byung ba/ 665mtha' las 'das par nges par 'byung ba/ 672thob pa'i nges par 'byung ba/ 6795

bsdur mchan/(773)shes phyin/ a (98)3015 shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong phrag nyi shu lnga pa/ 807rnam pa thams cad mar+ṣa pa nyid du nges par 'byung ba/ 807lam la nges par 'byung ba/ 811gnyis pa/ lam r+ṣa pa'i dbang du mdzad pa mtha' gnyis rnam par bdabaka tshab/re ——(1/ 823lam shes kyi yan lag 823nyan 11sa /) 95skyab/ 826rang sangs rgyas kyi lam/ 846zug11pa nga :re 15zug 881sdug bsngal chos shes sogs bzhi/ 881kun 'byung chos shes sogs bzhi/ 892'gog pa chos shes sogs bzhi/ 90nalam chos shes sogs bzhi/ ༷ 917dre)da pa bsgoskyab babaskyab 93nasems kun nas dul ba'i byed pa/ 933thams cad nas 'dud pa'i byed pa/ 935nyon mongs las rgyal ba'i byed pa/ 936gnod pas brdzi ba med pa'i byed pa/ 9na8yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob pa'i byed pa/ 9na9mchod pa'i rten du gyur pa'i byed pa/ 940mos pa yid la byed pa/ 942

rang gi don la mos pa dgu/ 9'tshorang dang gzhan gyi don la mos pa dgu/ 962gzhan gyi don la mos pa dgu/ 1007bstod pa sogs bstan pa/ 10na6tshob/stetshod 20 tshod/thu/ 10na6ban:zab ba tshog/spya/ 10'ju3ba:sngags pa dasde// 1070yongs su bsngo ba/ 1084yongs su bsngo ba'i byed pa/ 1084dmigs su med pa'i yongs su bsngo ba/ 1086phyin ci ma log pa'i ma— nyid kyis yongs su bsngo ba/ 1097dbe+en pa'i yongs su bsngo ba/ 1100sangs rgyas kyi bsod nams kyi rigs dang rang bzhin rjes su dran pa'i yongs su bsngo /ba/ shā/)/rte rtenathabs mkhas pa'i yongs su bsngo ba/ 11༷namatshan ma med pa'i yongs su bsngo ba/ ༷ 1105sangs rgyas kyis rjes su gnang ba'i yongs su bsngo ba/ 1107khams gsum du ma gtogs pa'i yongs su bsngo ba/ 1109bsod nams ra po 'byung ba'i yongs su bsngo ba chung ngu / 1115bsod nams r+sā po 'byung ba'i yongs su bsngo ba waṃng po/ 1116bsod nams ra po 'byung ba'i yongs su bsngo ba r+ṣa po/ 1117rjes su yi rang ba'i yid la byed pa/ 1124shin tu rnam par dag pa'i sgom lam/ 11na0ngo bo nyid kyi sgom lam/ 11na0'bras bu mchog nyid byed pa'i sgom lam/ 11 2chos thams cad la mngon par 'du mi byed pa'i sgom lam/ ༷ 11 5chos thams cad dmigs pa med pa'i mngon par rtogs par gtod par byed pa'i /sgo/ma snyo/ 11rten( 7

'bras bu sangs rgyas nyid du byed pa'i sgom lam/ 1141rnam dag sgom lam/ 1146gsum pa/ thams cad shes pas dbang du byas pa spyod pa'i khyad rngabaspyad/bye /ba(1/ 1182'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa la mi gnas pa/ 1182'bras yum la ring ba 1183rwa bras sdogaskyab bab 'u) ba/ 118zhesami mthun pa'i phyogs dang gnyen po'i phyogs/ 1184/byezang /ba/ ༷ 119ru gzugs la sogs la bden zhen bkag pa'i sbyor ba/ 1196mi rtag pa la sogs pa la bden zhen bkag pa'i sbyor ba/ 1198gzugs la sogs pa ma rdzogs pa dang rdzogs pa'i sbyor ba/ ༷ 12༷༷gzugs la sogs pa la chags pa med pa'i sbyor ba/ 1202gzhan du mi 'gyur ba'i sbyor ba/ 120nabyed pa po ma yin pa'i sbyor ba/ 1204las bya dka' ba nyid kyi sbyor ba/ 1207don yod pa'i sbyor ba/ 1208gzhan gyi rkyen gyi mi 'gro ba'i sbyor ba/ 1210rnam pa bdun du snang ba'i shes pa'i sbyor ba/ 1211sbyor ba'i mnyam pa nyid/ 1212(511pang paracan/ ༷ 1212sdug bsngal chos shes sogs bzhi/ 1219kun 'byung chos shes sogs bzhi/ 1221'gog pa chos shes sogs bzhi/ 1223lam chos shes sogs bzhi/ 1234bzhi pa/ rnam pa kun mngon par rjogs par rtogs pa'i dbang

du byas pa de bzhin nyid kyi le'u/ 12na4byedasgyu / thab 123'juthams cad shes pa nyid kyi rnam pa/ 1234lam shes pa nyid kyi rnam pa/ 1238thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi rnam pa/ 1247sbyor ba bzhi'i rnam pa/ 124na/sgozang thab 125zhesagazugs la sogs pa la mi gnas pa'i sbyor ba/ 1254sbyor ba med pa'i sbyor ba/ 1257zab pa'i (1ra ba/ 1259gting dpag dka' ba'i sbyor ba/ 1260tshad med pa'i sbyor ba/ 1261zab pa'i sbyor ba dang gting dpag dka' ba'i rnam grangs gzhan gyi sbyor ba/ 1262tshegs chen pos yun ring mo zhig nas mngon par rdzogs par byang chub pa'i sbyor ba/1264lung bstan pa thob pa'i sbyor ba/ 1266phyir mi ldog pa'i sbyor ba/ 1267nges par 'byung ba'i sbyor ba/ 1268bar chad med pa'i sbyor ba/ 1270mngon par rdzogs par byang chub pa la nye ba'i sbyor ba/ 1271myur du mngon par rdzogs par byang chub pa'i sbyor ba/ 1273gzhan gyi don gyi sbyor ba/ 1274'phel 'grib med pa'i sbyor ba/ 1277chos dang chos ma yin pa mi dmigs pa'i sbyor ba/ 1279bsam gyis mi kha pa'i rnam pa'i 'du shes 'gog pa'i sbyor ba/ 1281rnam par mi rtog pa'i sbyor ba/ 1282'bras bu rin po che sbyin pa'i sbyor ba/ 1286rnam par dag pa'i sbyor ba/ 1286sa mazulas la sbyor ba/ 12879

——zab ba:re myosazug tazug/ 1288bdud kyi mthu bcom pa'i yon tan/ 1288sangs rgyas kyis dgongs shing mas+dza pa'i yon tan/ 1290sangs rgyas rnams kyis mngon du mdzad pa'i yon tan/ 1291yang dag rdzogs pa'i byang chub dang nye ba'i yon tan/ 1291don chen po nyid la sogs pa'i yon tan/ 1292yul spyad pa'i yon tan/ 1294zag pa med pa'i chos thams cad yongs su rdzogs par byed pa'i yon tan/ 1298smra ba'i skyes bu'i yon tan/ 1300mi byed pa'i yon tan/ 1301dge ba'i rtsa ba thun mong ma yin pa bskyed pa'i yon tan/ 13༷1dam bcas pa ji lta ba bzhin du sgrub pa'i yon tan/ 1301r+ṣas bu rgya chen po yongs su 'dzin pa'i yon tan/ 1303sems can gyi don sgrub pa'i yon tan/ 1na0nashes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ma rnyed pa dang ma tshang ba rnyed pa las bzlog pa tshang ba rnyed pa'i yon tan/ 1305/sgozab ba:re pa/zab 65tshod/ 1306tshegs chen pos 'thob pa 1na06spobs pa ha cang myur ches pa 1307lus kyi rnam par 'gyur ba'i gnas ngan len rnam pa gsum/ 1308sems kyi gnas ngan len gsum/ ༷ 1na08rigs pa ma yin pas bskyed pa'i kha ton la sogs pa/ ༷ 13༷9phyir phyogs pa'i rgyu mtshan/ 'dzin pa/ 1310// 45thab rtenazugathab nga 1na12gya nom pa'i ro skyang ba las nyams pa/ 1na1natheg pa mchog las nyams pa/ 1na14cer du bya ba las nyams pa/ 1na15rgyu dang 'bras bu 'brel ba las nyams pa/ 1 1510

gong na med pa'i gnas las nyams pa/ 1316yul rnam pa mang po la rnam par rtog pa'i spobs pa 'byung ba/ 1na17yi ge 'dri ba la mngon par zhen pa/ 1na19dngos po med pa la mngon par zhen pa/ 1320zis pa'i yi ge la shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin par mngon par zhen pa/ 1na20shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i yi ge med pa la mngon par zhen pa/ 1321yul la sogs pa yid la byed pa/ ༷ 1323rnyed pa dang bkur ste dang tshigs su bcad pa'i ro myong ba/ 1324lam ma yin pas thabs mkhas pa sna'i ba 1324'dun pa dang snyom las kyis nyams pa/ 1lda25'dun pa'i yul tha dad pas nyams pa/ 1lda26rnyed pa dang bkur ste dang 'aṭad pa che ba dang 'dod pa chung ba nyid kyi tshogs pa ཿdpa /ba na can /ba/ 1rtenarten/ sbyangs pa'i yon tan dang ldan pa dang mi ldan pas tshogs pa dang mi ldan pa/ 1na27dge ba dang mi dge ba ma yin pa'i chos nyid kyi tshogs pa dang mi ldan pa/ 1na28gtong ba dang ser sna byed pas tshogs pa dang mi ldan pa/ 1329gtong ba dang mi len pas tshogs pa dang mi ldan pa/ 1nan0mgo smos pas go ba dang rnam par spyos pas go bas tshogs pa dang mi ldan pa/ 13na0mdo la sogs pa'i chos shes pa dang mi shes pas tshogs pa dang mi ldan pa/ 1nan1pha rol tu phyin pa drug dang ldan pa dang mi ldan pas tshogs pa dang mi ldan pa/ 1nan2thabs la mkhas pa dang thabs la mi mkhas pas tshogs pa dang mi ldan pa/ 13na3gzungs thob pa dang gzungs ma thob pas tshogs pa dang mi ldan pa/ 1na3nayi ge zi bar 'dod pa dang bri bar mi 'dod pas tshogs pa dang mi ldan pa/ 1na 4'dod pa la 'dun pa la sogs pa dang bral ba dang ma bral bas tshogs pa dang /ba sgyu /na /pa/ rtenartenarten/ ngan 'gror 'gro ba la phyir phyogs pa/ 1na 6bde 'gro 'gro ba la legs par phyogs pa/ 1nan6gcig pu nyid dang 'khor la dga' ba nyid kyi tshogs pa dang mi ldan pa/ 1nan711

rjes su 'byel bar 'dod pa nyid dang go skabs mi h+phud pas tshogs pa dang mi ldan pa/ 1rtenartenarten/zang zing cung zad 'dod pa dang de sbyin par mi 'dod pa nyid kyi tshogs pa dang mi ldan pa/ 1rtenartenam srog gi bar chad du 'gyur bar s+dza ba dang mi 'gro bas tshogs pa dang mi ldan pa/ 1339mu ge byung ba dang lo legs pa'i phyogs su 'gro ba dang mi 'gro bas tshogs pa dang mi ldan pa/ 1rten40wī rkun la sogs pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis 'gro ba dang mi 'gro bas tshogs pa dang mi ldan pa/ 1rten40khyim la blta bas tshogs pa dang mi ldan pa/ 1nagabadud sdeg can gyis 'byed pa'i sbyor ba/ 1natsobacos ma nye bar sgrub pa/ 134yul la ji lta ba bzhin ma yin pa la sogs pa la dga' ba barma pa/ 1na46sbyor ba'i khyad par gyi mtshan nyid/ 1356gzhi shes sbyor ba'i shes mtshan bcu drug 1na56lam shes sbyor ba'i shes mtshan bcu drug 1375rnam mar+ṣa sbyor ba'i shes mtshan bcu drug 1na82ga mas+dza bcu drug 1 90byed ma— bcu gcig 1ga7ngo bo nyid mas+dza bcu drug 1462thar pa'i cha dang mthun pa/ 1512thar pa'i cha dang mthun pa spyir bstan pa/ 1512dad pa'i thar pa'i cha dang mthun pa/ 151 brtson 'grus kyi thar pa'i cha dang mthun pa/ 151 dran pa'i thar pa'i cha dang mthun pa/ 1515ting nge 'dzin gyi thar pa'i cha dang mthun pa/ 1515shes rab kyi thar pa'i cha dang mthun pa/ 1518thar pa'i cha dang mthun pa chen po/ 151812

thar pa'i cha dang mthun pa chung ngu / 1520thar pa'i cha dang mthun pa 'azing po/ 1521nges par s+dzad pa'i cha dang mthun pa/ 1528drod/ 1528rtse mo 1530bzod pa/ 1536chos mchog 15na8phyir mi ldog pa'i dge 'dun/ 1541spyor lam phyir mi ldog pa'i rtags nyi shu/ 1541mthong lam phyir mi ldog pa'i rtags bcu drug 1563sgom lam phyir mi ldog pa'i rtags bcu drug 1586slob dpon wo po paṇ+ḍi ta a ba byu tī pa dpal ldan 'gro ba'i me long gis mdzad/bi kra ma shī la'i paṇ+ḍi ta chen po mdzi shrī dang /bod kyi lo tsā ba blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/slar yang dpal ldan byang chub rtse mo'i zhabs rdul spyi bos len zhing gsung gi bdud rtsi 'thungs pa dge slong badz+ra shrīs kyang cung zad bcos shing dag par bgyis/bsdur mchan/(1596): dkar chag gi zur mchan/ tshas r+ṣa 'di'i mjug deb nga gcig par song bas dkar chag kyang de'i rim pa ltar phyes nas bkod yod/'dir sher phyin skor gyi thod yig dang / dkar chag bsdur lngos re'u mig rnams su sde dge'i bstan 'gyur gyi thod yig ltar shes phyin zhes bkod yod la/ dpe shubs dang / deb g.yogs/ nang deb phyi shan/ glegs bam kyi bar bcug shog nye bcas su yongs kha ltar sher phyin zhes bkod yod/13

༄ga /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong phrag nyi shu lnga pa/sti༄tsho/ /rgya gar skad du/ pañca bing sha ti sa ha sri ka pra dz+nyā pā ra mi ta bu/bod skad du/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong phrag nyi shu lnga pa/ bam po dang po/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nyan thos zhi ba tshol rnams kun shes nyid kyis nyer zhir khrid mdzad gang yin dang //'gro la phan par byed rnams lam shes nyid kyis 'jig rten don sgrub mdzad pa gang / /gang dang yang dag ldan pas thub rnams rnam pa kun ldan sna tshogs 'di gsungs pa1/ /nyan thos byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs bcas sangs rgyas kyi ni yum de la phyag 'tshal④/ /rgyal sras gang dag skye bo ma lus bsgral phyir byang chub tu ni yid byas dang / /so sor byang chub rtogs nas gang dag slar yang mnyam med sgom par byed rnams dang / /slob ma dang ni slob ma'i lam 'gro nyon mongs zil mnan 'gro ba gang yin pa/ /de dag thams cad dam pa'i chos 50byed3

mnyan phyir na rab dga'i yid kyis 'dir spyon cig /gang phyir dri ma mang pos dus 'di de bzhin ma yin 'gro ba 'di yin zhing / /lta ba mchog tu mi legs chags sdang mun pa rab tu lhag gyur mi g.yo la/ /tshe yang ring po med dang mun pas dri bral snang ba bzang po dang ldan pas①/ /the tshom yul min mdo 'di kye ma rnyed dka' bas na rig ②par bdag gis dbye/ /'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das rgyal po'i khab kyi ri bya rgod 'phungs pa na bzhugs te/ dge slong lnga stong tsam kyi dge slong gi dge 'dun chen po thams cad kyang dgra bcom pa/ zag pa zad pa/ nyon mongs pa med pa/ dbang du gyur pa/ sems shin tu rnam par grol ba/ shes rab shin tu rnam par grol ba / cang shes pa/ glang po chen po/ bya ba byas pa/ byed pa byas pa/khyar bor ba/ bdag gi don rab tu thob pa/ srid par kun tu sbyor ba yongs su zad pa/ yang dag par kun shes pas sems shin tu rnam par grol ba/sems kyi dbang thams cad la pha rol tu phyin pa'i mchog thob pa rnams dang thabs cig go/ /gang zag gcig ma gtogs pa ni 'di ltar slob pa rgyun tu zhugs pa tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo'o/ /dge slong ma grags 'dzin dang /skye dgu'i bdag mo chen mo la sogs pa lnga brgya tsam dang / dge bsnyen ma ④dang /dge bsnyen ma shin tu mang ba ④kun kyang chos mthong ba dag dang yang thabs cig go / /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po tshad med pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong dang yang thabs cig ste/ thams cad kyang gzungs rab tu thob pa/ting nge 'dzin rab tu thob pa/ stong pa nyid kyi ⑤rnam par spyod pa/ mtshan ma med pa'i spyod yul can/ rtog pa med pa'i smon lam dang ldan pa/ chos 50—4

thams cad la mnyam pa nyid kyis bzod pa rab tu thob pa/ chags pa med pa'i gzungs rab tu thob pa/ mngon par shes pa shin tu ma nyams pa/ mnyan par 'os pa'i tshig dang ldan pa/ tshul 'chos pa med pa/ kha gsag med pa/grags pa dang / khe dang bkur ste'i sems med pa/ zang zing med pa'i chos ston pa/ chos zab mo'i bzod pa dam pa rtogs par khong du chud pa/ mi 'jigs pa chen po thob pa/ bdud kyi las thams cad las yang dag par 'das pa/ las kyi sgrib pa rgyun chad pa/ chos rab tu rtogs pas rna ma par dbye zhing bstan pa la mkhas pa/ bskal pa grangs med pa nas smon lam shin tu brtsams ①pa/ bzhin 'dzum pa dang ldan pa/ sngon du smra ba/ khro gnyer med pa—/ pha rol la tshigs su bcad pa'i dbyangs su brjod pa sdemakhas pa/ zhum pa'i sems dang bral ba/ spobs pa mi chod pa/ 'khor mtha' yas pa zil kyis mnan ①pa'i mi 'jigs pa dang ldan pa/ bskal pa bye ba mtha' yas pa las nges par 'byung ba la mkhas pa/ chos thams cad sgyu ma dang / smig rgyu dang / chu zla dang / rmi lam dang / sgra brnyan dang / mig yor dang /gzugs brnyan dang / sprul pa lta bur lhag par mos pa dang ④/ sems can thams cad kyi sems kyi rgyud ⑤dang / sems can thams cad kyi 'gro ba dang / spyod pa dang du/ mos pa phra mo sna tshogs la 'jug par mkhas pa/ sems can thams cad la sdang ba med pa'i sems dang ldan pa/ bzod pa rlabs po che dang ldan pa/ bdag nyid ji lta ba bzhin 'jug pa la mkhas pa/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad du bkod pa mtha' yas par smon pa dang 'jug pa yongs su gzung dze+eb/ 'jig rten gyi khams grangs med pa na bzhugs pa'i sangs 50—5

rgyas rjes su dran pa'i ting nge 'dzin rtag tu rgyun mi 'chad par mngon du gyur pa/sangs rgyas dpag tu med pa la gsol ba 'debs pa la mkhas pa/ sems can gyi lta ba sna tshogs dang bag la nyal dang kun nas ldang ba'i nyon mongs pa zhi bar bya ba la mkhas pa/ ting nge 'dzin gyis rnam par rtsen pa brgyad ①stong mngon par sgrub ④pa la mkhas pa/ yon tan brjod pa bskal pa mtha' yas par mi zad pa dang ldan pa sha stag dang thabs cig ste/ 'di lta ste skye ba gcig gis thogs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po bzang skyong dang / rin chen 'byung gnas dang / ded dpon dam pa dang / skyes bus byin ①dang /chus byin dang / dbang pos byin dang / blo gros dam pa dang / khyad par blo gros dang / blo gros 'phel ba dang / don yod mjong ba dang / rab tu zhugs pa dang / rab kyi rtsal gyis rnam par gnon pa dang / rtag tu brtson pa dang / rtag tu sbyor ba dang / mi gtong brtson pa dang / nyi ma'i snying po dang / blo gros dpe med pa dang / srun ras gzigs kyi dbang po dang /mthu chen thob pa dang / 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa dang / rdo rje blo gros dang / lag na rin chen phyag rgya dang / rtag tu lag brkyang dang /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po byams pa dang / de dag la sogs pa byang chub sems dpa' bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong du ma dag dang thabs cig go/ /de nas de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das nyid kyi gdan seng ge'i khri bshams nas/ sku drang por bsrangs te dgongs pa mngon du bzhag nas skyil mo krung bcas te bzhugs so/ /der bzhugs nas ting nge 'dzin gang du ting nge 'dzin thams cad khongs su chud pas 'du ba dang rjes su 'brang bar 'grur ba ting nge 'dzin gyi 50—6

rgyal po zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par gzhag ①go/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das dgongs shing yang dag par mkhyen pas ting nge 'dzin de las bzhengs te / lha'i spyan gyis sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad la rnam par gzigs so/ /de ltar gzigs nas sku thams cad las 'od zer rab tu bkye ste/ de'i zhabs kyi mthil gnyis kyi 'khor lo'i ②rtsibs stong dang ldan pa gnyis las kyang 'od zer bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong drug cu drug cu byung ngo / /zhabs kyi sor mo bcu las kyang 'od zer bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong drug cu drug cu byung ngo / /zhabs long bu gnyis dang / zhabs byin pa gnyis dang / zhabs pus mo gnyis dang /zhabs brla gnyis dang / sku lta ①zur gnyis dang / sku lte ba'i dkyil 'khor dang / sku rtsib rjologs gnyis dang / thugs ka'i skyes bu chen po'i mtshan dpal gyi be'u las kyang 'od zer bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong drug cu drug cu byung ngo //phyag gi sor mo bcu las kyang 'od zer bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong drug cu drug cu byung ngo / /de bzhin du phyag lag ngar gnyis dang / dpung pa gnyis dang /mgur dang / tshems mche ba bzhi dang / tshems bzhi bcu dang / spyan gnyis dang / snyan gnyis dang / shangs kyi sbubs gnyis dang / smin mtshams kyi mdzod spu dang / steng gi spyi gtsug dang / zhal gyi sgo nas kyang 'od zer bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong drug cu drug cu byung ste/ 'od zer bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong drug cu po de dag thams cad kyis dustong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di dag thams cad snang ba chen pos khyab par byas te/ shar phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed snang ba chen pos khyab par byas so/ /de bzhin du/ lho dang / nub dang / byang dang / byang 50—7

shar dang / shar lho dang / lho nub dang / nub byang gi phyogs mtshalas dang /'og dang / steng gi phyogs su phyogs rngure re zhing 'jig rten gyi khams gang bā'i klung gi bye ma snyed snang ba chen pos khyab par byas so/ /sems can gang gis 'od zer de mthong ba dang / 'od zer des gang la reg par gyur pa de dag thams cad kyang bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu nges par gyur to / /de nas yang bcom ldan 'das kyi tshu ba spu'i sgo thams cad nas 'od zer rab tu dgye 3ba mdzad de/ ba sru'i bu ga re re nas kyang 'od zer bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong drug cu drug cu byung ngo / /'od zer des kyang stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di snang ba chen pos khyab par byas so/ /shar phyogs su 'jig rten gyi khams gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed snang ba chen pos khyab par byas so/ /de bzhin du lho dang / nub dang / byang dang / byang shar dang / shar lho dang / lho nub dang / nub byang gi phyogs mtshams dang /'og dang / steng gi phyogs su phyogs re re zhing 'jig rten gyi khams gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed snang ba chen pos khyab par byas so/ /sems can gang gis 'ad de mthong ba dang / 'od des gang la reg par gyur pa de dag thams cad kyang bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu nges par gyur to/ /de nas yang bcom ldan 'das kyi ④de bzhin gshegs pa'i rang bzhin byi 'od gang yin pa des/ stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di snang ba chen pos khyab par mdzad pa dang / phyogs bcu po rnams thams cad kyi phyogs re rer/ 'jig rten gyi khams gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed rang bzhin gyi 'od des khyab par mdzad nas/ 'od des gang la reg par gyur pa de dag thams 50—8

cad kyang bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu nges pa'i bar du gyur to/ /de nas de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das kyi zhal kyi sgo nas ljags kyi dbang po bkram ste/ stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di thams cad ljags kyi dbang po des khyab par mdzad nas/ ljags kyi dbang po de las 'od rab tu bkye ste/ 'od de las 'od zer bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong du ma 'thon ①to—/ /'od zer gyi rtse mo re re las kyang rin po che'i rang bzhin byi pad+ma gser gyi mdog tu snang ba 'dab ma stong dang ldan pa byung bar ⑤pegyur to/ /pad+mo ④de dag la'ang de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku chos ston par mdzad cing gnas pa rnams bzhugs te/ 'di lta ste pha rol tu phyin pa drug dang ldan pa'i chos bstan pa 'di nyid ston pa dhimadzad do/ /de dag shar phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed du gshegs shing de dag tu byon nas 'di lta ste/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug dang ldan pa'i chos bstan pa 'di nyid kyi chos ston to/ /de bzhin du de dag lho dang / nub dang / byang dang / byang shar dang / shar lho dang / lho nub dang / nub byang gi phyogs mtshams dang / 'og dang steng gi phyogs su phyogs re re zhing 'jig rten byi khams gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag tu gshegs shing / de dag tu byon nas kyang 'di lta ste/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug dang ldan pa'i chos bstan pa 'di nyid kyi rjochos ston to/ /sems can gang gis chos de dag thos par gyur pa de dag thams cad kyang bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu nges par gyur to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis gdan seng ge'i khri de la bzhugs bzhin du sangs rgyas kyi ting nge 'dzin seng ge rnam par rol pa zhes bya ba la mnyam par bzhag ste/ de lta bu'i gzugs kyis ⑦50—9

rdzu 'phrul mngon par 'du mdzad do/ /ji lta bu'i gzugs kyis rdzu 'phrul mngon par 'du mdzad pas stong gsum kyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten byi khams 'di rnam par 'gyur ba drug tu g.yos so/ /rab tu g.yos so/ /kun tu rab tu g.yos so—/ /'gul to/ /rab tu 'gul to/ /kun tu rab tu 'gul to/ /ldeg go//rab tu ldeg go/ /kun tu rab tu ldeg go/ /chem/ rab tu chem/ kun tu rab tu chem mo/ /'khrugs/ rab tu 'khrugs/ kun tu rab tu 'khrugs so/ /'ur 'ur/ rab tu 'ur 'ur/ kun tu rab tu 'ur 'ur ro/ /mtha' mtho na ni dbus dma'/ dbus mtho na ni mtha' dma' ste/ dal bus bags kyis nyams su bde bar sems can thams cad la phan pa dang bde ba bskyed par gyur to/ /de nas de'i tshe skad cig yud tsam thang cig la/ stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di na/ sems can dmyal ba dang / byol song gi skye gnas dang gshin rje'i 'jig rten gang dag yod pa de dag rgyun chad cing stongs par gyur to/ /mi khom pa thams cad kyang zad par gyur to/ /sems can gang dag dmyal ba dang / dud 'gro'i skye gnas dang / gshin rje'i 'jig rten lalas shi 'phos pa de dag kyang dang ba dang rab tu dga' ba de nyid kyis mi rnams dang skal ba mnyam par skyes par gyur to/ /de bzhin du rgyal chen bzhi'i ris kyi lha dang / sum cu rtsa gsum dang / 'thab bral dang / dga' ldan dang / 'phrul dga' dang / gzhan ①'phrul dbang byed kyi lha dang skal ba mnyam par skyes par gyur to/ /de nas mi de dag dang lha de dag bcom ldan 'das nyid kyi mthus sngon gyi tshe rabs rjes su dran par gyur te/ rjes su dran nas dang ba dang rab tu dga' bas bcom ldan 'das gang ①na ba der dong zhing 50—10

phyin nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te/ bcom ldan 'das la thal mo sbyor zhing 'dud par gyur to/ /de bzhin du shar phyogs kyi 'jig rten gye khams gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dang / lho phyogs dang /nub phyogs dang / byang phyogs dang / phyogs mtshams rnams dang / 'og dang / steng gi phyogs kyi phyogs bcu po rnams kun tu phyogs kyi cha re rer 'jig rten gyi khams gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyi sems can dmyal ba thams cad dang /byol song gi skye gnas thams cad dang / gshin rje'i 'jig rten thams cad kyang rgyun chad cing stongs par gyur/ mi khom pa thams cad kyang nub par gyur te—/ sems can gang dag dmyal ba dang / dud 'gro'i skye gnas dang /gshin rje'i 'jig rten de dag nas shi 'phos pa de dag thams cad kyang mi dang lhar skal ba mnyam par skyes par gyur to/ /mi dang lha rnams su skyes pa de dag kyang bcom ldan 'das nyid kyi mthus sngon gyi gnas rjes su dran par gyur te/rjes su dran nas kyang dang ba dang rab tu dga' ba de nyid kyis rang rang gi sangs rgyas kyi zhing rnams su sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das byung bar gyur pa de dag gi drung du dong zhing phyin nas/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de rnams kyi zhabs la phyag 'tshal te/ thams cad thal mo sbyar nas bcom ldan 'das rnams la 'dud par gyur to/ /de nas de'i tshe stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di na sems can dmyus long ji snyed cig yod pa de dag thams cad kyang mig gis gzugs mthong bar gyur to/ /sems can 'on pa rnams kyang rna bas sgra thos par gyur to/ /sbyon pa rnams kyang dran pa thob par gyur to/ /sems 'khrugs pa rnams kyang sems rtse gcig pa thob par gyur to/ /gos med 50——11

pa rnams kyang gos thob par gyur to/ /dbul po rnams kyang nor thob par gyur to—/ /bkres pa rnams kyang zas thob par gyur to/ /skom pa rnams kyang btung ba thob par gyur to/ /nad kyis btab pa rnams kyang nad med par gyur to—/ /lus nyams pa dang dbang po ma tshang ba rnams kyang lus dang dbang po tshang zhing rgyas par gyur to/ /ngal ba rnams kyang ngal sos par gyur to/ /lus dang ngag dang yid kyi las kyi mtha' dang 'tsho ba mi dge ba ma spangs pa rnams kyang / lus dang ngag dang yid kyi las kyi mtha' dang 'tsho ba mi dge ba spangs par gyur to/ /sems can thams cad kyang sems can thams cad la dper na/ pha dang / ma dang / phu nu dang / sring mo dang / mdza' ba dang /gnyen dang / grogs po dang mtshungs pa'i sems kyis phan tshun sems mnyam pa nyid du gyur to/ /sems can thams cad kyang dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam dang ldan zhing tshangs par spyod pa dang / gtsang ba dang nyes pa'i dri nga ba med de/mi dge ba'i rtog pa thams cad dang bral bar gyur to/ /de'i tshe sems can thams cad kyang bde ba thams cad dang ldan par gyur to/ /'di lta bu'i bde ba dang ldan par gyur te/ dper na dge slong bsam gtan gsum pa la snyoms par zhugs pa'i bde ba de lta bu'i bde ba thams cad dang ldan par gyur to/ /de'i tshe 'di lta bu'i rang bzhin dang ldan par gyur te/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing gzhan na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi dul ba ni legs so/ /zhi ba ni legs so/ /yang dag par sdom pa ni legs so/ /yun ring du tshangs par spyod pa la gnas pa ni legs so/ /srog chags su gyur pa rnams la mi 'tshe ba ni legs so zhes ched du brjod pa ched du brjod par gyur to/ /50—12

de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das gdan seng ge'i khri de nyid la bzhugs pas 'di lta ste/dper na nyi ma sgrib ①pa med pa nam mkha'i dbyings yongs su dag pa la 'dug pa'am—/ zla ba nya ba'i dkyil 'khor ltar stong gsum gye stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams ri rab dang bcas pa/ khor yug dang bcas pa/ lha'i gnas dang bcas pa/ dbang po dang bcas pa/ dbang byed dang bcas pa/ lha dang lha ma yin gyi ris dang bcas pa/ tshangs pa dang bcas pa/ gtsang ma'i gnas dang bcas pa 'di zil gyis mnan te bzhugs na/ 'od dang / sku mdog dang / gzi brjid dang dpal kyis mdzes shing lham me lhan ṣ+pe lhang nge'o/ /ji ltar bcom ldan 'das kyis stong gsum kyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams zil gyis mnan te/ 'od dang / sku mdog dang / gzi brjid dang /dpal kyis mdzes shing lham me lhan ṣ+pe lhang nger bzhugs pa de bzhin du shar phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed zil kyis mnan te 'od dang / sku mdog dang / gzi brjid dang / dpal gyis mdzes shing lham me lhan ṣ+pe lhang nger bzhugs so/ /lho dang / nub dang / byang dang / byang shar dang / shar lho dang / lho nub dang / nub byang gi phyogs mtshalas dang /'og dang / steng gi phyogs kyi ⑪phyogs re re zhing 'jig rten byi khams gang gā'i klung 1gi bye ma snyed zil gyis mnan te/ 'od dang / sku mdog dang / gzi brjid dang / dpal gyis mdzes shing lham me lhan ṣ+pe lhang nger bzhugs so/ /'di lta ste dper na/ ri'i rgyal po ri rab ri nag po gzhan thams cad zil gyis gnon ④par gnas pa ni mdzes shing lham me lhan ṣ+pe lhang nge'o/ /'di lta ste dper na/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor skar ma'i gzugs thams cad zil gyis non 50—13

par gnas pa ni mdzes shing lham me lhan ṣ+pe lhang nge'o/ /'di lta ste dper na/nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'od gzhan thams cad zil gyis non par gnas pa ni mdzes shing lham me lhan ṣ+pe lhang nge'o/ /de bzhin du bcom ldan 'das phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten lha dang bcas pa/ dbang po dang bcas pa tshangs pa dang bcas pa/ gtsang ma'i gnas dang bcas pa zil kyis non par bzhugs pa yang 'od dang / sku mdog dang / gzi brjid dang bcas pa dpal gyis mdzes shing lham me lhan ṣ+pe lhang nge'o/ /de nas yang bcom ldan 'das kyis stong gsum byi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'dir bcom ldan 'das kyi rang bzhin gyi sku ci 'dra ba bzhin du bstan to/ /de nas stong gsum byi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di'i gtsang ma'i gnas kyi lha'i ris dang /kun snang dang ba dang / tshangs ris dang / gzhan 'phrul dbang byed dang /'phrul dga' dang / dga' ldan dang / 'thab bral dang / sum cu rtsa gsum dang / rgyal chen bzhi'i ris kyi lha gang ji snyed pa de dag thams cad kyis de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gdan seng ge'i khri la bzhugs pa mthong nas dga' zhing spro ba dang / yid bde zhing rab tu dga' la nyams bde ba dang yid bde ba skyes nas lha rdzas kyi me tog dang /phreng ba dang / spos dang / byug pa dang / phye ma dang / na bza' dang /lha rdzas kyi byug spos dang / lha rdzas kyi ut+pa la dang / pad+mo dang / ku mu ta ①dang / puṇ+ḍa rī ka dang / na li na dang / sau gan dhi dang / lha rdzas kyi me tog ke sa ra dang / ta ma li'i ②lo ma dang / lha rdzas kyi na bza' dang /rgyan dang / gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / lha rdzas kyi ba dan mang po 50—14

thogs nas/ bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der dong ste phyin nas/ me tog dang / phreng ba dang / spos dang / byug pa dang / phye ma dang / byug spos dang / ut+pa la dang / pad+mo dang / ku mu ta dang / puṇ+ḍa rī ka dang /na li na dang / sau gan bye ①dang / me tog ke ④sa ra dang / ta ma li'i ①lo ma dang / lha rdzas kyi na bza' dang / rgyan dang / gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / lha'i ba dan dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gtor to/ /mngon par gtor to/ /rab tu gtor to/ /stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di na 'dul ba dang snod du gyur pa'i mi ji snyed cig yod pa de dag kyang me tog chu las skyes pa dang / thang las skyes pa mang po khyer nas/bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der dong zhing phyin nas/ bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa byed par gyur to/ /me tog dang / phreng ba dang / spos dang /byug pa dang / phye ma la sogs pa dang / na bza' dang / rgyan dang /gdugs ④dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan de dag thams cad kyang de ma thag tu bcom ldan 'das kyis byin kyis brlabs kyis/ bcom ldan 'das kyi dbu'i steng gi nam mkha' la me tog la sogs pa'i khang pa brtsegs pa stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams tsam du red de gnas par gyur to/ /khang pa brtsegs pa de las kyang lha rdzas kyi me tog dang / dar gyi lda ldi mang po 'phyang bar gyur to/ /mngon par 'phyang bar gyur to/ /rab tu 'phyang bar gyur to/ /me tog dang dar gyi lda ldi de dag gis rjostong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di shin tu mdzes par gyur to/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi 'od snang ba gser gyi kha dog lta bu des kyang shin tu mdzes shing lham me lhan ṣ+pe lhang nger gyur 50—15

te①—/ stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'dir ci lta ba de bzhin du shar phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyang bcom ldan 'das kyi 'od snang ba des khyab cing gsal bar gyur to/ /lho dang / nub dang /byang dang / byang shar dang / shar lho dang / lho nub dang / nub byang gi phyogs mtshams dang / 'og dang / steng gi phyogs kyi phyogs re re zhing 'jig rten gyi khams gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyang bcom ldan 'das kyi 'od snang ba des khyab cing gsal bar gyur to/ /de la 'dzam bu'i gling gi mi rnams kyis de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku blta ④bas chog mi shes pa de mthong nas 'di snyam du sems par gyur te/ de bzhin gshegs pa bdag cag gi mdun na bzhugs shing chos ston to snyam mo/ /'dzam bu'i gling gi mi rnams ji ltar sems pa de bzhin du nub kyi ba lang spyod dang / shar gyi lus 'phags po dang / byang gi sgra mi snyan dang / rgyal chen bzhi'i ris kyi lha rnams dang / 'og min gyi lha rnams kyi bar dang / de bzhin du stong gagi 'jig rten gyi khams dang / stong gnyis kyi 'jig rten byi khams dang / stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi mi thams cad dang / lha thams cad kyis de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku lta bas chog mi shes pa de mthong nas 'di snyam du sems par gyur te/ de bzhin gshegs pa bdag cag gi mdun na bzhugs shing chos ston to snyam mo/ /de nas yang bcom ldan 'das kyis gdan seng ge'i khri de la bzhugs bzhin du 'od rab tu dgye ④bar mdzad de/ yang 'od des stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di rab tu snang bar gyur to/ /shar phyogs dang / lho dang / nub dang / byang dang / byang shar dang / shar lho dang / lho nub dang / nub 50—16

byang gi phyogs mtshams dang / 'og dang / steng gi phyogs kyi phyogs re re zhing 'jig rten gyi khams gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed rab tu ①snang bar gyur to/ /'od des stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di na sems can gang ji snyed cig yod pa de dag thams cad kyis/ shar phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa/ byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor dang bcas pa mang po mthong bar gyur to/ /shar phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed po de dag na sems can gang ji snyed cig 'khod pa de dag gis kyang stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di na bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa dge slong gi dge 'dun dang bcas pa/byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor dang thabs cig tu bzhugs pa mthong bar gyur to/ /de bzhin du 'jig rten gyi khams 'di na sems can ji snyed cig yod pa de dag gis lho dang / nub dang / byang dang / byang shar dang / shar lho dang / lho nub dang / nub byang gi phyogs mtshams dang / 'og dang / steng gi phyogs su phyogs re re zhing 'jig rten gyi khams gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed po de dag na/de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa/ byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor dang bcas pa mang po rnams mthong bar gyur to/ /'jig rten gyi khams gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed de dag na sems can gang dag yod pa de dag thams cad kyis kyang stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di na/ bcom ldan 'das de 50—17

bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa dge slong gi dge 'dun dang bcas pa/ byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor dang thabs cig tu bzhugs pa mthong bar gyur to/ /de nas shar phyogs su 'jig rten gyi khams gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed las 'das te/ de thams cad las pha rol po'i 'jig rten gye khams rin po che dang ldan pa zhes bya ba gang yin pa de na de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rin chen 'byung gnas zhes bya ba bzhugs shing / 'tsho la skyong bar byed de/ de byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams la shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i chos 'di nyid ston par mdzad do/ /de nas 'jig rten gyi khams de na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po kun nas 'od zer zhes bya ba 'dug 'dug pas snang ba chen po de dang / sa cher g.yos pa de dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku blta na chog mi shes pa de mthong nas/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rin chen 'byung gnas gang na ba der song ste phyin nas/ bcom ldan 'das de'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal nas/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen 'byung gnas de la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das 'od chen po 'di lta bu 'jig rten du byung hu ba dang / dog sa 'di ltar cher g.yos pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku 'di lta bu gda' ba 'di rgyu ci lags/ rkyen ci lags/de skad ces gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen 'byung gnas kyis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po kun nas 'od zer la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /rigs kyi bu 'di ni nub phyogs logs su 50—18

'jig rten gyi khams gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed 'das pa na 'jig rten gyi khams mi mjed ces bya ba yod de/ de na de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa zhes bya ba bzhugs shing 'tsho skyong ngo / /des ①byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams la shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ston te/ 'di 'dra ba 'di ni de'i mthu yin no/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po kun nas 'od zer gyis bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen 'byung gnas la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag kyang 'jig rten gyi khams mi mjed der/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa de blta ba dang / de la phyag bgyi zhing bsnyen bkur ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de dag kun kyang phal cher gzhon nur gyur pa/ gzungs dang so so yang dag par rig pa sgrub ⑤pa rab tu thob pa/ting nge 'dzin dang snyoms par 'jug pa thams cad la dbang rab tu thob pa de dag blta ba'i slad du mchi'o/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen 'byung gnas kyis bka' cad pa/ rigs kyi bu khyod kyis da ltar de'i dus la bab par shes na song shig /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen 'byung gnas kyis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po kun nas 'od zer la pad+mo rin po che sna tshogs kyi rgyu las byung ba/ gser gyi mdog tu snang ba 'dab ma stong dang ldan pa stong bskur ①te/ rigs kyi bu khyod kyis bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa de la pad+ma du'adi dag gis gtor te/ 'di skad du bcom ldan 'das 50—19

rin chen 'byung gnas bcom ldan 'das la snyun mi mnga' 'am/ thugs gzer ma mchis sam/ ldang ba yang ngam/ gshegs spyod dam/ bde ba la reg par gnas sam zhes rmed de/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rin chen 'byung gnas des bcom ldan 'das la pad+mo 'di dag kyang bskur ro zhes spros shig /rigs kyi bu sangs rgyas kyi zhing der bag yod par spyod cig /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ gang dag 'jig rten gyi khams mi mjed der skyes pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de dag ni bsten par dka' ba yin te/ der nyams par gyur ta re/de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po kun nas 'od zer gyis/bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rin chen 'byung gnas de nas pad+mo rin po che sna tshogs kyi rgyu las byung ba gser gyi mdog tu snang ba 'dab ma stong dang ldan pa de dag blangs te/ byang chub sems dpa' khyem pa dang / rab tu byung ba dang / khye'u dang bu mo'i gzugs su 'dug pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong du ma dang 'grogs te/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing de nas mi snang bar gyur te/ shar phyogs kyi sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das gang ji snyed cig bzhugs shing 'tsho skyong ba de dag thams cad la me tog dang / spos dang / bdug spos dang / phreng ba dang / byug pa dang /phye ma dang / na bza' dang / rgyan dang / gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang /ba dan dag gis rim gro ①bya ba dang / bkur ste ⑧bya ba dang / bste stang du bya ba dang / mchod pa byed cing / byang chub sems dpa'i rdzu 'phrul chen po dang / byang chub sems dpa'i mthu chen pos bcom ldan 'das de bzhin 50—20

gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa gang na ba der song ste phyin nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la spyi bos phyag 'tshal te/ phyogs gcig tu 'khod do/ /phyogs gcig tu 'khod nas/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po kun nas 'od zer gyis bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rin chen 'byung gnas/ bcom ldan 'das la snyun mi mnga' 'am/ thugs gzer ma mchis sam/ ldang ba yang ngam/ gshegs spyod dam/ bde ba la reg par gnas sam zhes 'dri ste/pad+ma ①gser gyi mdog tu snang ba 'dab ma stong dang ldan pa 'di dag kyang bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag nga ra rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rin chen 'byung gnas kyis bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa'i slad du bskur ro/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pas pad+mo de dag bzhes nas—/ shar phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed po de dag gi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de dag gang na ba der gtor to/ /de nas pad+mo de dag gis 'jig rten gyi khams de dag thams cad rgyas par gyur te/ pad+mo de dag la de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku mang po bzhugs shing / sangs rgyas kyi zhing de dag tu 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang ldan pa'i chos bstan pa 'di nyid ston to/ /chos bstan pa de ④sems can gang gis thos par gyur pa de dag thams cad kyang bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu nges par gyur to/ /byang chub sems dpa' khyim pa dang / rab tu byung ba dang / khye'u dang bu mo'i gzugs 50—21

su 'dug pa byang chub sems dpa' kun nas 'od zer dang lhan cig tu 'jig rten gyi khams rin chen yod pa de nas 'ongs pa de dag gis kyang / rang rang gi dge ba'i rtsa bas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa la rim gror ①byas so/ /bkur ster byas so/ /bste stang du byas so/ /mchod par byas nas phyogs gcig tu 'khod do/ /de nas lho phyogs logs su 'jig rten kyi khams gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed las 'das te/ de dag kun gyi pha rol na/② de thams cad las pha rol po'i 'jig rten byi khams mya ngan thams cad dang bral ba zhes bya ba gang yin pa de na de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mya ngan med pa'i dpal zhes bya ba bzhugs shing 'tsho la skyong bar byed de/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams la shes rab kyi pha rol tu ①phyin pa 'di nyid yang dag par ston par ⑦mdzad do/ /de nas 'jig rten gyi khams de na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po mya ngan med pa zhes bya ba 'dug 'dug pas snang ba chen po de dang / sa cher g.yos pa de dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku blta na chog mi shes pa de mthong nas/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mya ngan med pa'i dpal gang na ba der song ste phyin nas/ bcom ldan 'das de'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal nas/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa mya ngan med pa'i dpal de la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das 'od chen po 'di lta bu 'jig rten du byung ba dang / dog sa 'di ltar cher g.yos pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku 'di lta bu gda' ba 'di rgyu ci lags/ rkyen ci lags/50—22

de skad ces gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa mya ngan med pa'i dpal byis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po mya ngan med pa la 'di skad ces bka' pa to/ /rigs kyi bu 'di nas byang phyogs logs su 'jig rten gyi khams gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed 'das pa na 'jig rten gyi khams mi mjid ces bya ba yod de/ de na de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa zhes bya ba bzhugs shing 'tsho skyong ngo / /de byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams la shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ston te/ 'di 'dra ba 'di ni de'i mthu yin no/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po mya ngan dang bral bas/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa mya ngan med pa'i dpal la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag kyang 'jig rten gyi khams mi mjed der/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa de blta ba dang / de la phyag bgyi zhing bsnyen bkur ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de dag kun kyang phal cher gzhon nur gyur ①pa/ gzungs dang so so yang dag par rig pa sgrub ②pa rab tu thob pa/ting nge 'dzin dang snyoms par 'jug pa thams cad la dbang rab tu thob pa de dag blta ba'i slad du mchi'o/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa mya ngan med pa'i dpal gyis bka' pa pa/ rigs kyi bu khyod kyis da ltar de'i dus la bab par shes na song shig /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa mya ngan med pa'i dpal gyis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po mya ngan dang bral ba la pad+mo rin po che ①sna tshogs kyi rgyu las byung ba gser gyi mdog tu snang ba/ 'dab 50—23

ma stong dang ldan pa stong bskur ro①/ /rigs kyi bu bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa de la pad+mo 'di dag gis gtor te/ 'di skad du bcom ldan 'das mya ngan med pa'i dpal bcom ldan 'das la snyun mi mnga' 'am/ thugs gzer ma mchis sam/ldang ba yang ngam/ gshegs spyod dam/ bde ba la reg par gnas sam zhes rmed de/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa mya ngan med pa'i dpal des bcom ldan 'das la pad+mo de dag kyang bskur ro zhes sgos shig /rigs kyi bu sangs rgyas kyi zhing der bag yod par spyod cig /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'jig rten gyi khams der skyes pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de dag ni bsten par dka' ba yin te/ der nyams par gyur ta re/ de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po mya ngan dang bral bas/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mya ngan med pa'i dpal de las pad+mo gser gyi mdog tu snang ba 'dab ma stong dang ldan pa de dag blangs te/ byang chub sems dpa' khyem pa dang / rab tu byung ba dang / khye'u dang bu mo'i gzugs su 'dug pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong du mas lhan cig kun nas bskor cing mdun du bdar te/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing de nas mi snang bar gyur nas/ lho phyogs kyi sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das gang ji snyed ci pa/ bzhugs shing 'tsho skyong ba de dag thams cad la me tog dang / spos dang / bdug spos dang / phreng ba dang / byug pa dang / phye ma dang /na bza' dang / rgyan dang / gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan dag gis rim gror bya ba dang / bkur ster bya ba dang / bste stang du bya ba 50—24

dang / mchod par ①byed cing / byang chub sems dpa'i rdzu 'phrul chen po dang / byang chub sems dpa'i mthu chen pos/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa gang na ba der song ste phyin nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la spyi bos phyag 'tshal te/ phyogs gcig tu 'khod do/ /phyogs gcig tu 'khod nas/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po mya ngan dang bral bas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mya ngan med pa'i dpal bcom ldan 'das la snyun mi mnga' 'am/ thugs gzer ma mchis sam/ ldang ba yang ngam/ gshegs spyod dam/ bde ba la reg par gnas sam zhes 'dri ste/pad+mo gser gyi mdog tu snang ba 'dab ma stong dang ldan pa 'di dag kyang bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rgya ngan med pa'i dpal gyis bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa'i slad du bskur ro/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pas pad+mo de dag bzhes nas/ lho phyogs kyi 'jig rten kyi khams gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed po de dag gi ②sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag gang na ba der gtor to/ /de nas pad+mo de dag gis 'jig rten gyi khams de dag thams cad rgyas par khyab par gyur te/ pad+mo de dag la de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku mang po bzhugs shing sangs rgyas kyi zhing de dag tu 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang ldan pa'i chos bstan pa 'di nyid ston to/ /chos bstan pa de sems can gang gis thos par gyur pa de dag thams cad kyang bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu nges par gyur to/ /byang chub 50—25

sems dpa' khyim pa dang / rab tu byung ba dang / ge dang bu mo'i gzugs su 'dug pa byang chub sems dpa' mya ngan med pa dang lhan cig tu 'jig rten gyi khams mya ngan med pa de nas 'ongs pa de dag gis kyang rang rang gi dge ba'i rtsa bas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa la rim gror byas so/ /bkur ster byas so/ /bste stang du byas so/ /mchod par byas nas phyogs gcig tu 'khod do/ /de nas nub phyogs logs su 'jig rten gyi khams gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed las 'das te/ de thams cad las pha rol po'i ①'jig rten gyi khams nye bar zhi ba zhes bya ba gang yin pa de na de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rin chen 'od 'phro zhes bya ba bzhugs shing 'tsho skyong bar byed de/ de byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams la shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di nyid yang dag par ston pa snemadzad do/ /de nas 'jig rten gyi khams de na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po spyod pa'i blo gros zhes bya ba 'dug 'dug pas snang ba chen po de dang / sa cher g.yos pa de dang /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku blta bas ①chog mi shes pa de masgong nas/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rin chen 'od 'phro gang na ba der song ste phyin nas/ bcom ldan 'das de'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal nas/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen 'od 'phro dul 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das 'od chen po 'di lta bu 'jig rten du byung ba dang / dog sa 'di ltar cher ⑤g.yos pa dang /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku 'di lta bu gda' ba durgyu ci lags/ rkyen ci lags/50—26

——de skad ces gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das rin chen 'od 'phros byang chub sems bapa' sems dpa' chen po spyod pa'i blo gros la 'di skad ces bka' byed to—/ /rigs kyi bu 'di nas shar phyogs logs su 'jig rten gyi khams gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed 'das pa na/ 'jig rten gyi khams mi mjid ces bya ba yod de/ de na de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa zhes bya ba bzhugs shing 'tsho skyong ngo / /de byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams la shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ston te/'di 'dra ba de ni de'i mthu yin no/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po spyod pa'i blo gros kyis/ bcom ldan 'das rin chen 'od 'phro la 'di skad ①ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag kyang 'jig rten rmi khams spe mjed der/ b.rum ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag tsar rdzogs pa'i༄ngas rgyas shākya thub pa de blta ba dang / de la phyag babyi zhing bsnyen bkur ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de dag kun kyang phal cher gzhon nur gyur pa/ gzungs dang so so yang dag par rig pa sgrub ②pa rab tu thob ①pa/ ting nge 'dzin dang snyoms par 'jug pa thams cad la dbang rab tu thob pa de dag blta ba'i slad du mchi'o/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen 'od 'phros bka' byed pa/ rigs kyi bu byed kyis da ltar de'i dus la bab par shes na song shig /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen 'od 'phros byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po spyod pa'i blo gros la pad+mo rin po che sna tshogs kyi rgyu las byung ba gser kyi mdog tu snang ba 'dab ma stong dang ldan pa stong bsgur te/ rigs kyi bu byed kyis bcom ldan 50—27

'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa de la pad+mo 'di dag gis gtor te/ 'di skad du bcom ldan 'das rin chen 'od 'phros ①bcom ldan 'das la snyun mi mnga' 'am/ thugs gzer ma mchis sam/ ldang ba yang ngam/ gshegs spyod dam/ bde ba la reg par gnas sam zhes rmed de/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rin chen 'od 'phro des bcom ldan 'das la pad+mo 'di dag kyang bskur ro zhes spros shig /rigs kyi bu sangs rgyas kyi zhing der bag yod par spyod cig /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'jig rten gyi khams der skyes pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de dag ni bsten par dka' ba yin te/ der nyams par gyur ta re/ de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po spyod pa'i blo gros kyis/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rin chen 'od 'phro de las pad+mo gser gyi mdog tu snang ba 'dab ma stong dang ldan pa de dag blangs te/ byang chub sems dpa' khyim pa dang / rab tu byung ba dang /khye'u dang bu mo'i gzugs su 'dug pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong du ma dang 'grogs te—/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing de nas mi snang bar gyur nas/ nub phyogs kyi sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das gang ji snyed cig bzhugs shing 'tsho skyong ba de dag thams cad la me tog dang / spos dang / bdug spos dang / phreng ba dang /byug pa dang / phye ma dang / na bza' dang / rgyan dang / gdugs dang /rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan dag gis rim gror bya ba dang / bkur ster bya ba dang / bste stang du bya ba dang / mchod par byed cing / byang chub sems 50—28

dpa'i rdzu 'phrul chen po dang / byang chub sems dpa'i mthu chen pos bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa gang na ba der dong ste phyin nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te phyogs gcig tu 'khod do/ /phyogs gcig tu 'khod nas/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po spyod pa'i blo gros kyis/bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rin chen 'od 'phros ①bcom ldan 'das la snyun mi mnga' 'am/ thugs gzer ma mchis sam/ ldang ba yang ngam/ gshegs spyod dam/ bde ba la reg par gnas sam/ zhes 'dri ste/ pad+mo gser rmi mdog tu snang ba 'dab ma stong dang ldan pa 'di dag kyang bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen 'od 'phros bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa'i slad du bskur ro/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pas pad+mo de dag bzhes nas/ nub phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gang bā'i klung gi bye ma snyed po de dag gi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de dag gang na ba der gtor ro②/ /de nas pad+mo de dag gis 'jig rten gyi khams de dag thams cad rgyas par khyab par gyur te/ pad+mo de dag la de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku mang po bzhugs shing / sangs rgyas kyi zhing de dag tu 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang ldan pa'i chos bstan pa 'di nyid ston to/ /chos bstan pa de sems can gang gis thos par gyur pa de dag thams cad kyang bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu nges par gyur to/ /byang chub sems 50—29

dpa' khyim pa dang / rab tu byung ba dang / khye'u dang bu mo'i gzugs su 'dug pa byang chub sems dpa' spyod pa'i blo gros dang lhan cig 'jig rten byi khams nye bar zhi ba de nas 'ongs pa de dag gis kyang rang rang gi dge ba'i rtsa bas/bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa la rim gror byas so/ /bkur ster byas so/ /bste stang du byas so/ /mchod par byas nas phyogs gcig tu 'khod do/ /de nas byang phyogs su 'jig rten gyi khams gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed las 'das te/de thams cad las pha rol po'i 'jig rten kyi khams rgyal ba zhes bya ba gang yin pa de na de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rgyal ba'i dbang po zhes bya ba bzhugs shing 'tsho skyong ste/ de byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams la shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di nyid yang dag par ston par ①mdzad do/ /de nas 'jig rten gyi khams de na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rgyal bas byen zhes bya ba 'dug 'dug pas snang ba chen po de dang / sa cher g.yos pa de dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku blta na chog mi shes pa de mthong nas/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rgyal ba'i dbang po gang na ba der song ste phyin nas/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rgyal ba'i dbang po de la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das 'od chen po 'di lta bu 'jig rten du byung ba dang / dog sa 'di ltar cher g.yos pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku 'di lta bu gda' ba 'di rgyu ci lags/ rkyen ci lags/de skad ces gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rgyal ba'i 50—30

dbang pos byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rgyal bas byin la 'di skad ces bka' pa to/ /rigs kyi bu 'di ni lho phyogs logs su 'jig rten gyi khams gang bā'i klung gi bye ma snyed 'das pa na 'jig rten gyi khams mi mjed ces bya ba yod de/ de na de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa zhes bya ba bzhugs shing 'tsho skyong ngo / /de byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams la shes rab kyi/ pha rol tu phyin pa ston te/ 'di 'dra ba de ①ni de'i mthu yin no/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rgyal bas byin gyis/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rgyal ba'i dbang po la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag kyang 'jig rten gyi khams mi mjed der/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa de blta ba dang / de la phyag bgyi zhing bsnyen bkur ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de dag kun kyang phal cher gzhon nur gyur pa/gzungs dang so so yang dag par rig pa sgrub ①pa rab tu thob pa/ ting nge 'dzin dang snyoms par 'jug pa thams cad la dbang rab tu thob pa de dag blta ba'i slad du mchi'o/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rgyal ba'i dbang pos bka' byed pa/ rigs kyi bu byed kyis da ltar de'i dus la bab par shes na song shig /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa rgyal ba'i dbang pos byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rgyal bas byin la/ pad+mo rin bo che sna tshogs kyi rgyu las byung ba gser gyi mdog tu snang ba 'dab ma stong dang ldan pa stong bskur te/rigs kyi bu byed kyis bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang 50—31

dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa de la pad+mo 'di dag gis gtor te/'di skad du/ bcom ldan 'das rgyal ba'i dbang pos ①bcom ldan 'das la snyun mi mnga' 'am/ thugs gzer ma mchis sam/ ldang ba yang ngam/gshegs spyod dam/ bde ba la reg par gnas sam zhes rmed de/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rgyal ba'i dbang po des bcom ldan 'das la pad+mo 'di dag kyang ②bskur ro zhes spros shig /rigs kyi bu sangs rgyas kyi zhing der bag yod par spyod cig /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'jig rten gyi khams der skyes pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de dag ni bsten par dka' ba yin te/ der nyams par gyur ta re/ de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rgyal bas byen gyis—/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rgyal ba'i dbang po de las pad+mo gser gyi mdog tu snang ba 'dab ma stong dang ldan pa de dag blangs te/ byang chub sems dpa' khyim pa dang / rab tu byung ba dang / khye'u dang bu mo'i gzugs su 'dug pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong du ma dang 'grogs te/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing de nas mi snang bar gyur nas/ byang phyogs kyi sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das gang ji snyed cig bzhugs shing 'tsho skyong ba de dag thams cad la me tog dang / spos dang /bdug spos dang / phreng ba dang / byug pa dang / phye ma dang / na bza' dang / rgyan dang / gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan dag gis rim gror bya ba dang / bkur ster bya ba dang / bste stang du bya ba dang /mchod par byed cing / byang chub sems dpa'i rdzu 'phrul chen po dang / byang 50—32

chub sems dpa'i mthu chen bos/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa gang na ba der song ste phyin nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la spyi bos phyag 'tshal te/phyogs gcig tu 'khod do/ /phyogs gcig tu 'khod nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rgyal bas byin gyis/ bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rgyal ba'i dbang pos①/ bcom ldan 'das la snyun mi mnga' 'am/ thugs gzer ma mchis sam/ ldang ba yang ngam/gshegs spyod dam/ bde ba la reg par gnas sam zhes 'dri ste/ pad+mo gser gyi mdog tu snang ba 'dab ma stong dang ldan pa 'di dag kyang bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rgyal ba'i dbang pos bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa'i slad du bskur ro/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pas pad+mo de dag bzhes nas/ byang phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed po de dag gi sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag gang na ba der gtor to//de nas pad+mo de dag gis 'jig rten gyi khams de dag thams cad rgyas par khyab par gyur te/ pad+mo de dag la de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku mang po bzhugs shing /sangs rgyas kyi zhing de dag tu 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang ldan pa'i chos bstan pa 'di nyid ston to/ /chos bstan pa de sems can gang gis thos par gyur pa de dag thams cad kyang bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu nges par gyur to/ /byang chub sems dpa' khyem pa dang /rab tu byung ba dang / khye'u dang bu mo'i gzugs su 'dug pa byang chub sems 50—33

dpa' rgyal bas byen dang lhan cig 'jig rten gyi khams rgyal ba de nas 'ongs pa de dag gis kyang / rang rang gi dge ba'i rtsa bas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa la rim gror byas so/ /bkur ster byas so/ /bste stang du byas so/ /mchod par byas nas phyogs gcig tu 'khod do/ /de nas byang shar gyi phyogs mtshalas su 'jig rten gyi khams gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed las 'das te/ de thams cad las ①pha rol po'i 'jig rten byi khams ting nge 'dzin gyis brgyan pa zhes bya ba gang yin pa de na de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ting nge 'dzin byi glang po dam pa'i dpal zhes bya ba bzhugs shing 'tsho skyong ste/ de byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams la shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di nyid yang dag par ston pa mdzad do/ /de nas 'jig rten gyi khams de na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnam par rgyal bas ①rnam par gnon pa zhes bya ba 'dug 'dug pas snang ba chen po de dang /sa cher g.yos pa de dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku blta na chog mi shes pa de mthong nas/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ting nge 'dzin gyi glang po dam pa'i dpal gang na ba der song ste phyin nas/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa nying nge 'dzin gyi glang po dam pa'i dpal de la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das 'od chen po 'di lta bu 'jig rten du 'byung ba dang / dog sa 'di ltar cher g.yos pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku 'di lta bu gda' ba 'di rgyu ci lags/rkyen ci lags/ de skad ces gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das de bzhin 50—34

gshegs pa ting nge 'dzin gyi glang po dam pa'i dpal kyis byang chub sems dpa' rnam par rgyal bas rnam par gnon pa la 'di skad ces bka' stsal ①to/ /rigs kyi bu 'di nas lho nub kyi phyogs mtshams logs su 'jig rten gyi khams gang bā'i klung gi bye ma snyed 'das pa na 'jig rten gye khams mi mjed ces bya ba yod de/ de na de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa zhes bya ba bzhugs shing 'tsho skyong ngo // /de byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams la shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ston te/'di 'dra ba 'di ni de'i mthu yin no/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnam par rgyal bas rnam par gnon pas/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa ting nge 'dzin kyi glang po dam pa'i dpal la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag kyang 'jig rten gyi khams mi mjid der/bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa de blta ba dang / de la phyag bgyi shing bsnyen bkur ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de dag kun kyang phal cher gzhon nur gyur pa dang sde/ gzungs snedang so so yang dag par rig pa sgrub dupa rab tu thob pa/ ting nge 'dzin dang snyoms par 'jug pa thams cad la dbang rab tu thob pa de dag blta ba'i slad du mchi'o/ /bcom ldan 'das ting nge 'dzin byi glang po dam pa'i dpal gyis bka' pa pa/ rigs kyi bu khyod kyis da ltar de'i dus la bab par shes na song shig/ //bam po gnyis pa/ de nas de bzhin gshegs pa ting nge 'dzin gyi glang po dam pa'i dpal gyis/ byang chub sems dpa' dhirnam par rgyal bas rnam par 50—35

gnon pa la pad+mo rin po che sna tshogs kyi rgyu las byung ba/ gser byi mdog tu snang ba 'dab ma stong dang ldan pa stong bskur te/ rigs kyi bu khyod kyis bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa de la pad+mo 'di dag gis gtor te/ 'di skad du bcom ldan 'das ting nge 'dzin gyi glang po dam pa'i dpal la ①bcom ldan 'das la snyun mi mnga' 'am—/ thugs gzer ma mchis sam/ ldang ba yang ngam/ gshegs spyod dam/bde ba la reg par gnas sam zhes rmed de/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ting nge 'dzin gyi glang po dam pa'i dpal des bcom ldan 'das la pad+mo 'di dag kyang bskur ro zhes sgos shig /rigs kyi bu sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'dir ②bag yod par spyod cig/de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'jig rten byi khams der skyes pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de dag ni bsten par dka' ba yin te/ der nyams par gyur ta re/ de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnam par rgyal bas rnam par gnon pas/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ting nge 'dzin gyi glang po dam pa'i dpal de las pad+mo gser gyi mdog tu snang ba 'dab ma stong dang ldan pa de dag blangs te/ byang chub sems dpa' khyim pa dang / rab tu byung ba dang / sgo dang bu mo'i gzugs su 'dug pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong du ma dang 'grogs te/sangs rgyas kyi zhing de nas mi snang bar gyur nas/ byang shar gyi phyogs mtshams kyi sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das gang ji snyed cig bzhugs shing 'tsho skyong ba de dag thams cad la me tog dang / spos dang / bdug spos dang / phreng ba dang /50—36

byug pa dang / phye ma dang / na bza' dang / rgyan dang / gdugs dang /rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan dag gis rim gror bya ba dang / bkur ster bya ba dang / bste stang du bya ba dang / mchod par byed cing / byang chub sems dpa'i rdzu 'phrul chen po dang / byang chub sems dpa'i mthu chen pos/bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa gang na ba der song ste phyin nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la spyi bos phyag 'tshal te/ phyogs gcig tu 'khod do/ /phyogs gcig tu 'khod nas/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnam par rgyal bas rnam par gnon pas/ bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ting nge 'dzin gyi glang po dam pa'i dpal bcom ldan 'das la snyun mi mnga' 'am/ thugs gzer ma mchis sam/ ldang ba yang ngam/ gshegs spyod dam/ bde ba la reg par gnas sam zhes 'dri ste/pad+mo gser gyi mdog tu snang ba 'dab ma stong dang ldan pa 'di dag kyang bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa ting nge 'dzin gyi glang po dam pa'i dpal gyis bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa'i slad du bskur ro/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pas pad+mo de dag bzhes nas/ byang shar gyi phyogs mtshams kyi 'jig rten kyi khams gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed po de dag gi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de dag gang na ba der gtor to/ /de nas pad+mo de dag gis 'jig rten gyi khams de dag thams cad rgyas par khyab par gyur te/ pad+mo de dag la de bzhin gshegs 50—37

pa'i sku mang po bzhugs shing / sangs rgyas kyi zhing de dag tu 'di lta ste/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang ldan pa'i chos bstan pa 'di nyid ston to/ /chos bstan pa de sems can gang gis thos par gyur pa de dag thams cad kyang bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu nges par gyur to/ /byang chub sems dpa' khyim pa dang / rab tu byung ba dang / sgo dang bu mo'i gzugs su 'dug pa byang chub sems dpa' rnam par rgyal bas rnam par gnon pa dang lhan cig 'jig rten gye khams rgyal ①ba de nas 'ongs pa de dag dze+ekyang rang rang gi dge ba'i rtsa bas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par ①rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa la rim gror byas so/ /bkur ster ④byas so/ /bste stang du byas so/ /mchod par byas nas phyogs gcig tu 'khod do—/ /de nas shar lho'i phyogs mtshams kyi ⑤'jig rten byi khams gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed las 'das te/ de thams cad las pha rol po'i 'jig rten kyi khams snying po byang chub kyi rgyan shin tu yid du 'ong ba zhes bya ba gang yin pa de na de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas pad+mo dam pa'i dpal zhes bya ba bzhugs shing 'tsho skyong ngo rjo/ /de byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams la shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di nyid yang dag par ston pa mdzad do/ /de nas 'jig rten kyi khams de na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po lag na pad+mo zhes bya ba 'dug 'dug pa ⑦snang ba chen po de dang / sa cher g.yos pa de dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku blta na chog mi shes pa de mthong nas/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas pad+mo dam pa'i dpal gang na ba der song 50—38

ste phyin nas/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa pad+mo dam pa'i dpal de la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das 'od chen po 'di lta bu 'jig rten du byung ba dang / dog sa 'di ltar cher g.yos pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku 'di lta bu gda' ba 'di'i ①rgyu ci lags/ rkyen ci lags/ de skad ces gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa pad+mo dam pa'i dpal gyis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po lag na pad+mo la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /rigs kyi bu 'di ni nub byang gi phyogs mtshams logs su 'jig rten gyi khams gang bā'i klung gi bye ma snyed 'das pa na 'jig rten gyi khams mi mjid ces bya ba yod de/ de na de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa zhes bya ba bzhugs shing 'tsho skyong ngo / /de byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams la shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ston te/ 'di 'dra ba 'di ni de'i mthu yin no/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po lag na pad+mos/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa pad+mo dam pa'i dpal la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag kyang 'jig rten gyi khams mi mjed der bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa de blta ba dang / de la phyag bgyi zhing bsnyen bkur ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de dag kun kyang phal cher gzhon nur gyur pa/gzungs dang so so yang dag par rig pa sgrub sdepa rab tu thob pa/ ting nge 'dzin dang snyoms par 'jug pa thams cad la dbang rab tu thob pa de dag blta ba'i slad du mchi'o/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa pad+mo dam pa'i dpal 50—39

gyis bka' byed pa/ rigs kyi bu khyod kyis da ltar de'i dus la bab par shes na song shig /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa pad+mo dam pa'i dpal gyis byang chub sems dpa' lag na pad+mo la pad+mo rin po che sna tshogs kyi rgyu las byung ba gser byi mdog tu snang ba 'dab ma stong dang ldan pa stong bskur te/ rigs kyi bu spyod kyis bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa de la pad+mo de ①dag gis gtor te/ 'di skad du bcom ldan 'das pad+mo dam pa'i dpal bcom ldan 'das la snyun mi mnga' 'am/thugs gzer ma mchis sam/ ldang ba yang ngam/ gshegs spyod dam/ bde ba la reg par gnas sam zhes rmed de/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas pad+mo dam pa'i dpal des bcom ldan 'das la pad+mo 'di dag kyang bskur ro zhes spros shig /rigs kyi bu sangs rgyas kyi zhing der bag yod par spyod cig /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'jig rten gyi khams der skyes pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de dag ni bsten par dka' ba yin te/ der nyams par gyur ta re/ de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po lag na pad+mos/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas pad+mo dam pa'i dpal de las/ pad+mo gser gyi mdog tu snang ba 'dab ma stong dang ldan pa de dag blangs nas/ byang chub sems dpa' khyem pa dang / rab tu byung ba dang /sgo dang bu mo'i gzugs su 'dug pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong du ma dang 'grogs te—/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing de nas mi snang bar gyur nas/ shar lho'i phyogs mtshams kyi sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das gang ji snyed cig bzhugs shing 'tsho 50—40

skyong ba de dag thams cad la me tog dang / spos dang / bdug spos dang /phreng ba dang / byug pa dang / phye ma dang / na bza' dang / rgyan dang /gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan dag gis rim gror bya ba dang /bkur ster bya ba dang / bste stang du bya ①dang / mchod par ②byed cing /byang chub sems dpa'i rdzu 'phrul chen po dang / byang chub sems dpa'i mthu chen po dang ④/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa gang na ba der song ste phyin nas/bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la spyi bos phyag 'tshal te/ phyogs gcig tu 'khod do/ /phyogs gcig tu 'khod nas/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po lag na pad+mos bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas pad+mo dam pa'i dpal/ bcom ldan 'das la snyun mi mnga' 'am/thugs gzer ma mchis sam/ ldang ba yang ngam/ gshegs spyod dam/ bde ba la reg par gnas sam zhes 'dri ste/ pad+mo gser kyi mdog can 'dab ma stong dang ldan pa 'di dag kyang / bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas pad+mo dam pa'i dpal gyis bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa'i slad du bskur ro/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pas pad+mo de dag bzhes nas/ shar lho'i phyogs mtshalas kyi 'jig rten kyi khams gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed po de dag gi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de dag gang na ba der gtor to/ /de nas pad+mo 50—41

de dag gis 'jig rten gyi khams de dag thams cad rgyas par khyab par gyur te/pad+mo de dag las ①de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku mang po bzhugs shing / sangs rgyas kyi zhing de dag tu 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang ldan pa'i chos bstan pa 'di nyid ston to/ /chos bstan pa de sems can gang gis thos par gyur pa de dag thams cad kyang bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu nges par gyur to/ /byang chub sems dpa' khyim pa dang / rab tu byung ba dang / khye'u dang bu mo'i gzugs su 'dug pa byang chub sems dpa' lag na pad+mo dang lhan cig 'jig rten gyi khams snying po byang chub kyi rgyan shin tu yid du 'ong ba de nas 'ongs pa de dag gis kyang rang rang gi dge ba'i rtsa bas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa la rim gror byas so/ /bkur ster byas so/ /bste stang du byas so/ /mchod par byas nas phyogs gcig tu 'khod do/ /de —nas lho nub kyi phyogs mtshams su 'jig rten gyi khams gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed las 'das te/ de thams cad las pha rol po'i 'jig rten gyi khams rdul gyi tshogs dang bral ba zhes bya ba gang yin pa de na de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor snang ba dam pa'i dpal zhes bya ba bzhugs shing 'tsho skyong ste/ de byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams la shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di nyid yang dag par ston par ②mdzad do/ /de nas 'jig rten gyi khams de na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po nyi ma rab tu snang ba zhes bya ba 'dug 'dug pas snang ba chen po de dang / sa cher g.yos pa de dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku blta na chog mi 50—42

shes pa de mthong nas/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor snang ba dam pa'i dpal gang na ba der song ste phyin nas/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor snang ba dam pa'i dpal de la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das 'od chen po 'di lta bu 'jig rten du byung ba dang / dog sa 'di ltar cher g.yos pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku 'di lta bu gda' ba ni rgyu ci lags/ rkyen ci lags/ de skad ces gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor snang ba dam pa'i dpal gyis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po nyi ma rab tu snang ba de la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /rigs kyi bu 'di ni byang shar gyi phyogs mtshams logs su 'jig rten gyi khams gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed las 'das pa na 'jig rten gyi khams mi mjed ces bya ba yod de—/ de na de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa zhes bya ba ①bzhugs shing 'tsho skyong ngo / /de byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams la shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ston te/ 'di 'dra ba 'di ni de'i mthu yin no/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po nyi ma rab tu snang bas/ bcom ldan 'das nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor snang ba dam pa'i dpal la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag kyang 'jig rten kyi khams mi mjed der bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa de blta ba dang / de la phyag bgyi zhing bsnyen bkur ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' 50—43
