nyid dang bral ba'o/ /tshor ba ni tshor ba'i mtshan nyid dang bral ba'o /'du shes ni 'du shes kyi mtshan nyid dang bral ba'o/ /'du byed rnams ni 'du byed rnams kyi mtshan nyid dang bral ba'o/ /rnam par shes pa ni rnam par shes pa'i mtshan nyid dang bral ba'o/ /skye mched rnams ni skye mched rnams kyi mtshan nyid dang bral ba'o/ /khams rnams ni khams rnams kyi mtshan nyid dang bral ba'o/ /rten cing 'byel par 'byung ba'i bar ni rten cing 'byel par 'byung ba'i mtshan nyid dang bral ba'o/ /yang dag pa'i mtha'i bar ni yang dag pa'i mtha'i mtshan nyid dang bral ba'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu mtshan nyid kyang mtshan nyid kyi ngo bo dang bral ba'o/ /ngo bo yang ngo bo'i mtshan nyid dang bral ba'o/ /shā ri'i bus smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gang zhig bslab pa 'di la slob pa de rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du 'byung bar 'gyur ram/ rab 'byor gyis smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu de de bzhin te/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gang zhig bslab pa 'di la slob pa de ni/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du 'byung bar 'gyur ro zhes bya ba ni bzod pa chung ngu'i dmigs pa dang rnam pa'i khyad par yin no / /①de ci'i phyir zhe na/ tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu 'di ltar chos thams cad ni ma skyes shing nges par ma byung ba'o/ /smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor rgyu gang gis na chos thams cad ma skyes shing nges par ma 'byung ba yin/ rab 'byor gyis smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu gzugs ni gzugs kyi rang bzhin gyis stong ste/ de la skye ba'am/ nges par 'byung ba yang mi dmigs so/tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu tshor ba ni tshor ba'i rang bzhin gyis stong ste/ /de la skye 50—354

ba'am nges par 'byung ba yang mi dmigs so/ /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu 'du shes ni 'du shes kyi rang bzhin gyis stong ste/ de la skye ba'am nges par 'byung ba yang mi dmigs so/ /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu 'du byed rnams ni 'du byed rnams kyi rang bzhin gyis stong ste/ de la skye ba'am nges par 'byung ba yang mi dmigs so/ /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu rnam par shes pa ni rnam par shes pa'i rang bzhin gyis stong ste/ de la skye ba'am nges par 'byung ba yang mi dmigs so//de bzhin du phung po dang / khams dang / skye mched dang / rten cing 'byel par 'byung ba dang / yang dag pa'i mtha'i bar du yang dag pa'i mtha'i rang bzhin gyis stong ste/ de la skye ba'am nges par 'byung ba yang mi dmigs so/ /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa ni/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang nye ba yin te/ de ji lta ji ltar rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du nye bar gyur pa de lta de ltar lus yongs su dag pa dang / ngag yongs su dag pa dang /sems yongs su dag pa dang / mtshan yongs su dag pa thob par 'gyur ro/ /de ji lta ji ltar lus yongs su dag pa dang / ngag yongs su dag pa dang /sems yongs su dag pa dang / mtshan yongs su dag pa thob par 'gyur ba ①de lta de ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de 'dod chags dang ldan pa'i sems mi skyed do/ /zhe sdang dang ldan pa'i sems mi skyed ②do/ /gti mug dang ldan pa'i sems mi skyed ①do/ /nga rgyal dang ldan pa'i sems mi skyed do/ /g.yo dang sgyu dang ldan pa dang / phrag dog dang ser sna dang ldan pa dang /sred pa dang ldan pa dang / lta ba ngan pa dhidang ldan pa'i sems mi skyed do/ /50—355

de 'dod chags kyi sems mi skyed cing / zhe sdang dang / gahi mug dang / nga rgyal dang / g.yo dang / sgyu dang / phrag dog dang / ser sna dang / sred pa dang / lta ba ngan pa dang ldan pa'i sems mi skyed pas nam yang ma'i ①mngal du skye bar mi 'gyur te/ rtag tu rgyun mi 'chad par rdzus ②te skye bar 'gyur ro/ /sems can yongs su smin par bya ba'i don ma gtogs par nam yang ngan song rnams su skye bar mi 'gyur ro/ /de sangs rgyas kyi zhing nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing du 'gro zhing / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la yang ①bsnyen bkur byed/sems can rnams kyang yongs su smin par byed/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing yang sbyong bar byed de nas rjobla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas kyi bar du nam yang sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams dang 'bral ⑤bar mi 'gyur ro/ /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la de ltar rjospyod pa ni/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du nye bar gyur pa yin no zhes bya ba ni bzod pa 'bring gi dmigs pa dang rnam pa'i khyad par yin no / /⑦de nas tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor gyis bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das gal te byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ thabs mi mkhas pas gzugs la spyod na mtshan ma la spyod de/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la mi spyod do/ /gal te tshor ba la spyod na mtshan ma la spyod do/ /'du shes la spyod na mtshan ma la spyod do/ /'du byed rnams la spyod na mtshan ma la spyod do/ /rnam par shes pa la spyod na mtshan ma la spyod de/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 50—356

la mi spyod do/ /gal te gzugs rtag pa'am/ mi rtag pa zhes bgyi bar spyod na mtshan ma la spyod de/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la mi spyod do/ /gal te tshor ba rtag pa'am/ mi rtag pa zhes bgyi bar spyod na mtshan ma la spyod do/ /'du shes rtag pa'am/ mi rtag pa zhes bgyi bar spyod na mtshan ma la spyod do/ /'du byed rnams rtag pa'am/ mi rtag pa zhes bgyi bar spyod na mtshan ma la spyod dorka/ /rnam par shes pa rtag pa'am/ mi rtag pa zhes bgyi bar spyod na mtshan ma la spyod de/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la mi spyod do/ /gal te gzugs bde ba'am/ sdug bsngal ba zhes bgyi bar spyod na mtshan ma la spyod de/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la mi spyod do/ /gal te tshor ba bde ba'am/ sdug bsngal ba zhes bgyi bar spyod na mtshan ma la spyod do/ /'du ①shes bde ba'am/sdug bsngal ba zhes bgyi bar spyod na mtshan ma la spyod do/ /'du byed rnams bde ba'am—/ sdug bsngal ba khruzhes bgyi bar spyod na mtshan ma la spyod do/ /rnam par shes pa bde ba'am/ sdug bsngal ba zhes bgyi bar spyod na mtshan ma la spyod de—/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la mi spyod do/ /gal te gzugs bdag gam—/ bdag med ces bkyi bar spyod na mtshan ma la spyod de/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la mi spyod do/ /tshor ba bdag gam bdag med ces bgyi bar spyod na mtshan ma la spyod do/ /'du shes bdag gam bdag med ces bgyi bar spyod na mtshan ma la spyod do/ /'du byed rnams bdag gam bdag med ces bgyi bar spyod na mtshan ma la spyod do/ /rnam par shes pa bdag gam bdag med ces bgyi bar spyod na mtshan ma la spyod de/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la mi spyod do—/ /gal te gzugs zhi ba'am/ ma zhi ba zhes bgyi bar spyod na mtshan ma la 50—357

spyod de/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la mi spyod do/ /tshor ba zhi ba'am/ma zhi ba zhes bgyi bar spyod na mtshan ma la spyod do/ /'du shes zhi ba'am/ ma zhi ba ①zhes bgyi bar spyod na mtshan ma la spyod do/ /'du byed rnams zhi ba'am/ma zhi ba zhes bkyi bar spyod na mtshan ma la spyod do/ /rnam par shes pa zhi ba'am/ma zhi ba zhes bgye bar spyod na mtshan ma la spyod de/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la mi spyod do/ /gal te gzugs dben pa'am/ mi dbe+en pa zhes babyi bar spyod na mtshan ma la spyod de/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la mi spyod do/ /tshor ba dbe+en pa'am/ mi dben pa zhes bgyi bar spyod na mtshan ma la spyod do/ /'du shes dben pa'am/ mi dben pa ④zhes bgyi bar spyod na mtshan ma la spyod do—/ /'du byed rnams dben pa'am/ mi dbe+en pa zhes bgyi ③bar spyod na mtshan ma la spyod do/ /rnam par shes pa dben pa'am mi dben pa zhes bgyi bar spyod na mtshan ma la spyod de/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la mi spyod do/ /bcom ldan 'das gal te byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ thabs mi mkhas pas byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun gye bar la spyod na mtshan ma la spyod de/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la mi spyod do/ /de bzhin du mngon par shes pa rnams dang /pha rol tu phyin pa rnams budang / bsam gtan rnams dang / tshad med pa rnams dang /du gzugs med pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams dang / mig lnga rnams dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu rnams dang / mi 'jigs pa bzhi rnams dang / so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi rnams dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa'i bar rnams la spyod na mtshan ma la spyod de/ shes 50—358

rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la mi spyod do/ /bcom ldan 'das gal te byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/thabs mi mkhas pas 'di snyam du/ bdag ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do snyam du sems na dmigs pa la spyod pa ste/ bdag med do snyam du sems pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de ni mtshan ma la spyod do/ /bcom ldan 'das gal te byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'di snyam du gang de ltar spyod pa de ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /de ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa sgom mo snyam du sems na de mtshan ma nyid la spyod pa ste①/ de ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i thabs mi mkhas par rig par bya'o②/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bus/ tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor la 'di skad ces smras so/ /tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'di thabs mi mkhas par ji ltar rig par bya ba yin/ rab 'byor gyis smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu 'di ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/gzugs la gnas pa dang / lhag par mos pa dang / kun shes pa dang /tshor ba la gnas pa dang / lhag par mos pa dang / kun shes pa dang /'du shes la gnas pa dang / lhag par mos pa dang / kun shes pa dang /'du byed rnams la gnas pa dang / lhag par mos pa dang / kun shes pa dang / rnam par shes pa la gnas pa dang / lhag par mos pa dang / kun shes par byed na de gzugs la gnas pa dang / lhag par mos pa dang /kun shes pa dang / tshor ba la gnas pa dang / lhag par mos pa dang /50—359

kun shes pa dang / 'du shes la gnas pa dang / lhag par mos pa dang /kun shes pa dang / 'du byed rnams la gnas pa dang / lhag par mos pa dang / kun shes pa dang / rnam par shes pa la gnas pa dang / lhag par mos pa dang / kun shes pa dang ①/ gzugs mngon par 'du byed pa la spyod/tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed rnams dang / rnam par shes pa mngon par 'du byed pa la spyod pa yin te/ des na de skye ba dang / rga ba dang /na ba dang / 'chi ba dang / mya ngan dang / smre sngags 'don pa dang /sdug bsngal ba dang / yid mi bde ba dang / 'khrugs sdepa las yongs su mi 'grol ①bas/ sdug bsngal chen po las yongs su mi 'grol bar brjod do/ /gal te byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ mig la gnas pa dang / lhag par mos pa dang / kun shes pa dang / rna ba dang / sna dang / lce dang / lus dang / yid la gnas pa dang / lhag par mos pa dang / kun shes pa dang / gzugs la gnas pa dang / lhag par mos pa dang / kun shes pa dang / sgra dang /dri dang / ro dang / reg dang / chos la gnas pa dang / lhag par mos pa dang / kun shes pa dang / mig gi rnam par shes pa la gnas pa dang /lhag par mos pa dang / kun shes pa dang / rna ba'i rnam par shes pa dang /sna'i rnam par shes pa dang / lce'i rnam par shes pa dang / lus kyi rnam par shes pa dang / yid kyi rnam par shes pa la gnas pa dang / lhag par mos pa dang / kun shes pa dang / mig gi 'dus te reg pa la gnas pa dang /lhag par mos pa dang / kun shes pa dang / rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa dang /50—360

sna'i 'dus te reg pa dang / lce'i 'dus te reg pa dang / lus kyi 'dus te reg pa dang / yid kyi 'dus te reg pa la gnas pa dang / lhag par mos pa dang / kun shes pa dang / mig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen rmis tshor ba bde ba dang / sdug bsngal ba dang / bde ba yang ma yin/ sdug bsngal ba yang ma yin pa gang yin pa de la gnas pa dang / lhag par mos pa dang / kun shes pa dang / rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen gyis tshor ba dang / sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen gyis tshor ba dang / lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen gyis tshor ba dang / lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen gyis tshor ba dang / yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen gyis tshor ba bde ba dang ①/ sdug bsngal ba dang /bde ba yang ma yin/ sdug bsngal ba yang ma yin pa gang yin pa de la gnas pa dang / lhag par mos pa dang / kun shes pa dang / gal te byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun la ②gnas pa dang / lhag par mos pa dang /kun shes pa dang / de bzhin du mig lnga dang / mngon par shes pa drug dang /pha rol tu phyin pa drug dang / bsam gtan dang / tshad med pa dang /gzugs med pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu dang / mi 'jigs pa bzhi dang / so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi dang /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bco brgyad dang / dgra bcom pa nyid dang /rang sangs rgyas nyid dang / byang chub sems dpa' dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams la gnas pa dang / lhag par mos pa dang / kun shes na de sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams la gnas pa dang / lhag par mos pa dang / kun shes pas sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams mngon par 'du byed pa la spyod pa yin te/50—361

mngon par 'du byed pa la spyod pas skye ba dang / rga ba dang / na ba dang /'chi ba dang / mya ngan dang / smre sngags ①'don pa dang / sdug bsngal ba dang / yid mi bde ba las yongs su mi 'grol bas sdug bsngal chen po las yongs su mi 'grol bar brjod do/ /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de ni nyan thos kyi sa'am/ rang sangs rgyas kyi sa yang mngon du bya ba'i skal ba yang med na/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par ⑤'tshang rgya ba lta ci smos te/ de ni gnas med do/ /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod na/ thabs mi mkhas par shes par bya'o/ /smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la ji ltar spyod na thabs mkhas par shes par bya/rab 'byor gyis smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu nam byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa na/ gzugs la gnas pa med pa dang / lhag par mos pa med pa dang / kun shes pa med pa dang / tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed rnams dang / rnam par shes pa la gnas pa med pa dang / lhag par mos pa med pa dang / kun shes pa med pa dang / de bzhin du sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams kyi bar la gnas pa med pa dang / lhag par mos pa med pa dang / kun shes pa med pas de gzugs la mi spyod/ tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed rnams dang /rnam par shes pa la mi spyod de/ gzugs kyi mtshan ma la mi spyod/ tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed rnams dang / rnam par shes pa'i mtshan 50—362

ma la mi spyod/ gzugs rtag pa'am/ mi rtag pa zhes bya bar mi spyod/ tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed rnams dang / rnam par shes pa rtag pa'am / mi rtag pa zhes bya bar mi spyod/ gzugs bde ba'am/ sdug bsngal ba zhes bya ba dang / bdag yod pa'am/ bdag med pa zhes bya ba dang /zhi ba'am/ ma zhi ba stizhes bya ba dang / tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang /'du byed rnams la yang de bzhin te/ rnam par shes pa bde ba'am/ sdug bsngal ④zhes bya ba dang / bdag gam bdag med pa zhes bya ba dang / zhi ba'am ma zhi ba ④zhes bya bar mi spyod/ gzugs stong pa'am/ mi stong pa zhes bya bar mi spyod/ mtshan ma yod pa'am/ mtshan ma med pa zhes bya bar mi spyod/smon pa yod pa'am/ smon pa med pa zhes bya bar mi spyod/ tshor ba dang /'du shes dang / 'du byed rnams la de bzhin te/ rnam par shes pa stong pa'am—/ mi stong pa zhes bya bar mi spyod/ mtshan ma yod pa'am/ mtshan ma med pa zhes bya bar mi spyod/ rton pa yod pa'am/ smon pa med pa zhes bya bar mi spyod/ dbe+en pa'am/ mi dben pa zhes bya bar mi spyod na/ de'i tshe byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po thabs mkhas par shes par bya'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu 'di ltar gzugs kyi stong pa nyid gang yin pa de gzugs ma yin/ stong pa nyid las gzhan na sdegazugs med/gzugs las gzhan na ⑤stong pa nyid med de/ gzugs nyid stong pa nyid/stong pa nyid nyid gzugs so/ /tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed rnams dang / rnam par shes pa'i stong pa nyid gang yin pa de yang rnam par shes pa ma yin/ stong pa nyid las gzhan na yang / rnam par shes pa med/ rnam 50—363

par shes pa las gzhan na yang / stong pa nyid med de/ stong pa nyid nyid rnam par shes pa①/ rnam par shes pa nyid stong pa nyid do/ /de bzhin du skye mched dang / khams dang / rten cing 'byel par 'byung ba dang / byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun rnams dang / pha rol tu phyin pa rnams dang / bsam gtan rnams dang / tshad med pa rnams dang / gzugs med pa'i stoms par 'jug pa rnams dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu dang /mi 'jigs pa bzhi dang / so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bco brgyad kyi bar gyi stong pa nyid gang yin pa de yang sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams ma yin/ stong pa nyid las gzhan na yang sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams med/ sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams las gzhan na yang stong pa nyid med de/ stong pa nyid nyid sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams/ sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams stong pa nyid do/ /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la de ltar spyod pa ni thabs mkhas par shes par bya'o// //bam po bcu gcig pa/ tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa ni/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya ba'i skal ba yod do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa na/ gal te chos 'ga' zhig nye bar rtogs na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la mi spyod do—/ /nye bar ma rtogs na shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la mi spyod do/ /nye bar rtogs pa yang ma ④yin la/ nye bar ma rtogs pa yang yin na/ shes rab kyi 50—364

pha rol tu phyin pa la mi spyod do/ /nye bar rtogs pa yang ma yin la/ nye bar ma rtogs pa yang ma yin na shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la mi spyod do/ /shā ri'i bus smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor ci'i phyir na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ nye bar rtogs na shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la mi spyod pa yin/ nye bar ma rtogs na shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la mi spyod pa yin/ nye bar rtogs pa yang ma ①yin la/ nye bar ma rtogs pa yang yin na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la mi spyod pa yin/ nye bar rtogs pa yang ma yin la nye bar ma rtogs pa yang ma yin na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la mi spyod pa yin/ rab 'byor gyis smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu de ni 'di ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la rang bzhin mi dmigs so/ /de ci'i phyir zhe ④na/ 'di ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni dngos po med pa'i rang bzhin te/ tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu rnam grangs des na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe spyod do zhes bya bar nye bar mi rtogs so—/ /mi spyod do zhes bya bar nye bar mi rtogs so/ /spyod kyang spyod la mi spyod kyang mi spyod do zhes bya bar nye bar mi rtogs so/ /spyod pa yang ma yin mi spyod pa yang ma yin no zhes bya bar nye bar mi rtogs so/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar des chos thams cad dngos po med pa'i rang bzhin du khong du chud cing ma blangs pa'i phyir te/ tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu de ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i sems mi zhum zhing kun tu mi zhum ste/ mi dngang kun tu mi skrag kun tu skrag pas zin par ma 50—365

gyur na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de ni rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid la nye bar rig par bya'o zhes bya ba ni bzod pa chen po'i dmigs pa dang rnam pa'i khyad par ro ①tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid de yang dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid kyi phyir gnyis su med cing sdeganyis su byar med pa'o/ /de ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi ting nge 'dzin ni ①chos thams cad skye ba med pa zhes bya ba de/ yangs pa/ mdun du byas pa/tshad med par nges pa/ nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas rnams kyis mi 'phrogs pa'o/ /shā ri'i bu ting nge 'dzin rjodes rnam par spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni myur du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya'o/ /shā ri'i bus smras pa/tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor ting nge 'dzin ni ⑤gang dag gis gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po myur du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur/ rab 'byor gyis smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu ting nge 'dzin gang la gnas pas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po myur du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ba byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi ting nge 'dzin dpa' bar 'gro ba zhes bya ba yod do/ /de bzhin du rin chen phyag rgya zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin yod do/ /seng ge rnam par rtse ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin yod do/ /zla ba bzang po zhes 50—366

bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin yod do/ /zla ba'i rgyal mtshan tog ces bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin yod do/ /chos thams cad las shin tu 'phags pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin yod do/ /chos thams cad kyi phyag rgya zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin yod do/ /spyi gtsug rnam par lta ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin yod do/ /chos kyi dbyings su nges pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin yod do/ /nges pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin yod do/ /rdo rje lta bu zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin yod do/ /chos thams cad la 'jug pa'i phyag rgya zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin yod do/ /mnyam par gzhag ①pa'i gnas skabs su rab tu gnas pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin yod do/ /rgyal po'i phyag rgya zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin yod do/ /stobs kyi brtson 'grus zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin yod do/ /chos thams cad las yang dag par 'phags pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin yod do/ /ting nge 'dzin la rgyal po ltar rab tu gnas pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin yod do/ /'od zer rab tu 'gyed pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin yod do/ /dpung rnam par bkod pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin yod do/ /yang dag par 'phags pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin yod do/ /nges pa'i tshig la gdon mi za bar 'jug pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin yod do/ /lta bas chog mi shes pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin yod do/ /tshig bla dgas la yang dag par 'jug pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin yod do/ /phyogs rnam par lta ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin yod do/ /phyag rgya yongs su 'dzin pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin yod do/ /nyams pa med pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin yod do/ /chos thams cad yang dag par 'du ba rgya mtsho'i phyag rgya zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin yod do/ /nam mkha' ltar rgyas par 50—367

'gengs pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin yod do/ /rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin yod do/ /rgyal mtshan rtse mo'i dpung rgyan zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin yod do/ /dbang po'i tog ces bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin yod do/ /rgyun gyi rjes su song ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin yod do/ /seng ge rnam par bsgyings pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin yod do/ /snrel zhi zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin yod do/ /nyon mongs pa spong ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin yod do/ /rnam par snang ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin yod do/ /tshol ba med pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin yod do/ /gnas la rten ①pa med pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin yod do/ /sems med pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin yod do/ /dri ma med pa'i sgon ma zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin yod do/ /'od mtha' yas pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin yod do/ /'od byed pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin yod do//kun tu snang ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin yod do/ /dag pa dam pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin yod do/ /'od dri ma med pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin yod do/ /dga' ba byed pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin yod do/ /rgyal bar bya ba ma yin pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin yod do/ /glog gi sgon ma zhes bya ba'i bhang nge 'dzin yod do/ /zad mi shes pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin yod do/ /mi 'pham pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin yod do/ /gzi brjid yod pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin yod do/ /zad pa dang bral ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin yod do/ /mi g.yo ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin yod do/ /rnam par phye ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin yod do/ /'jigs pa snemed pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin yod do/ /nyi ma'i sgon ma zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin yod do/ /zla ba dri ma med pa zhes bya ba'i 50—368

ting nge 'dzin yod do/ /shes rab sgron ma zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin yod do/ /snang ba gsal ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin yod do/ /snang ba byed pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin yod do/ /bya ba byed pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin yod do/ /ye shes tog ces bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin yod do/ /rdo rje lta bu zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin yod do/ /sems gnas pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin yod do/ /kun tu snang ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin yod do/ /rab tu gnas pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin yod do/ /rin chen mtha' zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin yod do/ /chos dam pa'i phyag rgya zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin yod do/ /chos thams cad mnyam pa nyid ces bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin yod do/ /dga' ba spong ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin yod do/ /chos kyis ①'phags pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin yod do/ /rnam par 'thor ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin yod do/ /chos thams cad kyi tshig rab tu 'byed pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin yod do/ /yi ge rnam ②par 'god pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin yod do/ /yi ge dang bral ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin yod do/ /dmigs pa gcod pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin yod do/ /'gyur ba med pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin yod do/ /rnam pa med pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin yod do/ /ming nges par 'jug pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin yod do/ /gnas med par spyod pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin yod do/ /rab rib med pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin yod do/ /spyod pa dang ldan pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin yod do/ /g.yo ba med pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin yod do/ /g.yul ④las rgal ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin yod do/ /yon tan thams cad kyi tshogs su gyur pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin yod do/ /50—369

sems med par gnas pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin yod do/ /dge ba'i me tog rgyas shing gsal ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin yod do/ /byang chub kyi yan lag yod pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin yod do/ /spobs pa mtha' yas pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin yod do/ /mi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin yod do/ /chos thams cad las 'da' ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin yod do—/ /yongs su gcod par byed ①pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin yod do/ /ṣ+pem nur rnam par sel ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin yod do/ /gnas su bya ba med pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin yod do/ /gcig tu rnam par bkod pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin yod do/ /rnam pa mngon par sgrub pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin yod do/ /rnam pa gcig tu gyur pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin yod do/ /rnam pa dor ba med pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin yod do/ /srid pa'i gzhi thams cad rtogs par khong du chud pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin yod do/ /brda dang / sgra la 'jug pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin yod do/ /sgra dbyangs dang ldan pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin yod do/ /yi ge dang bral ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin yod do/ /sgon ma 'bar ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin yod do/ /mtshan nyid yongs su sbyong ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin yod do/ /mngon par dmigs pa med pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin yod do/ /rnam pa'i mchog thams cad dang ldan pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin yod do/ /bde ba dang / sdug bsngal thams cad la mngon par mi dga' ba med pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin yod do/ /zad mi shes pa'i za ma tog ces bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin yod do/ /gzungs kyi blo gros zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin yod do/ /'jig rten thams cad 50—370

rab tu sgom pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin yod do/ /ting nge 'dzin mnyam pa nyid ces bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin yod do/ /tshul dang tshul med pa las rnam par grol ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin yod do/ /rjes su 'brang ba thams cad yang dag par 'du ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin yod do/ /gzhi med par nges pa ①zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin yod do/ /de bzhin nyid la gnas par nges pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin yod do/ /lus kyi skyon yang dag par 'joms pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin yod do/ /ngag gi skyon rnam par 'jig pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin yod do/ /nam mkha' 'dra ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin yod do/ /nam mkha' ltar chags pa med pas rnam par grol zhing gos ④pa med pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin yod do/ /ting nge 'dzin des rnam par spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni myur du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu de dag ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi ting nge 'dzin te/ting nge 'dzin de dag gis rnam par spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams ni myur du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya ste/ de ltar ting nge 'dzin dang /gzungs kyi sgo gang la bslabs ①pas/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams myur du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ba de lta bu tshad med grangs med pa gzhan dag kyang yod derjo/ de la dpa' bar 'gro ba zhes bya ba'i nying nge 'dzin gang zhe na—/ ting nge 'dzin gang gis ting nge 'dzin thams cad kyi spyod yul nyams su 50—371

stsong bar 'gyur ba ste/ de ni dpa' bar 'gro ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin zhes bya'o—/ /de la rin chen phyag rgya zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gang zhe na/ ting nge 'dzin gang gis ting nge 'dzin thams cad rgyas gdab ①par 'gyur ba ste/de ni rin chen phyag rgya zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin zhes bya'o/ /de bzhin du de la nam mkha' ltar chags pa med pa'i ④rnam par grol zhing gos pa med pa zhes bya ba'i bar gyi ①ting nge 'dzin gang zhe na/ ting nge 'dzin gang la gnas na chos thams cad la nam mkha' ltar chags pa med cing rnam par grol bas gos pa med pa rjes su thob par 'gyur ba ste/ de ni nam mkha' ltar chags pa med pas durnam par grol zhing gos pa med pa'i ting nge 'dzin zhes bya ba'i bar du'o zhes bya ba ni chos kyi mchog chung ngu'i dmigs pa dang rnam pa'i khyad par yin no / /⑤de nas sangs rgyas kyi mthus tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor gyes/ tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu la 'di skad ces smras so/ /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gang ting nge 'dzin de dag gi rjoganas pa ⑦ni sngon gyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis kyang / bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu lung bstan to/ /da ltar phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag na/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bzhugs shing 'tsho skyong ba gang dag yin pa de dag gis kyang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de lung bstan te/ des ni ting nge 'dzin yang yang dag par rjes su mi mthong / bdag ni snyoms par zhugs so zhes bya bar ting nge 'dzin des rlom sems su 'gyur ba yang med do/ /des ni ting nge 50—372

'dzin yang yang dag par rjes su mi mthong ngo / /bdag ni snyoms par 'jug go//bdag gis mnyam par gzhag ①par bya'o/ /bdag ni mnyam par gzhag ④par gyur to zhes zlos sems su 'gyur ba med de/ de la rnam par rtog pa de dag med cing mi rgyu'o zhes bya ba ni chos kyi ④mchog 'bring gi dmigs pa dang rnam pa'i khyad par yin no / /rjoshā ri'i bus smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor ci ting nge 'dzin 'di la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po la/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis ⑤lung bstan pa yod dam/ rab 'byor gyis smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu de ni med de/de ci'i phyir zhe na/ tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu 'di ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yang gzhan la ting nge 'dzin yang gzhan/ byang chub sems dpa' yang gzhan zhes bya ba med kyi/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa nyid kyang ting nge 'dzin te/ ting nge 'dzin nyid kyang byang chub sems dpa'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' nyid kyang ting nge 'dzin to/ /smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor gal te de ltar ting nge 'dzin kyang gzhan la/ byang chub sems dpa' yang gzhan zhes bya ba medadhi/ byang chub sems dpa' yang gzhan la/ ting nge 'dzin nyid ⑦kyang gzhan zhes bya ba med de/ chos thams cad mnyam pa nyid kyi phyir ting nge 'dzin nyid kyang byang chub sems dpa' byang chub sems dpa' nyid kyang ting nge 'dzin yin na/ de la ting nge 'dzin bstan par nus sam/ rab 'byor gyis smras pa/ tshe dang ldan shā ri'i bu de ni ma yin no/ /smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor rigs kyi bu de ting nge 'dzin de la 'du shes su byed dam/50—373

rab 'byor gyis smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu 'du shes su byed pa med do//smras pa/ ji ltar de la 'du shes su byed par mi 'gyur/ rab 'byor gyis smras pa/ji ltar rnam par rtog ①pa med pa ltar ro/ /smras pa de la ji ltar rtog ①pa med pa yin—/ rab 'byor kyis smras pa/ chos thams cad med pa'i phyir rtog pa med de/de ltar na ting nge 'dzin de la rtog pa med do/ /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu rnam grangs des na/ rigs kyi bu de ting nge 'dzin de la rnam par shes par byed pa med do/ /'du shes su byed pa med do/ /smras pa/ci'i phyir rnam par shes par byed pa med cing / 'du shes su 'gyur ba med/ rab 'byor gyes smras pa/ ting nge 'dzin de yang med la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de yang med pa'i phyir/ rnam par shes pa med do/ /'du shes su 'astor ba med do zhes bya ba ni chos kyi mchog chen po'i dmigs pa dang rnam pa'i khyad par yin no / /④de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis/ tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor la legs so zhes bya ba gnang ste/ ji ltar khyod nyon mongs pa med pa la gnas pa rnams kyi mchog tu bstan pa ltar ston pa ni legs so/ /legs so/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos/ de ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la basbab par bya'o/ /de ltar bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang / tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la bslab par bya'o/ /de ltar byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos rnams dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bco brgyad kyi bar la bslab par bya'o/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bus/50—374

bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das de ltar slob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la slob ①pa lags sam/ bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang / tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la slob pa lags sam—/ byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos rnams dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams kyi bar la slob pa lags sam/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ shā ri'i bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de ltar slob pa ni—/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis slob pa yin/bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang / tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis slob pa yin/byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos rnams dang / bsam gtan dang / tshad med pa dang / gzugs med pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dang / stobs bcu dang /mi 'jigs pa bzhi dang / so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi dang /① sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bco brgyad kyi bar la mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis slob pa yin no/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bus/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la slob pa ni mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis slob pa lags sam/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ shā ri'i bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 50—375

la mi dmigs pa'i tshul byis slob pa yin no/ /shā ri'i bus gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das ci'i slad du mi dmigs pa lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa—/ shā ri'i bu shin tu rnam par dag pa'i phyir bdag mi dmigs so/ /shin tu rnam par dag pa'i phyir sems can dang / srog dang / gso ba dang /skyes bu dang / gang zag dang / shed las skyes dang / shed bu dang /byed pa po dang / tshor ba po dang / shes pa po dang / mthong ba po mi dmigs so/ /shin tu rnam par dag pa'i phyir sdug bsngal mi dmigs so/ /shin tu rnam par dag pa'i phyir kun 'byung ba dang / 'gog pa dang / lam mi dmigs so/ /shin tu rnam par dag pa'i phyir/ 'dod pa'i khams mi dmigs so/ /shin tu rnam par dag pa'i phyir/ gzugs kyi khams mi dmigs so/ /shin tu rnam par dag pa'i phyir/ gzugs med pa'i khams mi dmigs so/ /shin tu rnam par dag pa'i phyir/ bsam gtan dang / tshad med pa dang / gzugs med pa'i stoms par 'jug pa mi dmigs so/ /shin tu rnam par dag pa'i phyir/ dran pa nye bar gzhag ⑨pa dang / yang dag par spong ba dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa dang / dbang po dang / stobs dang /byang chub kyi yan lag dang / lam mi dmigs so/ /shin tu rnam par dag pa'i phyir/ pha rol tu phyin pa rnams mi dmigs so/ /shin tu rnam par dag pa'i phyir/ stobs bcu dang / mi 'jigs pa bzhi dang / so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu mi dmigs so/ /shin tu rnam par dag pa'i phyir/ sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams mi dmigs so/ /shin tu rnam par dag pa'i phyir/ rgyun tu zhugs pa mi dmigs 50—376

so—/ /shin tu rnam par dag pa'i phyir/ lan cig phyir 'ong ba dang / phyir mi 'ong ba dang / dgra bcom pa dang / rang sangs rgyas mi dmigs so/ /shin tu rnam par dag pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' mi dmigs so/ /shin tu rnam par dag pa'i phyir/ byang chub mi dmigs so/ /shin tu rnam par dag pa'i phyir/ sangs rgyas mi dmigs so/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das rnam par dag pa gang lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ chos thams cad ma skyes pa dang / 'byung ba med pa dang / dmigs pa med pa dang / mngon par 'du bya ba med pa 'di ni rnam par dag pa zhes bya ste/ shā ri'i bu de ltar na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos thams cad la mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis slob pa yin no zhes bya ba ni rnam par rtog pa dang ldan pa spyi'i dbang du byas nas bstan pa yin no / /①gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de ltar slob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos gang dang gang la slob pa lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' 6) pa/ shā ri'i bu de ltar slob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni chos gang la yang slob pa med do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ shā ri'i bu chos 'di dag ni/ byis pa so so'i skye bos ji ltar mngon par chags par bya ba de lta bu'i rnam pa yod pa ma yin no/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'o na chos 'di dag rnam pa ji ltar mchis pa lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' cad pa/ ji ltar med pa de ltar yod de/ de ltar yod pa ma yin pa de'i phyir med ces bya'o zhes ①bya ba ni drod du gtogs pa'i rnam par rtog pa dang ldan pa'i dang po ma rig pa'i rtog pa yin no / /①50—377

gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das ci'i slad du mchis pa ①ma lags pas ④ma mchis pa zhes bgyi/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ shā ri'i bu gzugs nang stong pa nyid dang / dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi bar gyi phyir yod pa ma yin no/ /tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed rnams dang / rnam par shes pa nang stong pa nyid dang / dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi bar gyi phyir yod pa ma yin no/ /byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos rnams kyi bar du nang stong pa nyid dang / dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid ①kyi bar gyi phyir yod pa ma yin no/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bco brgyad kyi bar du nang stong pa nyid dang / dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi bar gye phyir yod pa ma yin no zhes bya ba ni de nyid kyi rtog pa gnyis pa gzugs la sogs pa'i phung po la rtog pa yin no / /rjode la byis pa so so'i ⑤skye bo rnams dhini ma rig pa dang / sred pa la ⑦mngon par zhen to/ /de dag gis ni ma rig pa dang / sred pas brtags so/ /brtags nas ma rig pa dang / sred pa dag gis mngon par zhen te/ mtha' gnyis su chags pas de dag gis mtha' gnyis yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin mi shes mi mthong ngo / /de dag gis ⑧ji lta ba bzhin med pa'i chos de dag brtags nas ming dang gzugs la mngon par zhen pa nas/ sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams kyi bar la mngon par zhen par gyur to zhes bya ba ni de nyid kyi rtog pa gsum pa ming dang gzugs la mngon par zhen pa'i rtog pa yin no / /⑨chos rnams la mngon par zhen pa de dag ni med pa'i mtha' gnyis dag tu rtog par byed/ brtags nas mi shes mi mthong ngo / /ci zhig mi shes mi 50—378

mthong zhe na/ gzugs mi shes mi mthong ngo / /tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed rnams dang / rnam par shes pa mi shes mi mthong ba nas/skye mched dang / khams dang / rten cing 'byel par 'byung ba'i bar du mi shes mi mthong ngo / /byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun mi shes mi mthong ba nas/ sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams kyi bar du mi shes mi mthong ste/ de ltar de dag ni byis pa zhes bya ba'i grangs su 'gro'o zhes bya ba ni de nyid kyi rtog pa bzhi pa mtha' gnyis la chags pa'i rnam par rtog pa yin no / /①de dag ni ma rig pa dang / sred pa'i rkyen gyis mi shes mi mthong ngo /ci zhig mi shes mi mthong zhe na/ gzugs kun nas nyon mongs pa'o zhes mi shes mi mthong ngo / /de bzhin du gzugs rnam par byang ba'o zhes mi shes mi mthong ngo / /tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed rnams dang / rnam par shes pa kun nas nyon mongs pa'o zhes mi shes mi mthong ngo / /de bzhin du rnam par shes pa rnam par byang ba'o zhes mi shes mi mthong ngo / /de dag ni nges par mi ②'byung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /gang nas nges par mi 'byung zhe na/ 'dod pa'i khams nas nges par 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /gzugs kyi khams nas nges par 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /gzugs med pa'i khams nas nges par 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi chos dag las nges par 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro zhes bya ba ni de nyid kyi rtog pa lnga pa kun nas nyon mongs pa dang / rnam par byang ba skemi shes pa'i rnam par rtog pa yin no / /rjode dag ni sdemi dad do/ /ji ltar mi dad ce na/ gzugs gzugs kyis rjostong zhes bya bar mi dad do/ /byang chub kyi bar du byang chub kyis ⑦stong zhes bya 50—379

bar mi dad do/ /de dag ni gnas pa ma yin no/ /ji ltar gnas pa ma yin zhe na/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la gnas pa ma yin/ tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang / brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa la gnas pa ma yin/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la gnas pa ma yin/ phyir mi ldog pa'i sa la gnas pa ma yin/ sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams kyi bar la gnas pa ma yin no//de dag ni mngon par zhen pa yin no/ /ji ltar mngon par zhen pa yin zhe na/gzugs la mngon par zhen pa yin/ tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed rnams dang / rnam par shes pa la mngon par zhen pa yin/ mig la mngon par zhen pa yin/ rna ba dang / sna dang / lce dang / lus dang /yid la mngon par zhen pa yin no/ /skye mched dang / khams dang / rten cing 'byel par 'byung ba la mngon par zhen pa yin/ 'dod chags dang /zhe sdang dang / gti mug la mngon par zhen pa yin/ lta bar gyur pa rnams la mngon par zhen pa yin/ byang chub kyi bar la mngon par zhen pa yin te/de'i phyir na byis pa zhes bya'o/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de ltar slob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la mi slob cing rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du mi 'byung ba lags sam/bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsaX pa/ shā ri'i bu de ltar slob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la mi slob pa yin/rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du mi 'byung ba yin no/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das ci'i slad du zhe na①/ byang chub sems dpa' de shes rab kyi pha rol 50—380

tu phyin pa la mi slob pa lags/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du mi 'byung ba lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ shā ri'i bu 'di la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po thabs mi mkhas pas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la rtog par byed/ mngon par zhen par byed/ bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa la rtog par byed/ mngon par zhen par byed/ brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la rtog par byed/ mngon par zhen par byed/ bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la rtog par byed/ mngon par zhen par byed/ tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la rtog par byed/ mngon par zhen par byed/sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la rtog par byed/ mngon par zhen par byed/ de bzhin du bsam gtan dang / tshad med pa dang / gzugs med pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa la rtog par byed/ mngon par zhen par byed/ dran pa nye bar gzhag pa dang / yang dag par spong ba dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa dang /dbang po rnams dang / stobs rnams dang / byang chub kyi yan lag rnams dang / lam la rtog par byed/ mngon par zhen par byed/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu dang / mi 'jigs pa bzhi dang / so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bco brgyad la rtog par byed—/ mngon par zhen par byed pa nas/ chos thams cad dang / rnam pa thams cad mdon pa nyid kyi bar la rtog par byed/ mngon par zhen par byed do—/ /shā ri'i bu rnam grangs des na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la mi slob pa yin/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du mi 'byung ba yin no zhes bya ba ni de nyid kyi rtog pa drug pa 50—381

'phags pa'i lam la mi gnas pa'i rnam par rtog pa yin no / /①gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos ji ltar babe+ebs pas rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du nges par 'byung bar 'gyur ba'i shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la slob pa ji lta bu lags/bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ shā ri'i bu nam byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa de mi dmigs shing yang dag par rjes su mi mthong ba de ltar slob na—/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du nges par 'byung bar 'gyur/ de bzhin du bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang / tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang / rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi bar mi dmigs/ yang dag par rjes su mi mthong ba de ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la slob na/ mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du nges par 'byung bar 'gyur ro//shā ri'i bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa dang / de ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la slob pa n-i/mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du 'byung bar 'gyur ro zhes bya ba ni de nyid kyi rtog pa bdun pa ②dmigs pa la rtog pa yin no / /①shā ri'i bus gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das gang mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis ④rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du 'byung ba lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis 50—382

bka' stsal pa/ shā ri'i bu shin tu rnam par dag pa'i phyir bdag mi dmigs shing mi mthong ngo / /de bzhin du shin tu rnam par dag pa'i phyir/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi bar du mi dmigs shing mi mthong ngo zhes bya ba ①de nyid kyi rtog pa brgyad pa bdag la sogs par rtog pa yin no / /②shā ri'i bu rnam par dag pa ni skye ba med pa ma byung ba mngon par 'du byed pa med pa'o zhes bya ba ni de nyid kyi rtog pa dgu pa rnam par dag pa skye ba la sogs pa'i rnam par rtog pa yin no / /④'di dag ni gzung ba'i rtog pa dang po yin no / /rjode thabs mi mkhas pas gzugs la rtog cing mngon par zhen pa yin/rnam par shes pa'i bar la rtog cing mngon par zhen pa yin no zhes bya ba ni rtse mor gtogs pa'i rnam par rtog pa dang ldan pa dang po ⑤phung po'i don la rnam par rtog pa yin no / /dumig la rtog cing mngon par zhen pa yin/ de bzhin du yid kyi bar dang gzugs la mngon par ⑦rtog cing mngon par zhen pa yin/ de bzhin du chos kyi bar la rtog cing mngon par zhen pa yin zhes bya ba ni de nyid kyi rtog pa gnyis pa skye ba'i sgo'i don gyi rnam par rtog pa yin no / /⑧mig ⑨dang gzugs dang / mig gi rnam par shes pa'i khams su rtog cing mngon par zhen pa yin/ de bzhin du yid dang chos dang yid kyi rnam par shes pa'i khams kyi bar la rtog cing mngon par zhen pa yin zhes bya ba ni de nyid kyi rtog pa gsum pa rigs kyi don la rnam par rtog pa yin no / /⑩50—383

ma rig par rtog cing mngon par zhen pa yin/ de bzhin du rga shir rtog cing mngon par zhen pa yin zhes bya ba'i bar du'o zhes bya ba ni de nyid kyi rtog pa bzhi pa skye ba'i don la rnam par rtog pa yin no / /①de nang stong pa nyid dang / phyi stong pa nyid dang / phyi nang stong pa nyid dang ⑤/ dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi bar la rtog cing mngon par zhen pa yin zhes bya ba ni de nyid kyi rtog pa lnga pa stong pa nyid kyi don la rnam par rtog pa yin no / /①pha rol tu phyin pa drug la rtog cing mngon par zhen pa yin zhes bya ba ni de nyid kyi rtog pa drug pa pha rol tu phyin pa'i don la rnam par rtog pa yin no / /dubyang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun la rtog cing mngon par zhen pa yin zhes bya ba ni/ de nyid kyi rtog pa bdun pa mthong ba'i lam la rnam par rtog pa yin no / /rjode bsam gtan dang / mngon par shes pa rnams dang / tshad med pa rnams dang / gzugs med pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams la rtog cing /mngon par zhen pa yin zhes bya ba ni/ de nyid kyi rtog pa brgyad pa dhibasgom pa'i lam la rnam par rtog pa yin no / /⑦de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcur rtog cing mngon par zhen pa yin/rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi bar la rtog cing mngon par zhen pa yin zhes bya ba ni de nyid kyi rtog pa dgu pa mi slob pa'i lam la rtog pa yin no / /⑧'di dag ni gzung ba'i rtog pa gnyis pa yin no / /⑨50—384

shā ri'i bu bdag nye bar mi dmigs/ de bzhin du sems can dang /srog dang / gso ba dang / skyes bu dang / gang zag dang / shed las skyes dang / shed bu dang / byed pa po dang / rig pa po dang / shes pa po dang / mthong ba po mi dmigs so/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ shin tu rnam par dag pa'i phyir bdag med cing mi dmigs zhes bya ba ni bzod par gtogs pa'i rnam par rtog pa dang ldan pa las/ rtog pa dang po bdag rang dbang can la rnam par rtog pa'o / /①shā ri'i bu gzugs nye bar mi dmigs zhes bya ba nas/ rnam par shes pa'i bar du nye bar mi dmigs zhes bya ba ni de nyid kyi rtog pa gnyis pa bdag gcig pur rnam par rtog pa yin no/ /shā ri'i bu mig ②mi dmigs so/ /de bzhin du yid kyi bar dang /gzugs mi dmigs/ chos kyi bar du mi dmigs so zhes bya ba ni de nyid kyi rtog pa gsum pa rgyu'i bdag nyid la rnam par rtog pa yin no / /④shā ri'i bu mig dang / gzugs dang / mig gi rnam par shes pa mi dmigs so/ /yid dang chos dang yid kyi rnam par shes pa'i bar mi dmigs so zhes bya ba ni de nyid kyi rtog pa bzhi pa lta ba po la sogs pa'i bdag tu rnam par rtog pa yin no / /rjoshā ri'i bu rten cing 'byel par 'byung ba mi dmigs so/ /gzugs med pa'i khams kyi bar du mi dmigs so zhes bya ba ni de nyid kyi rtog pa lnga pa kun nas nyon mongs pa'i rten gyi bdag tu rnam par rtog pa yin no / /dhibasam gtan dang po mi dmigs so/ /gzugs med pa'i snyoms par 50—385

'jug pa'i bar du mi dmigs so zhes bya ba ni de nyid kyi rtog pa drug pa 'dod chags dang bral ba'i rten gyi bdag tu rnam par rtog pa yin no / /①'phags pa'i bden pa rnams mi dmigs so zhes bya ba ni de nyid kyi rtog pa bdun pa mthong ba'i rten gyi bdag tu rnam par rtog pa yin no / /①rnam par thar pa brgyad dang / mthar gyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu mi dmigs so zhes bya ba ni de nyid kyi rtog pa brgyad pa sgom pa'i rten gyi bdag tu rnam par rtog pa yin no / /①stobs bcu mi dmigs so/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi bar du mi dmigs so/ /ji ltar mi dmigs she na/ bdag nyid du'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ bdag shin tu rnam par dag pa'i phyir ro zhes bya ba ni de nyid kyi rtog pa dgu pa don byas pa'i rten byi rnam par rtog pa yin no/ /'di dag ni 'dzin pa'i rnam par rtog pa dang po yin no / /mede nas tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor kyis/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das la la zhig 'di skad du 'dri zhing ci sgyu ma'i skyes bu 'di shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la bslabs shing / rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du 'byung bar 'gyur ram/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid thob par 'gyur ram zhes mchi na/ bcom ldan 'das de skad du 'dri ba de la ji skad du bstan par bgyi/ ci sgyu ma'i skyes bu 'di bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang / tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa rjodang / sbyin pa'i pha 50—386

rol tu phyin pa la bslabs shing / rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du 'byung bar 'gyur ram/ sgyu ma'i skyes bu 'di byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos rnams kyi bar la bslabs shing / rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du 'byung bar 'gyur ram/sgyu ma'i skyes bu 'di sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams kyi bar la bslabs shing /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du 'byung bar 'gyur ram/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid thob par 'gyur ram zhes mchi na/ bcom ldan 'das de skad du 'dri ba de la ji skad du bstan par bgyi/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de lta bas na de khyod nyid la dris/ khyod kyis ji ltar bzod pa de ltar lung ston cig /ces bya ba ni 'dzin pa'i rtog pa gnyis pa phyir bstan pa yin no / /①rab 'byor de ji snyam du sems/ gzugs kyang gzhan la/sgyu ma'ang gzhan zhig yin snyam mam/ tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed rnams dang / rnam par shes pa yang gzhan la sgyu ma yang gzhan zhig yin snyam mam/gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de lta ②ma lags so zhes bya ba ni chos kyi mchog tu gtogs pa'i rnam par rtog pa dang ldan pa rtog pa dang po yin no / /④bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de ji snyam du sems/mig kyang gzhan la sgyu ma yang gzhan zhig yin snyam mam/ rna ba dang / sna dang / lce dang / lus dang / yid kyang gzhan la sgyu ma yang gzhan zhig yin snyam mam/ gzugs kyang gzhan la sgyu ma yang gzhan zhig yin snyam mam/sgra dang / dri dang / ro dang / reg dang / chos kyang gzhan la sgyu ma yang gzhan zhig yin snyam mam/ rab 'byor gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de ni ma lags so zhes bya ba ni de nyid kyi rtog pa gnyis pa skye mched du btags pa la 50—387

rnam par rtog pa yin no / /①bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' zad pa/ rab 'byor de ji snyam du sems/mig dang / gzugs dang / mig gi rnam par shes pa yang gzhan la sgyu ma yang gzhan zhig yin snyam mam/ rna ba dang / sgra dang / rna ba'i rnam par shes pa dang / sna dang / dri dang / sna'i rnam par shes pa dang / lce dang /ro dang / lce'i rnam par shes pa dang / lus dang / reg bya dang / lus kyi rnam par shes pa ①dang / yid dang / chos dang / yid kyi rnam par shes pa yang gzhan la sgyu ma yang gzhan zhig yin snyam mam/ rab 'byor gyes gsol pa—/ bcom ldan 'das de ni ma lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' zad pa/ rab 'byor de ji snyam du sems/ mig gi 'dus te reg pa yang gzhan la sgyu ma yang gzhan zhig yin snyam mam/ rna ba'i 'dus ste reg pa dang /sna'i 'dus te reg pa dang / lce'i 'dus te reg pa dang / lus kyi 'dus te reg pa dang / yid kyi 'dus te reg pa yang gzhan la sgyu ma yang gzhan zhig yin snyam mam/ rab 'byor gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de ni ma lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de ji snyam du sems—/ mig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen gyis tshor ba yang gzhan la sgyu ma yang gzhan zhig yin snyam mam/ rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen gyis tshor ba dang /sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen gyis tshor ba dang / lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen gyis tshor ba dang / lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen gyis tshor ba dang / yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen gyis tshor ba yang gzhan la sgyu ma yang gzhan zhig yin snyam mam/ gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de ni ma lags so/ /bcom ldan 50—388

'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de ji snyam du sems/ sa'i khams kyang gzhan la sgyu ma yang gzhan zhig yin snyam mam/ rab 'byor gyis gsol pa/bcom ldan 'das sa'i khams kyang gzhan ma lags/ sgyu ma yang gzhan ma lags te—/ sa'i khams nyid kyang sgyu ma/ sgyu ma nyid kyang sa'i khams so/ /bcom ldan 'das chu'i khams kyang gzhan ma lags/ sgyu ma yang gzhan ma lags te/chu'i khams nyid kyang sgyu ma/ sgyu ma nyid kyang chu'i khams so/ /bcom ldan 'das me'i khams kyang gzhan ma lags/ sgyu ma yang gzhan ma lags te/me'i khams nyid kyang sgyu ma/ sgyu ma nyid kyang me'i khams so/ /bcom ldan 'das rlung gi khams ①kyang gzhan ma lags/ sgyu ma yang gzhan ma lags te/rlung gi khams nyid kyang sgyu ma/ sgyu ma nyid kyang rlung gi khams so/ /bcom ldan 'das nam mkha'i khams kyang gzhan ma lags/ sgyu ma yang gzhan ma lags te / nam mkha'i khams nyid kyang sgyu ma/ sgyu ma nyid kyang nam mkha'i khams so//bcom ldan 'das rnam par shes pa'i khams kyang gzhan ma lags/ sgyu ma yang gzhan ma lags te/ rnam par shes pa'i khams nyid kyang sgyu ma/ sgyu ma nyid kyang rnam par shes pa'i khams so zhes bya ba ni de ②nyid kyi rtog pa gsum pa khams su btags pa la rnam par rtog pa yin no / /skebacom ldan 'das kyis bka' zad pa/ rab 'byor de ji snyam du sems/sgyu ma yang gzhan la rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba yang gzhan zhig yin snyam mam/rab 'byor gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das ma rig pa yang gzhan ma lags/sgyu ma yang gzhan ma lags te/ ma rig pa nyid kyang sgyu ma/ sgyu ma nyid kyang ma rig pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das 'du byed kyang gzhan la sgyu ma yang gzhan ma 50—389

lags te/ 'du byed nyid kyang sgyu ma/ sgyu ma nyid kyang 'du byed do/ /bcom ldan 'das rnam par shes pa yang gzhan la/ sgyu ma yang gzhan ma lags te/rnam par shes pa nyid kyang sgyu ma/ sgyu ma nyid kyang rnam par shes pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das ming dang gzugs kyang gzhan la sgyu ma yang gzhan ma lags te/ming dang gzugs nyid kyang sgyu ma/ sgyu ma nyid kyang ming dang gzugs so/ /bcom ldan 'das skye mched drug kyang gzhan la sgyu ma yang gzhan ma lags te/skye mched drug nyid kyang sgyu ma/ sgyu ma nyid kyang skye mched drug go/ /bcom ldan 'das reg pa yang gzhan la ①sgyu ma yang gzhan ma lags te/ reg pa nyid kyang sgyu ma/ sgyu ma nyid kyang reg pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das tshor ba yang gzhan la sgyu ma yang gzhan ma lags te/ tshor ba nyid kyang sgyu ma/ sgyu ma nyid kyang tshor ba'o/ /bcom ldan 'das sred pa yang gzhan la sgyu ma yang gzhan ma lags te—/ sred pa nyid kyang sgyu ma/ sgyu ma nyid kyang sred pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das len pa yang gzhan la sgyu ma yang gzhan ma lags te/ len pa nyid kyang sgyu ma/sgyu ma nyid kyang len pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das srid pa yang gzhan la sgyu ma yang gzhan ma lags te/ srid pa nyid kyang sgyu ma/ sgyu ma nyid kyang srid pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das skye ba yang gzhan la sgyu ma yang gzhan ma lags te/ skye ba nyid kyang sgyu ma/ sgyu ma nyid kyang skye ba'o/ bcom ldan 'das rga shi yang gzhan la sgyu ma yang gzhan ma lags te/ rga shi nyid kyang sgyu ma/ sgyu ma nyid kyang rga shi'o ②zhes bya ba ni/ de nyid kyi rtog pa bzhi pa rten cing 'byel par 'byung ba btags pa la rnam par rtog pa yin no / /④bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de ji snyam du sems/50—390

byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos rnams kyi bar yang gzhan la sgyu ma yang gzhan zhig yin snyam mam/ gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de lta ma lags so zhes bya ba ni de nyid kyi rtog pa lnga pa rnam par byang bar btags pa la rnam par rtog pa yin no / /①bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' 6) pa/ rab 'byor de ji snyam du sems/stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma med pa dang / smon pa med pa yang gzhan la sgyu ma yang gzhan zhig yin snyam mam/ rab 'byor gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma med pa dang / smon pa med pa yang gzhan la/ sgyu ma yang gzhan ma lags so zhes bya ba ni de nyid kyi rtog pa drug pa mthong ba'i lam du btags pa la rnam par rtog pa yin no / /②bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' zad pa/ rab 'byor de ji snyam du sems/bsam gtan dang / gzugs med pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa yang gzhan la/sgyu ma yang gzhan zhig yin snyam mam/ rab 'byor gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de lta ma lags so zhes bya ba ni de nyid kyi rtog pa bdun pa bsgom ①pa'i lam du btags pa la rnam par rtog pa yin no / /dubacom ldan 'das kyis bka' pa pa/ rab 'byor de ji snyam du sems/stong pa nyid thams cad kyang gzhan la/ sgyu ma yang gzhan zhig yin snyam mam/rab 'byor gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de ni ma lags so zhes bya ba ni de nyid kyi rtog pa brgyad pa khyad par gyi lam du btags pa la rnam par rtog pa yin no / /⑤bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' pa pa/ rab 'byor de ji snyam du sems/de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bco 50—391

brgyad kyi bar yang gzhan la sgyu ma yang gzhan zhig yin ①snyam mam/ gsol pa/bcom ldan 'das de ni ma lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/rab 'byor de ji snyam du sems/ byang chub kyang gzhan la sgyu ma yang gzhan zhig yin snyam mam/ gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de lta ma lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das gzugs kyang gzhan ma lags/ sgyu ma yang gzhan ma lags te/gzugs nyid kyang sgyu ma/ sgyu ma nyid kyang gzugs so/ /bcom ldan 'das tshor ba yang gzhan ma lags/ sgyu ma yang gzhan ma lags te/ tshor ba nyid kyang sgyu ma/ sgyu ma nyid kyang tshor ba'o/ /bcom ldan 'das 'du shes kyang gzhan ma lags/ sgyu ma yang gzhan ma lags te/ 'du shes nyid kyang sgyu ma/sgyu ma nyid kyang 'du shes so/ /bcom ldan 'das 'du byed rnams kyang gzhan ma lags/ sgyu ma yang gzhan ma lags te/ 'du byed rnams nyid kyang sgyu ma/sgyu ma nyid kyang 'du byed rnams so/ /bcom ldan 'das rnam par shes pa yang gzhan ma lags/ sgyu ma yang gzhan ma lags te/ rnam par shes pa nyid kyang sgyu ma/ sgyu ma nyid kyang rnam par shes pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das mig kyang gzhan ma lags/ sgyu ma yang gzhan ma lags/ bcom ldan 'das gzugs kyang gzhan ma lags/ sgyu ma yang gzhan ma lags/ bcom ldan 'das mig gi rnam par shes pa yang gzhan ma lags/ sgyu ma yang gzhan ma lags/bcom ldan 'das mig gi 'dus te reg pa yang gzhan ma lags/ sgyu ma yang gzhan ma lags/ bcom ldan 'das mig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen gyes skyes pa'i tshor ba bde ba'am/ sdug bsngal ba'am/ bde ba yang ma yin/ sdug bsngal ba yang ma yin pa yang gzhan ma lags/ sgyu ma yang gzhan ma lags/50—392

bcom ldan 'das rna ba dang / sna dang / lce dang / lus kyang gzhan ma lags| sgyu ma yang gzhan ma lags/ bcom ldan 'das yid kyang gzhan ma lags—/ sgyu ma yang gzhan ma lags/ bcom ldan 'das chos kyang gzhan ma lags—/ sgyu ma yang gzhan ma lags/ bcom ldan 'das yid kyi rnam par shes pa yang gzhan ma lags/ sgyu ma yang gzhan ma lags/ bcom ldan 'das yid kyi 'dus te reg pa yang gzhan ma lags/ sgyu ma yang gzhan ma lags / bcom ldan 'das yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen gyis skyes pa'i tshor ba bde ba'am/ sdug bsngal ba'am/ bde ba yang ma yin/ sdug bsngal ba yang ma yin pa yang gzhan ma lags/ sgyu ma yang gzhan ma lags/ bcom ldan 'das byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos rnams kyang gzhan ma lags/ sgyu ma yang gzhan ma lags te/ bcom ldan 'das byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos rnams nyid sgyu ma/ sgyu ma nyid kyang ①byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos rnams so/ /bcom ldan 'das sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bco brgyad kyang gzhan ma lags/ sgyu ma yang gzhan ma lags te/ sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bco brgyad nyid sgyu ma/sgyu ma nyid kyang snesangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bco brgyad do/ /bcom ldan 'das byang chub kyang gzhan ma lags/ sgyu ma yang gzhan ma lags te/ byang chub nyid kyang sgyu ma/ sgyu ma nyid kyang byang chub bo/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de ji snyam du sems/ ci sgyu ma la skye ba'am/'gag pa yod dam/ gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de ni ma mchis so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de ji snyam du sems/ sgyu ma la kun nas nyon mongs pa'am/ rnam par byang ba yod dam/ gsol pa/50—393

bcom ldan 'das de ni ma lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' byed pa/rab 'byor de ji snyam du sems/ gang la skye ba med cing 'gag pa med pa dang /kun nas nyon mongs pa med cing rnam par byang ba med pa de/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la slob par 'gyur ram/ bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang /brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang /tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la slob par 'gyur ram/ tshad med pa dang / bsam gtan dang / gzugs med pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa la slob par 'gyur ram/ byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun dang / mngon par shes pa dang / stobs bcu dang / mi 'jigs pa bzhi dang / so so yang dag par rig pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa la slob par 'gyur ram/ thams cad shes pa nyid du 'byung bar 'gyur ram/ lam byi rnam pa shes pa nyid dang ①/ rnam pa thams cad mdon pa nyid thob par 'gyur ram/ gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de ni mi 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' byed pa/ rab 'byor de ji snyam du sems—/ nye bar len pa'i phung po lnga po 'di dag la 'di lta ste/ byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya bar 'du shes pa dang / kun shes pa dang / gdags pa dang / tha snyad du bya ba yin nam/ gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de lta ma lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' byed pa/ rab 'byor de ji snyam du sems/ 'du shes pa dang / kun shes pa dang / gdags pa dang /tha snyad tsam gyis ④nye bar len pa'i phung po lnga po skye ba'am/ 'gag pa'am/kun nas nyon mongs pa'am/ rnam par byang ba dmigs par 'gyur ram/50—394

gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de ni mi 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de ji snyam du sems/ gang la 'du shes med cing kun shes pa med pa dang / gdags pa med pa dang / tha snyad med pa dang /ming med pa dang / ming du gdags pa med pa dang / lus med pa dang /lus kyi las med pa dang / ngag med pa dang / ngag gi las med pa dang /yid med pa dang / yid kyi las med pa dang / skye ba med pa dang / 'gag pa med pa dang / kun nas nyon mongs pa med pa dang / rnam par byang ba med pa de/ ci shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la bslabs shing / rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du 'byung bar 'gyur ram/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid thob par 'gyur ram/ gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de ni mi 'gyur ro—/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la bslabs shing /mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du nges par 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de ltar lags na shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la slob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos sgyu ma'i skyes bus bslabs pa ltar bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu bslab par bgyi'o/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ bcom ldan 'das 'di nyid sgyu ma'i skyes bur rig par bgyi ste/ 'di lta ste nye bar len pa'i phung po lnga ①rnams so—/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de ji snyam du sems/ci phung po lnga po 'di dag shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la bslabs shing rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du 'byung bar 'gyur ram/ gsol pa/ bcom ldan 50—395

'das de ni mi 'gyur ro/ /de ci'i be+ed du zhe na/ bcom ldan 'das 'di ltar nye bar len pa'i phung po lnga po rnams ni dngos po ma mchis pa'i rang bzhin no/ /de bzhin du phung po lnga ni rmi lam lta bu'o/ /rmi lam yang dngos po med pa'i rang bzhin lags te/ dmigs su ma mchis so/ /de bzhin du phung po lnga po dngos po med pa'i rang bzhin rmis dmigs su ma mchis so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de ji snyam du sems/ sgra brnyan lta bu dang /mig yor lta bu dang / sprul pa lta bu dang / gzugs brnyan lta bu'i phung po lnga po de dag shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la bslabs shing rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du 'byung bar 'gyur ram/ gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de ni mi 'gyur ro/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ bcom ldan 'das 'di ltar mi lam ni dngos po ma mchis pa'i rang bzhin te/ sgra brnyan ni dngos po ma mchis pa'i rang bzhin no/ /de bzhin du mig yor dang / sprul pa dang / gzugs brnyan ni dngos po ma mchis pa'i rang bzhin te/ dmigs su ma mchis so/ /de bzhin du phung po lnga po ni dngos po med pa'i rang bzhin gyis na dmigs su ma mchis so/ /bcom ldan 'das 'di ltar gzugs ni sgyu ma lta bu'o/ /tshor ba ni sgyu ma lta bu'o/ /'du shes ni sgyu ma lta bu'o/ /'du byed rnams ni sgyu ma lta bu'o / /rnam par shes pa ni sgyu ma lta bu'o/ /rnam par shes pa gang yin pa de yang dbang po drug dang phung po lnga'o/ /de dag kyang nang stong pa nyid kyis mi dmigs so/ /phyi stong pa nyid kyis mi dmigs pa nas/ dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi bar kyis mi dmigs so/ /bcom ldan 'das gal te de skad du bshad pa dang ①/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gang 50—396

zhig mi zhum/ kun tu mi zhum/ 'gyod par mi 'gyur/ mi dngang / kun tu mi skrag /kun tu skrag pas zin par mi 'gyur na/ bcom ldan 'das de ni thams cad shes pa nyid du nges par 'byung bar 'gyur/ lam shes pa nyid du nges par 'byung bar 'gyur te/ rnam pa thams cad mdon pa nyid du rjes su thob ①par 'gyur bar rig par bya'o zhes bya ba ni dgu pa mi slob pa'i lam du btags pa'i rnam par rtog pa ste 'dzin rtog gnyis pa'o / /⑧de nas tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor gyis/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po theg pa la gsar du zhugs pas bstan pa 'di thos nas zhum zhing kun tu zhum la 'gyod de/ dngang ba dang / kun tu skrag pa dang / kun tu skrag pas zin par mi 'gyur lags sam/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ shā ri'i bu gal te byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po theg pa la gsar du zhugs pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa na/ thabs mi mkhas pa dang /dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi lag tu song bar ma gyur na ni dngang zhing kun tu skrag la ①skrag pas zin par 'gyur ro/ /rab 'byor gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das gang la spyod pas mi dngang / kun tu mi skrag / kun tu skrag rjopas zin par mi 'gyur ba shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i thabs mkhas pa de gang lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsaX pa/ rab 'byor 'di la byang —chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos ⑤shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams 50—397

cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i sems kyis gzugs mi rtag ces bya bar so sor rtog kyang de mi dmigs so/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i sems kyis tshor ba mi rtag ces bya bar so sor rtog kyang de mi dmigs so/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i sems kyis 'du shes mi rtag ces bya bar so sor rtog kyang de mi dmigs so/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i sems kyis 'du byed rnams mi rtag ces bya bar so sor rtog kyang de mi dmigs so/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i sems kyis rnam par shes pa mi rtag ces bya bar so sor rtog kyang de mi dmigs so/ /rab 'byor de ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i thabs mkhas par rig par bya'o/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i sems kyis/ gzugs sdug bsngal zhes bya bar so sor ①rtog kyang de mi dmigs so/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i sems kyis tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed rnams dang / rnam par shes pa sdug bsngal zhes bya bar so sor rtog kyang de mi dmigs so/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i sems kyis gzugs stong zhes bya bar rtog /gzugs bdag med ces bya ba dang / gzugs zhi zhes bya ba dang / gzugs dben zhes bya ba dang / gzugs stong ⑤zhes bya ba dang / gzugs mtshan ma med ces bya ba dang / gzugs smon pa med ces bya bar so sor rtog kyang de mi dmigs so/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i sems kyis tshor ba dang / 'du 50—398

shes dang / 'du byed rnams dang / rnam par shes pa stong zhes bya bar so sor rtog kyang de mi dmigs so/ /rnam par shes pa bdag med ces bya ba dang /rnam par shes pa zhi zhes bya ba dang / rnam par shes pa dben zhes bya ba dang /rnam par shes pa stong zhes bya ba dang / rnam par shes pa mtshan ma med ces bya ba dang / rnam par shes pa smon pa med ces bya bar so sor rtog kyang de ①dmigs so/ /rab 'byor de ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i sems kyis ②shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i thabs mkhas pa yin par rig par ①bya'o/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la byed pas mi dmigs pa'i tshul du chos ston pa gang yin pa 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la byed pa can de dag nyid kyi mchog tu 'dzin pa med pa nyid gang yin pa 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la byed pa can de dag nyid kyi bzod pa dang / 'dod pa dang so sor rtog pa gang yin pa 'di ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la byed pa can de dag nyid kyi de mi 'dor ba gang yin pa 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o—/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la byed pa can de 50—399

dag nyid kyi nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang ldan pa'i yid la byed pa'am/mi dge ba'i chos gzhan gyis ①skabs mi 'byed pa gang yin pa 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa ste/ rab 'byor de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ mi dngang / kun tu mi skrag /kun tu skrag pas zin par mi 'gyur ro// //bam po bcu gnyis pa/ rab 'byor gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas rnam pa 'di ltar rab tu rtog ste/ gzugs kyi stong pa nyid kyis gzugs stong pa ma yin gyi/ gzugs nyid stong pa nyid do/ /stong pa nyid nyid gzugs so/ /tshor ba'i stong pa nyid kyis tshor ba stong pa ma yin gyi/ tshor ba nyid stong pa nyid/ stong pa nyid nyid tshor ba'o/ /'du shes kyi stong pa nyid kyis 'du shes stong pa ma yin kyi/ 'du shes nyid stong pa nyid/ stong pa nyid nyid 'du shes so/ /'du byed rnams kyi stong pa nyid kyis 'du byed rnams stong pa ma yin gyi/ 'du byed rnams nyid stong pa nyid/ stong pa nyid nyid 'du byed rnams so/ /rnam par shes pa'i stong pa nyid kyis rnam par shes pa stong pa ma yin gyi/ rnam par shes pa nyid stong pa nyid de①/ stong pa nyid nyid rnam par shes pa'o/ /mig gi stong pa nyid kyis mig stong pa ma yin gyi/ mig nyid stong pa nyid①/ stong pa nyid nyid mig go/ /rna ba'i stong pa nyid kyis rna ba stong pa ma yin byi/ rna ba nyid stong pa nyid/ stong pa nyid nyid rna ba'o/ /sna'i stong pa nyid kyis sna stong pa ma yin gyi/ sna nyid 50—400

stong pa nyid/ stong pa nyid nyid sna'o/ /lce'i stong pa nyid kyis lce stong pa ma yin gyi/ lce nyid stong pa nyid/ stong pa nyid nyid lce'o/ /lus kyi ① stong pa nyid kyis lus stong pa ma yin gyi/ lus nyid stong pa nyid/ stong pa nyid nyid lus so/ /yid kyi stong pa nyid kyis yid stong pa ma yin gyi/ yid nyid stong pa nyid—/ stong pa nyid nyid yid do/ /gzugs kyi stong pa nyid kyis gzugs stong pa ma yin gyi/ gzugs nyid stong pa nyid/ stong pa nyid nyid gzugs so//sgra'i stong pa nyid kyis sgra stong pa ma yin gyi/ sgra nyid stong pa nyid/ stong pa nyid nyid sgra'o/ /dri'i stong pa nyid kyis dri stong pa ma yin gyi/ dri nyid stong pa nyidarka/ stong pa nyid nyid dri'o/ /ro'i stong pa nyid kyis ro stong pa ma yin gyi/ro nyid stong pa nyid/ stong pa nyid nyid ro'o/ /reg gi stong pa nyid kyis reg stong pa ma yin gyi/ reg nyid stong pa nyid/ stong pa nyid nyid reg go/ /chos kyi stong pa nyid kyis chos stong pa ma yin kyi/ chos nyid stong pa nyid/stong pa nyid nyid chos so/ /mig gi rnam par shes pa'i stong pa nyid kyis mig gi rnam par shes pa stong pa ma yin gyi/ mig gi rnam par shes pa nyid stong pa nyid/stong pa nyid nyid mig gi rnam par shes pa'o/ /rna ba'i rnam par shes pa'i stong pa nyid kyis rna ba'i rnam par shes pa stong pa ma yin gyi/ rna ba'i rnam par shes pa nyid stong pa nyid/ stong pa nyid nyid rna ba'i rnam par shes pa'o/ /sna'i rnam par shes pa'i stong pa nyid kyis sna'i rnam par shes pa stong pa ma yin gyi/sna'i rnam par shes pa nyid stong pa nyid/ stong pa nyid nyid sna'i rnam par shes pa'o—/ /lce'i rnam par shes pa'i khrustong pa nyid kyis lce'i rnam par shes pa stong pa ma yin gyi/ lce'i rnam par shes pa nyid stong pa nyid/ stong pa nyid nyid 50—401

lce'i rnam par shes pa'o/ /lus kyi rnam par shes pa'i stong pa nyid kyis lus kyi rnam par shes pa stong pa ma yin gyi/ lus kyi rnam par shes pa nyid stong pa nyid/stong pa nyid nyid lus kyi rnam par shes pa'o/ /yid kyi rnam par shes pa'i stong pa nyid kyis yid kyi rnam par shes pa stong pa ma yin gyi/ yid kyi rnam par shes pa nyid stong pa nyid/ stong pa nyid nyid yid kyi rnam par shes pa'o/ /mig gi 'dus te reg pa'i stong pa nyid kyis mig gi 'dus te reg pa stong pa ma yin byi/mig gi 'dus te reg pa nyid stong pa nyid/ stong pa nyid nyid mig gi 'dus te reg pa'o/ /rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i stong pa nyid kyis rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa stong pa ma yin gyi/ rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa nyid stong pa nyid/ stong pa nyid nyid rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'o/ /sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i stong pa nyid kyis sna'i 'dus te reg pa ①stong pa ma yin gyi/ sna'i 'dus te reg pa nyid stong pa nyid—/ stong pa nyid nyid sna'i 'dus te reg pa'o/ /lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i stong pa nyid kyis lce'i 'dus te reg pa stong pa ma yin gyi/ lce'i 'dus te reg pa nyid stong pa nyid/ stong pa nyid nyid lce'i 'dus te reg pa'o/ /lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i stong pa nyid kyis lus kyi 'dus te reg pa stong pa ma yin gyi/lus kyi 'dus te reg pa nyid stong pa nyid/ stong pa nyid nyid lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'o/ /yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i stong pa nyid kyis yid kyi 'dus te reg pa stong pa ma yin gyi/ yid kyi 'dus te reg pa nyid stong pa nyid/ stong pa nyid nyid yid kyi ②'dus te reg pa'o/ /mig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen gyis tshor ba'i stong pa nyid kyis mig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba stong pa ①ma yin gyi/ mig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen gyis tshor ba dhistong pa nyid/ stong pa 50—402

nyid nyid mig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen gyis tshor ba'o/ /rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen gyis tshor ba'i stong pa nyid kyis rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen gyis tshor ba stong pa ma yin gyi/ rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba nyid stong pa nyid—/ stong pa nyid nyid rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen gyis tshor ba'o/ /sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen gyis tshor ba'i stong pa nyid kyis sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen byis tshor ba stong pa ma yin gyi/ sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen gyis tshor ba nyid stong pa nyid/ stong pa nyid nyid sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen gyis tshor ba'o—/ /lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba'i stong pa nyid kyis lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen gyis tshor ba stong pa ma yin gyi/ lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen gyis tshor ba nyid stong pa nyid/ stong pa nyid nyid lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen gyis tshor ba'o/ /lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen gyis tshor ba'i stong pa nyid kyis lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen gyis tshor ba stong pa ma yin gyi/ lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen gyis tshor ba nyid stong pa nyid/ stong pa nyid nyid lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen gyis tshor ba'o/ /yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen gyis tshor ba'i stong pa nyid kyis yid kyi ①'dus te reg pa'i rkyen gyis tshor ba stong pa ma yin gyi/ yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen gyis tshor ba nyid stong pa nyid/ stong pa nyid nyid yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen gyis tshor ba'o/ /dran pa nye bar gzhag pa'i bar gyi stong pa nyid kyis dran pa nye bar gzhag pa stong pa ma yin gyi/dran pa nye bar gzhag ②pa nyid stong pa nyid/ stong pa nyid nyid dran pa nye bar gzhag pa'o/ /yang dag par spong ba dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa dang /dbang po dang / stobs rnams kyang de bzhin te/ sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 50—403

'dres pa'i bar gyi stong pa nyid kyis sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa stong pa ma yin gyi/ sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa nyid stong pa nyid/ stong pa nyid nyid sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa'o/ /rab 'byor 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ste/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa ni/skrag par mi 'gyur/ kun tu skrag par mi 'gyur/ kun tu skrag pa dang ldan par mi 'gyur ro zhes bya ba ni yongs su 'dzin pa dang po thabs la mkhas pas yongs su zin pa yin no / /①rab 'byor gyes gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das gang dag gis yongs su bzung bas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di bstan pa thos nas mi dngang /kun tu mi skrag /kun tu skrag pa dang ldan par mi 'gyur ba byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen gang lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' pa pa/ rab 'byor 'di la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen ni gang de la gzugs mi rtag ces bya bar de mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis chos ston cing / dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag thams cad kyang rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid ma gtogs par nyan thos kyi sa 'am/rang sangs rgyas kyi sar yongs su bsngor mi 'jug pa dang / tshor ba dang /'du shes dang / 'du byed rnams dang / rnam par shes pa mi rtag ces bya bar de mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis chos ston cing / dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag thams cad kyang rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid ma gtogs par nyan thos kyi sa 'am/50—404
