rang sangs rgyas kyi sar yongs su bsngor mi 'jug pa ste/ rab 'byor 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen du rig par bya'o—/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen ni/ gang de la gzugs sdug bsngal zhes bya bar de mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis chos ston pa dang / gzugs bdag med ces bya ba dang /zhi zhes bya ba dang / dbe+en zhes bya ba dang / stong zhes bya ba dang / mtshan ma med ces bya ba dang / smon pa med ces bya bar de mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis chos ston cing / dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag thams cad kyang rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid ma gtogs par nyan thos kyi sa 'am/ rang sangs rgyas kyi sar yongs su bsngor mi 'jug pa dang / gang de la tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang /'du byed rnams dang / rnam par shes pa sdug bsngal zhes bya bar de mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis chos ston pa dang / rnam par shes pa bdag med ces bya ba dang /zhi zhes bya ba dang / dben zhes bya ba dang / stong zhes bya ba dang / mtshan ma med ces bya ba dang / smon pa med ces bya bar de mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis chos ston cing dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag thams cad kyang rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid ma gtogs par nyan thos kyi sa 'am/ rang sangs rgyas kyi sar yongs su bsngor mi 'jug pa ste/ rab 'byor 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen du rig par bya'o/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen ni gang de la mig mi rtag ces bya bar de mi dmigs pa'i tshul kyis chos ston pa dang /sdug bsngal zhes bya ba dang / bdag med ces bya ba dang / zhi zhes bya ba dang /50—405

dbe+en zhes bya ba dang / stong zhes bya ba dang / mtshan ma med ces bya ba dang /smon pa med ces bya bar de mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis chos ston cing dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag thams cad kyang rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid ma gtogs par nyan thos kyi sa 'am/ rang sangs rgyas kyi sar yongs su ①bsngor mi 'jug pa dang /gang de la rna ba dang / sna dang / lce dang / lus dang / yid mi rtag ces bya ba dang / sbug bsngal zhes bya ba dang / bdag med ces bya ba dang / zhi zhes bya ba dang / dngen zhes bya ba dang / stong zhes bya ba dang / mtshan ma med ces bya ba dang / smon pa med ces bya bar de mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis chos ston cing dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag thams cad kyang rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid ma gtogs par nyan thos kyi sa 'am/ rang ④sangs rgyas kyi sar yongs su bsngor mi 'jug pa ste/ rab 'byor 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen du rig par bya'o/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen ni gang de gzugs mi rtag ces bya bar de mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis chos ston pa dang /sdug bsngal zhes bya ba dang / bdag med ces bya ba dang / zhi zhes bya ba dang /dbe+en zhes bya ba dang / stong zhes bya ba dang / mtshan ma med ces bya ba dang /smon pa med ces bya bar de mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis chos ston cing dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag thams cad kyang rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid ma gtogs par nyan thos kyi sa 'am/ rang sangs rgyas kyi sar yongs su bsngor mi 'jug pa dang /sgra dang / dri dang / ro dang / reg dang / chos mi rtag ces bya bar de mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis chos ston pa dang / sdug bsngal zhes bya ba dang /50—406

bdag med ces bya ba dang / zhi zhes bya ba dang / dben zhes bya ba dang /stong zhes bya ba dang / mtshan ma med ces bya ba dang / smon pa med ces bya bar de mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis chos ston cing / dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag thams cad kyang rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid ma gtogs par nyan thos kyi sa 'am/rang sangs rgyas kyi sar yongs su bsngor mi 'jug pa ste/ rab 'byor 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen du rig par bya'o—/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen ni gang de la mig gi rnam par shes pa dang / mig gi 'dus te reg pa dang / mig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen gyis tshor ba mi rtag ces bya bar de mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis chos ston pa dang / sdug bsngal zhes bya ba dang / bdag med ces bya ba dang / zhi zhes bya ba dang / dben zhes bya ba dang / stong zhes bya ba dang / mtshan ma med ces bya ba dang / smon pa med ces bya bar de mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis chos ston cing / dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag thams cad dang ①rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid ma gtogs par nyan thos kyi sa 'am/ rang sangs rgyas kyi sar yongs su bsngor mi 'jug pa dang /rna ba'i rnam par shes pa dang / rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa dang / rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen gyis tshor ba dang / sna'i rnam par shes pa dang /sna'i 'dus te reg pa dang / sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba dang /lce'i rnam par shes pa dang / lce'i 'dus te reg pa dang / lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen gyis tshor ba dang / lus kyi rnam par shes pa dang / lus kyi 'dus te reg pa dang / lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba dang /50—407

yid kyi rnam par shes pa dang / yid kyi 'dus te reg pa dang / yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen gyis tshor ba mi rtag ces bya bar de mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis chos ston pa dang / sdug bsngal zhes bya ba dang / bdag med ces bya ba dang / zhi zhes bya ba dang / dbe+en zhes bya ba dang / stong zhes bya ba dang /mtshan ma med ces bya ba dang / smon pa med ces bya bar de mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyes chos ston cing / dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag thams cad kyang rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid ma gtogs par nyan thos kyi sa 'am/ rang sangs rgyas kyi sar yongs su bsngor mi 'jug pa ste/ rab 'byor 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen du rig par bya'o/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen ni gang de la byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos rnams kyi bar du mi rtag ces bya bar de nyumi dmigs pa'i tshul byis chos ston pa dang / sdug bsngal zhes bya ba dang / bdag med ces bya ba dang / zhi zhes bya ba dang / dbe+en zhes bya ba dang / stong zhes bya ba dang / mtshan ma med ces bya ba dang / smon pa med ces bya bar de mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis chos ston cing / dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag thams cad kyang rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid ma gtogs par nyan thos kyi sa 'am/ rang sangs rgyas kyi sar yongs su bsngor mi 'jug pa dang / yang dag par spong ba dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa dang / dbang po dang /stobs dang / byang chub kyi yan lag dang / 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa mi rtag ces bya bar de mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis chos ston pa dang /sdug bsngal zhes bya ba dang / bdag med ces bya ba dang / zhi zhes bya ba dang /50—408

dbe+en zhes bya ba dang / stong zhes bya ba dang / mtshan ma med ces bya ba dang /smon pa med ces bya bar de mi dmigs pa'i tshul kyis chos ston cing dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag thams cad kyang rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid ma gtogs par nyan thos kyi sa 'am/ rang sangs rgyas kyi sar yongs su bsngor mi 'jug pa dang /bsam gtan dang / tshad med pa dang / gzugs med pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dang / mngon par shes pa rnams mi rtag ces bya bar de mi dmigs pa'i tshul kyis chos ston pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu dang / mi 'jigs pa bzhi dang / so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams kyi bar du mi rtag ces bya bar de mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis chos ston pa dang / sdug bsngal zhes bya ba dang / bdag med ces bya ba dang / zhi zhes bya ba dang / dben zhes bya ba dang / stong zhes bya ba dang /mtshan ma med ces bya ba dang / smon pa med ces bya bar de mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis chos ston cing / dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag thams cad kyang rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid ma gtogs par nyan thos kyi sa 'am/ rang sangs rgyas kyi sar yongs su bsngor mi 'jug pa'o/ /rab 'byor 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen du rig par bya ste/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen des yongs su zin pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di bstan pa thos nas①/ mi dngang /kun tu mi skrag /kun tu skrag pa dang ldan par mi 'gyur ro/ /rab 'byor gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ gang gis shes rab kyi pha rol tu 50—409

phyin pa bstan pa 'di thos nas dngang zhing kun tu skrag la kun tu skrag pa dang ldan par 'gyur ba thabs mi mkhas par 'gyur ba dang / sdig pa'i grogs po'i lag tu song bar 'gyur ba ji lta bu zhig lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor 'di la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la byed pa dang bral bas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa sgom zhing dmigs te/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa des kyang rlom sems su byed pa dang / rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i yid la byed pa dang bral bas bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa sgom zhing dmigs te/ bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa des kyang rlom sems su byed pa dang / rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i yid la byed pa dang bral bas brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa sgom zhing dmigs te / brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa des kyang rlom sems su byed pa dang /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i yid la byed pa dang bral bas bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa sgom zhing dmigs te/ bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa des kyang rlom sems su byed pa dang / rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i yid la byed pa dang bral bas tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa sgom zhing dmigs te/ tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa des kyang rlom sems su byed pa dang / rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i yid la byed pa dang bral bas sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa sgom zhing dmigs te/sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa des kyang rlom sems su byed pa de lta bu ni/ rab 'byor byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i thabs mi mkhas par rig par bya'o/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang 50—410

byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la byed pa dang bral bas gzugs nang stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed/ gzugs phyi stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed/ gzugs phyi nang stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed/gzugs dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi bar zhes bya bar yid la byed/rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid yid la byed pa dang bral bas tshor ba dang /'du shes dang / 'du byed rnams dang / rnam par shes pa nang stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed pa dang / rnam par shes pa phyi stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed pa dang /① rnam par shes pa phyi nang stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed pa dang / rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid yid la byed pa dang bral bas rnam par shes pa dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi bar zhes bya bar yid la byed cing dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa snenyid kyi bar de yang dmigs te/dmigs pa'i tshul gyis stong pa nyid de dag gis kyang zlom sems su byed do/ /mig nang stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed/ mig phyi stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed—/ mig phyi nang stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed/ mig dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi bar zhes bya bar yid la byed cing stong pa nyid de yang dmigs te/ dmigs pa'i tshul gyis stong pa nyid de dag gis kyang rlom sems su byed pa dang / rna ba dang / sna dang / lce dang / lus dang /yid nang stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed/ yid phyi stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed—/ yid phyi nang stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed/ yid dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi bar zhes bya bar yid la byed cing ①nang stong pa 50—411

nyid de yang dmigs te/ dmigs pa'i tshul gyis stong pa nyid de dag gis kyang zlom sems su byed pa dang / gzugs nang stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed/gzugs phyi stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed/ gzugs phyi nang stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed/ gzugs dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi bar zhes bya bar yid la byed/ sgra dang / dri dang / ro dang / reg dang /chos nang stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed/ chos phyi stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed—/ chos phyi nang stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed/ chos dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi bar zhes bya bar yid la byed cing nang stong pa nyid de yang dmigs te/ dmigs pa'i tshul gyis stong pa nyid des kyang zlos sems su byed pa dang / mig gi rnam par shes pa nang stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed/mig gi rnam par shes pa phyi stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed/ mig gi rnam par shes pa phyi nang stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed/ mig gi rnam par shes pa dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi bar zhes bya bar yid la byed/ rna ba'i rnam par shes pa dang / sna'i rnam par shes pa dang / lce'i rnam par shes pa dang / lus kyi rnam par shes pa dang / yid kyi rnam par shes pa nang stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed/ yid kyi rnam par shes pa phyi stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed/ yid kyi rnam par shes pa phyi nang stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed/yid kyi rnam par shes pa dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi bar zhes bya bar yid la byed cing nang stong pa nyid de yang dmigs te/ dmigs pa'i tshul tshul ①gyis stong pa nyid des kyang rlom sems su byed pa dang / mig gi 'dus te reg pa nang stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed/ mig gi 'dus te reg pa phyi stong 50—412

pa zhes bya bar yid la byed/ mig gi 'dus te reg pa phyi nang stong pa zhes bya ba ①yid la byed/ mig gi 'dus te reg pa dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi bar zhes bya bar yid la byed/ rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa dang / sna'i 'dus te reg pa dang / lce'i 'dus te reg pa dang / lus kyi 'dus te reg pa dang / yid kyi 'dus te reg pa nang stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed/yid kyi 'dus te reg pa phyi stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed/ yid kyi 'dus te reg pa phyi nang stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed/ yid kyi 'dus te reg pa dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi bar zhes bya bar yid la byed cing nang stong pa nyid de yang dmigs te/ dmigs pa'i tshul gyis nang stong pa nyid des kyang rlom sems su byed pa dang / mig gi rnam par shes pa'i bar ④nas yid kyi rnam par shes pa'i bar dang / de bzhin du mig gi 'dus te reg pa nas yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i bar dang / mig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen gyis tshor ba nang stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed/ mig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen gyis tshor ba phyi stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed/ mig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba phyi nang stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed/ mig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen gyis tshor ba dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi bar zhes bya bar yid la byed/ rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen gyis tshor ba dang /sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen gyis tshor ba dang / lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen gyis tshor ba dang / lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen gyis tshor ba dang / yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen gyis tshor ba nang stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed/yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen gyis tshor ba phyi stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed/50—413

yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen gyis tshor ba phyi nang stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed—/ yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen gyis tshor ba dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi bar zhes bya bar yid la byed cing nang stong pa nyid de yang dmigs te/ dmigs pa'i tshal gyis stong pa nyid des kyang rlom sems su byed pa dang / sa'i khams nang stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed/ sa'i khams phyi stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed/ sa'i khams phyi nang stong pa nyid ces bya bar yid la byed/ sa'i khams dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi bar zhes bya bar yid la byed/ chu'i khams dang / me'i khams dang / rlung gi khams dang / nam mkha'i khams dang / rnam par shes pa'i khams nang stong pa ①nyid ces bya bar yid la byed/ rnam par shes pa'i khams phyi stong pa nyid ces bya bar yid la byed/ rnam par shes pa'i khams phyi nang stong pa nyid ces bya bar yid la byed/ rnam par shes pa'i khams dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi bar zhes bya bar yid la byed/ ma rig pa nang stong pa nyid ces bya bar yid la byed/ ma rig pa phyi stong pa nyid ces bya bar yid la byed/ ma rig pa phyi nang stong pa nyid ces bya bar yid la byed/ ma rig pa dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi bar zhes bya bar yid la byed/ 'du byed dang / rnam par shes pa dang / ming dang gzugs dang / skye mched drug dang / reg pa dang / tshor ba dang / sred pa dang / len pa dang / srid pa dang / skye ba dang / rga shi nang stong pa nyid ces bya bar yid la byed/ rga shi phyi stong pa nyid ces bya bar yid la byed/ rga shi phyi nang stong pa nyid ces bya bar yid la byed—/ rga shi dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid ces ②bya bar yid la 50—414

byed cing nang stong pa nyid de yang dmigs te/ dmigs pa'i tshul gyis stong pa nyid des kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la byed pa dang bral bas dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams sgom zhing / dran pa nye bar gzhag pa de dag kyang dmigs te/ dmigs pa'i tshul gyis dran pa nye bar gzhag pa de dag gis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de bzhin du yang dag par spong ba dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa dang / dbang po dang / stobs dang / byang chub kyi yan lag dang / lam dang / bsam gtan dang / tshad med pa dang / gzugs med pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dang / mngon par shes pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu dang / mi 'jigs pa bzhi dang / so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bco brgyad rnams sgom par byed cing sangs rgyas kyi chos de dag kyang dmigs te/ dmigs pa'i tshul gyis sangs rgyas kyi chos de dag gis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /rab 'byor byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ de ltar thabs mi mkhas pas na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bstan pa 'di thos nas/ dngang zhing kun tu skrag la/ skrag pas zin par 'gyur ro//rab 'byor kyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das sdeg pa'i grogs pos zin pa gang gis shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bstan pa thos nas/ dngang zhing kun tu skrag la skrag pas zin par 'gyur ba/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sdig pa'i grogs pos zin par ji ltar 'gyur ba lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis 50—415

bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor 'di la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i ldig pa'i grogs po ni gang zhig shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang bral bar byed pa dang / bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang / tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang bral bar byed pa ste/'di ni de bzhin gshegs pas gsungs pa ma yin/ 'di ni chos ma yin/'di ni 'dul ba ma yin rmi①/ 'di la bslab par bya ba'i mi cha'o①/ /mdo sde 'di dag ni rang bzor byas pa ste/ 'di dag ni mnyan par mi bya'o/ /gzung bar mi bya'o/ /bcang bar mi bya'o/ /klag par mi bya'o/ /kun chub par mi bya'o / /tshul bzhin du yid la mi bya'o/ /'di dag ni gzhan la bstan par mi bya'o zhes zer ba 'di ni/ rab 'byor byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i sdig pa'i grogs por rig par bya'o/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i sdig pa'i grogs po ni 'di ltar bdud sdig to can sangs rgyas kyi cha byad du byas pa dag byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i drung du 'ongs nas/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug las bzlog ①cing mos pa med par byed de/ rigs kyi bu shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgoms pas khyod la ci zhig bya/ bsam gtan gye pha rol tu phyin pa bsgoms pas khyod la ci zhig bya/brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgoms pas khyod la ci zhig bya/ bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa bsgoms pas khyod la ci zhig bya/ tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgoms pas khyod la ci zhig bya/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa bsgoms pas khrod la ci zhig bya zhes zer ba 'ong ngo zhes bdud kyi las mi ston/50—416

bdud kyi nyes pa mi ston pa 'di ni/ rab 'byor byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i sdeg pa'i grogs por rig par bya'o/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang bdud sdig can dag sangs rgyas kyi cha byad du byas shing byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i drung du phyin te/ nyan thos dang ldan pa'i mdo dang /dbyangs kyis ①bsnyad pa dang / lung du ②bstan pa dang / tshigs su bcad pa dang / ched du brjod pa dang / gleng gzhi dang / 'di ltar 'das pa dang /skyes pa'i rabs dang / shin tu rgyas pa dang / chos rmad du byung ba dang /rtog ④pa brjod pa dang / gtan la phab par bstan pa dag ston te/ 'grel torjo—/ /rnam par 'byed do/ /gsal bar byed do/ /yongs su ston to zhes bdud kyi las rnam pa 'di lta bu dag mi smra mi ston pa 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i sdig pa'i grogs por rig par bya'o/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang bdud sdig can dag sangs rgyas kyi cha byad du byas shing / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i drung du phyin te/ 'di skad du rigs kyi bu khyod la ni byang chub kyi sems cung zad kyang med/ khyod ni phyir mi ldog pa yang ma yin/ khyod kyis ni bla na med pa yang dag par dzegs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar yang mi nus so zhes zer ba ni 'di lta bu'i bdud kyi las dag mi smra mi ston pa 'di ni/ rab 'byor byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i sdig pa'i grogs por rig par bya'o/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang bdud sdig can dag sangs rgyas kyi cha byad du byas shing / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de'i ⑤drung du phyin te/ 'di skad du rigs kyi bu mig ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /rna ba dang / sna dang / lce dang /nga0—417

—lus dang / yid ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /gzugs ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /sgra dang / dri dang / ro dang / reg dang / chos ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /mig gi rnam par shes pa ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /rna ba'i rnam par shes pa dang / sna'i rnam par shes pa dang / lce'i rnam par shes pa dang / lus kyi rnam par shes pa dang / yid kyi rnam par shes pa ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /mig gi 'dus te reg pa ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa dang / sna'i 'dus te reg pa dang / lce'i 'dus te reg pa dang / lus kyi 'dus te reg pa dang / yid kyi 'dus te reg pa ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /mig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen gyis tshor ba dang / sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen gyis tshor ba dang / lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba dang / lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen gyis tshor ba dang / yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen gyis tshor ba ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa ①ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang /bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang / brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang /bsam gtan rmi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /yang dag par spong ba dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa dang /dbang po dang / stobs dang / byang chub kyi yan lag dang / lam rnams nas sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams kyi bar ni bdag gam bdag gis stong 50—418

na—/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas te yang ci zhig bya zhes zer ba de lta bu'i bdud kyi ①las dag mi smra mi ston pa 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i sdig pa'i grogs por ①rig par bya'o/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang bdud sdog can dag rang sangs rgyas kyi cha byad du byas shing / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i drung du phyin te/ 'di skad du rigs kyi bu shar phyogs ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das dang / byang chub sems dpa' dang / nyan thos rnams kyis stong ste—/ 'di la ni sangs rgyas zhes bya ba yang med do/ /byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya ba yang med do/ /nyan thos zhes bya ba yang med do/ /lho dang / nub dang / byang dang / byang shar dang / shar lho dang / lho nub dang /nub byang dang / 'og dang / steng gi phyogs bcu kun kyang sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das dang / byang chub sems dpa' dang / nyan thos rnams kyis stong ste—/ 'di la ni sangs rgyas zhes bya ba yang med do/ /byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya ba yang med do/ /nyan thos zhes bya ba yang med do zhes zer ba de lta bu'i bdud kyi las dag mi smra mi ston pa 'di ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i sdig pa'i grogs por rig par bya'o/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang bdud sdig can dag nyan thos kyi cha byad du byas shing byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i drung du phyin te/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba las bzlog ①cing nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas gdams pa dang / rjes su bstan pa de lta bu'i bdud kyi las dag mi smra mi ston pa 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i 50—419

sdig pa'i grogs por rig par bya'o/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang bdud sdig can dag mkhan po dang slob dpon kyi cha byad du byas shing byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i drung du phyin te/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa las bzlog ①cing rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba las bzlog ②ste/ dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams la sbyor ba dang / yang dag par spong ba rnams dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams dang / dbang po rnams dang /stobs rnams dang / byang chub kyi yan lag rnams dang / 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa la sbyor ba dang / stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma med pa dang / smon pa med pa'i bar gyi chos rnams la sbyor zhing / de ltar rigs kyi bu khyod kyis chos de dag yongs su bsgoms ①la nyan thos kyi sa mngon du byas shing rjobla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyis khyod la ci zhig bya zhes zer ba de lta bu'i bdud kyi las dag mi smra mi ston pa 'di ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pho'i sdig pa'i grogs por rig par bya'o/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang bdud sdig can dag pha dang ma'i cha byad du byas shing / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i drung du phyin te/ 'di ni ⑤bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pas khyod la ci zhig bya/ de'i don du ni bskal pa tshad med grangs med par 'khor ba na bu'akhor zhing / rkang lag dang mgo bcad pa tshad med pas nyon mongs par 'gyur kyis/ gang la rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu mngon du byar ⑦yod pa dang / lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu mngon du byar ⑧yod pa dang /phyir mi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu mngon du byar ⑨yod pa dang / dgra bcom pa'i 50—420

'bras bu mngon du byar ①yod pa de la brtson par gyis shig ces zer ba de lta bu'i bdud kyi las dag mi smra mi ston pa 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i sdig pa'i grogs por rig par bya'o/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang bdud sdeg can dag ②dge slong gi cha byad du byas shing / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i drung du phyin te/ gzugs mi rtag ces bya bar dmigs pa'i tshul gyis ston pa dang / gzugs sdug bsngal ba dang / bdag med pa dang / zhi ba dang / dben pa dang / stong pa dang / mtshan ma med pa dang / smon pa med pa zhes bya bar dmigs pa'i tshul gyes ston pa dang /tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed rnams dang / rnam par shes pa mi rtag ces bya bar dmigs pa'i tshul gyis ston pa dang / rnam par shes pa sdug bsngal ba dang / bdag med pa dang / zhi ba dang / dbe+en pa dang /stong pa dang / mtshan ma med pa dang / smon pa med pa zhes bya bar dmigs pa'i tshul gyis ston pa dang / mig mi rtag ces bya ba dang / sdug bsngal ba dang /bdag med pa dang / zhi ba dang / dbe+en pa dang / stong pa dang /mtshan ma med pa dang / smon pa med pa zhes bya bar dmigs pa'i tshul gyis ston pa dang / rna ba dang / sna dang / lce dang / lus dang / yid mi rtag ces bya ba dang / sdug bsngal ba dang / bdag med pa dang / zhi ba dang /dbe+en pa dang / stong pa dang / mtshan ma med pa dang / smon pa med pa zhes bya bar dmigs pa'i tshul gyis ston pa dang / gzugs mi rtag ces bya ba dang / sdug bsngal ba dang / bdag med pa dang / zhi ba dang / dbe+en pa dang / stong pa dang / mtshan ma med pa dang / smon pa med pa zhes bya bar 50—421

dmigs pa'i tshul kyis ston pa dang / sgra dang / dri dang / ro dang / reg dang / chos mi rtag ces bya ba dang / sdug bsngal ba dang / bdag med pa dang / zhi ba dang / dbe+en pa dang / stong pa dang / mtshan ma med pa dang /smon pa med pa zhes bya bar dmigs pa'i tshul gyis ston pa dang / mig gi rnam par shes pa mi rtag ces bya ba dang / sdug bsngal ba dang / bdag med pa dang / zhi ba dang / dben pa dang / stong pa dang / mtshan ma med pa dang / smon pa med pa zhes bya bar dmigs pa'i tshul byis ston pa dang / rna ba'i rnam par shes pa dang / sna'i rnam par shes pa dang / lce'i rnam par shes pa dang / lus kyi rnam par shes pa dang / yid kyi rnam par shes pa mi rtag ces bya ba dang / sdug bsngal ba dang / bdag med pa dang / zhi ba dang /dben pa dang / stong pa dang / mtshan ma med pa dang / smon pa med pa zhes bya bar dmigs pa'i tshul gyis ston pa dang / mig gi 'dus te reg pa mi rtag ces bya ba dang / sdug bsngal ba dang / bdag med pa dang / zhi ba dang / dben pa dang / stong pa dang / mtshan ma med pa dang / smon pa med pa zhes bya bar dmigs pa'i tshul gyis ston pa dang / rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa dang / sna'i 'dus te reg pa dang / lce'i 'dus te reg pa dang / lus kyi 'dus te reg pa dang / yid kyi 'dus te reg pa mi rtag ces bya ba dang / sdug bsngal ba dang / bdag med pa dang / zhi ba dang / dben pa dang /stong pa dang / mtshan ma med pa dang / smon pa med pa zhes bya bar dmigs pa'i tshul gyis ston pa dang / mig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen gyis tshor ba mi rtag ces bya ba dang / sdug bsngal ba dang / bdag med pa dang / zhi ba 50—422

dang / dben pa dang / stong pa dang / mtshan ma med pa dang / smon pa med pa zhes bya bar dmigs pa'i tshul gyis ston pa dang / rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen gyis tshor ba dang / sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen gyis tshor ba dang /lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen gyis tshor ba dang / lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen gyis tshor ba dang / yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen gyis tshor ba mi rtag ces bya ba dang / sdug bsngal ba dang / bdag med pa dang / zhi ba dang /dben pa dang / stong pa dang / mtshan ma med pa dang / smon pa med pa zhes bya bar dmigs pa'i tshul gyes ston pa dang / dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams kyi bar ①mi rtag ces bya ba dang / sdug bsngal ba dang / bdag med pa dang / zhi ba dang / dben pa dang / stong pa dang / mtshan ma med pa dang / spyon pa med pa zhes bya bar dmigs pa'i tshul gyis ston pa dang / de bzhin du yang dag par spong ba dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa dang / dbang po dang / stobs dang / byang chub kyi yan lag dang / 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa rnams mi rtag ces bya ba dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams kyi bar du mi rtag ces bya ba dang / sdug bsngal ba dang / bdag med pa dang / zhi ba dang / dbe+en pa dang / stong pa dang / mtshan ma med pa dang / smon pa med pa zhes bya bar dmigs pa'i tshul kyis ston pa de lta bu'i bdud kyi las dag mi smra mi ston pa 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i sdig pa'i grogs por rig par bya'o/ /de ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i sdig pa'i grogs por rig par bya ste/ de ltar shes nas kyang yongs su spang bar bya'o zhes bya ba ni yongs su 'dzin pa gnyis pa dge ba'i 50—423

bshes gnyen gyis yongs su zin pa yin no/ /'di dag gis nges par 'byed pa'i yan lag bzhi bstan to / /①de nas tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor gyis/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' byang chub ④sems dpa' zhes bgyi ba'i tshig 'di'i don gang lags/ de skad ces gsol pa dang /bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor la 'di skad ces ④bka' stsal to//rab 'byor byang chub sems dpa'i tshig gi don ni tshig gi don med pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ byang chub la ni skye ba 'am/ yod pa nyid dam med pa nyid yod pa 'am dmigs pa ma yin te/ rab 'byor de'i phyir byang chub sems dpa'i tshig gi don med pa'o zhes bya ba ni rigs kyi rang gi ngo bo yin no / /burab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha' la bya'i rjes med cing mi dmigs so/ /rab 'byor de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa'i tshig gi don med cing mi dmigs so/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ rmi lam la gnas med cing mi dmigs so/ /rab 'byor de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa'i tshig gi don med cing mi dmigs so/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ sgyu ma la gnas med cing mi dmigs so/ /rab 'byor de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa'i tshig gi don med cing mi dmigs so/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/smig rgyu la gnas med cing mi dmigs so/ /rab 'byor de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa'i tshig gi don med cing mi dmigs so/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste 50—424

dper na/ sgra brnyan dang / mig yor dang / gzugs brnyan dang / dri za'i grong khyen dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i sprul pa la gnas med cing mi dmigs so/ /rab 'byor de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa'i tshig gi don med cing mi dmigs so zhes bya ba ni drod du gtogs pa'i rten ①yin no / /②rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ yang dag pa'i mtha' la gnas med cing mi dmigs so/ /rab 'byor de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa'i tshig gi don med cing mi dmigs so/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ de bzhin nyid la gnas med cing mi dmigs so/ /de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa'i tshig gi don med cing mi dmigs so/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ ma nor ba de bzhin nyid dang / gzhan ma yin pa de bzhin nyid ①dang / chos nyid dang / chos kyi dbyings nyid dudang / chos kyi gnas nyid dang / chos nges pa nyid dang / dben pa nyid la gnas med cing mi dmigs so/ /rab 'byor de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa'i tshig gi don med cing mi dmigs so zhes bya ba ni rtse mor gtogs pa'i rten rjoyin no / /burab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ sgyu ma'i skyes bu'i gzugs la gnas med cing mi dmigs so/ /rab 'byor de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i tshig gi don med cing mi dmigs so/ /tshor ba dang / 'du shes ⑦dang /'du byed rnams dang / rnam par shes pa la gnas med cing mi dmigs so/ /50—425

rab 'byor de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i ①tshig gi don med cing mi dmigs so/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ sgyu ma'i skyes bu'i mig la tshig gi don med cing mi dmigs so/ /rab 'byor de bzhin du 'di lta ste dper na—/ sgyu ma'i skyes bu'i rna ba dang / sna dang / lce dang / lus dang /yid la tshig gi don med cing mi dmigs so/ /rab 'byor de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i tshig gi don med cing mi dmigs so/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ sgyu ma'i skyes bu'i gzugs la tshig gi don med cing mi dmigs so/ /sgra dang / dri dang / ro dang / reg dang / chos la tshig gi don med cing mi dmigs so/ /rab 'byor de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i tshig gi don med cing mi dmigs so/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ sgyu ma'i skyes bu'i mig dang / gzugs dang / mig gi rnam par shes pa la tshig gi don med cing mi dmigs so/ /rab 'byor de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i tshig gi don med cing mi dmigs so/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/sgyu ma'i skyes bu'i rna ba dang / sgra dang / rna ba'i rnam par shes pa la tshig gi don med cing mi dmigs so/ /rab 'byor de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i tshig gi don med cing mi dmigs so/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/50—426

sgyu ma'i skyes bu'i sna dang dri dang sna'i rnam par shes pa la tshig gi don med cing mi dmigs so/ /rab 'byor de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i tshig gi don med cing mi dmigs so/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ sgyu ma'i skyes bu'i lce dang / ro dang / lce'i rnam par shes pa la tshig gi don med cing mi dmigs so/ /rab 'byor de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i ①tshig gi don med cing mi dmigs so/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ sgyu ma'i skyes bu'i lus dang / reg bya dang / lus kyi rnam par shes pa la tshig gi don med cing mi dmigs so/ /rab 'byor de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i tshig gi don med cing mi dmigs so/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ sgyu ma'i skyes bu'i yid dang /chos dang / yid kyi rnam par shes pa la tshig gi don med cing mi dmigs so/ /rab 'byor de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i tshig gi don med cing mi dmigs so zhes bya ba ni bzod par gtogs pa'i rten bstan pa yin no// //bam po bcu gsum pa/ rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ sgyu ma'i skyes bu'i nang stong pa nyid la spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i tshig gi don med cing mi dmigs so/ /rab 'byor de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i tshig gi don 50—427

med cing mi dmigs so/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ sgyu ma'i skyes bu'i phyi stong pa nyid la spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i tshig gi don med cing mi dmigs so/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ sgyu ma'i skyes bu'i dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi bar la spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i tshig gi don med cing mi dmigs so/ /rab 'byor de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i tshig gi don med cing mi dmigs so/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ sgyu ma'i skyes bu'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang / dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams dang / yang dag par spong ba rnams dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams dang / dbang po rnams dang / stobs rnams dang / byang chub kyi yan lag rnams dang / 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa dang / stobs bcu dang / mi 'jigs pa dang / so so yang dag par rig pa dang /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams dang / phung po rnams dang / khams rnams dang / skye mched rnams dang / rten cing 'byel par 'byung ba rnams dang / bsam gtan dang / tshad med pa dang /① gzugs med pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams la spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i tshig gi don med cing mi dmigs so/ /rab 'byor de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i tshig gi don med cing mi dmigs so zhes bya ba ni chos kyi mchog tu gtogs pa'i rten bstan pa yin no / /sde50—428

rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi gzugs la tshig gi don med cing mi dmigs so/ /rab 'byor de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i tshig gi don med cing mi dmigs so/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi tshor ba dang /'du shes dang / 'du byed rnams dang / rnam par shes pa la tshig gi don med cing mi dmigs so/ /rab 'byor de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i tshig gi don med cing mi dmigs so/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi mig la tshig gi don med cing mi dmigs so/ /rab 'byor de bzhin du/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i tshig gi don med cing mi dmigs so/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi rna ba dang / sna dang / lce dang / lus dang / yid la tshig gi don med cing mi dmigs so/ /rab 'byor de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i tshig gi don med cing mi dmigs so/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi nang stong pa nyid nas dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi bar la spyod pa'i 50—429

byang chub sems dpa'i tshig gi don med cing mi dmigs so/ /rab 'byor de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i tshig gi don med cing mi dmigs so/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun dang /de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu dang / mi 'jigs pa bzhi dang / so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bco brgyad la spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i tshig gi don med cing mi dmigs so/ /rab 'byor de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i tshig gi don med cing mi dmigs so/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ 'dus ma byas kyi dbyings la 'dus byas kyi khams kyi gnas med cing mi dmigs so/ /'dus byas kyi khams la 'dus ma byas kyi dbyings kyi gnas med cing mi dmigs so/ /rab 'byor de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i tshig gi don med cing mi dmigs so zhes bya ba ni mthong ba'i lam gyi rten bstan pa yin no / /①rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ skye ba med pa'i tshig gi don med cing mi dmigs so/ /rab 'byor de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i tshig gi don med cing mi dmigs so/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ 'gag pa med pa 50—430

dang / mngon par 'du bya ba med pa dang / 'byung ba med pa dang / mi dmigs pa dang / kun nas nyon mongs pa med pa'i tshig gi don med cing mi dmigs so/ /rab 'byor de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i tshig gi don med cing mi dmigs so/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ rnam par byang ba med pa'i tshig gi don med cing mi dmigs so/ /rab 'byor de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i tshig gi don med byung mi dmigs so/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/rab 'byor gzugs kyi skye ba la tshig gi don med cing mi dmigs so/ / rab 'byor tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed rnams dang / rnam par shes pa'i skye ba la tshig gi don med cing mi dmigs so/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/rab 'byor gzugs kyi 'gag pa dang / mngon par 'du byed pa dang /'byung ba dang / dmigs pa dang / kun nas nyon mongs pa la tshig gi don med cing mi dmigs so/ /rab 'byor tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed rnams dang / rnam par shes pa'i 'gag pa dang mngon par 'du byed pa dang 'byung ba dang dmigs pa dang kun nas nyon mongs pa la tshig gi don med cing mi dmigs so/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor gzugs kyi rnam par byang ba la tshig gi don med cing mi dmigs so/ /rab 'byor tshor ba dang /'du shes dang / 'du byed rnams dang rnam par shes pa'i rnam par byang ba la tshig gi don med cing mi dmigs so/ /rab 'byor de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i byang chub 50—431

sems dpa'i tshig gi don med cing mi dmigs so/ /rab 'byor gzugs kyi skye ba la tshig gi don med cing mi dmigs so/ /—gzugs kyi 'gag pa dang /mngon par 'du byed pa dang / 'byung ba dang / dmigs pa dang / kun nas nyon mongs pa dang / rnam par byang ba la tshig gi don med cing mi dmigs so—/ /tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed rnams dang / rnam par shes pa'i skye ba la tshig gi don med cing mi dmigs so/ /rnam par shes pa'i 'gag pa dang / mngon par 'du byed pa dang / 'byung ba dang / dmigs pa dang / kun nas nyon mongs pa dang / rnam par byang ba la tshig gi don med cing mi dmigs so/ /skye mched dang / khams dang / rten cing 'byel par 'byung ba'i skye ba la tshig gi don med cing mi dmigs so/ /skye mched dang /khams dang / rten cing 'byel par 'byung ba'i rnam par byang ba'i bar la tshig gi don med cing mi dmigs so/ /byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos rnams kyi bar dang /bsam gtan rnams dang / tshad med pa rnams dang / gzugs med pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams dang / mngon par shes pa rnams dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu dang / mi 'jigs pa bzhi dang / so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams kyi skye ba la tshig gi don med cing mi dmigs so/ /de bzhin du sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams kyi rnam par byang ba'i bar la tshig gi don med cing mi dmigs so/ /rab 'byor de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i tshig gi don med cing mi dmigs so/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ shin tu dben pa'i phyir 50—432

gzugs la mtshan ma'i gnas med cing mi dmigs so/ /shin tu dbe+en pa'i phyir tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed rnams dang / rnam par shes pa la mtshan ma'i gnas med cing mi dmigs so/ /rab 'byor de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen bo shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i tshig gi don med cing mi dmigs so/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ shin tu dbe+en pa'i phyir/ skye mched dang / khams dang /rten cing 'byel par 'byung ba so so ba dang / bsdus pa rnams la mtshan ma'i gnas med cing mi dmigs so/ /rab 'byor de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i tshig gi don med cing mi dmigs so/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ dran pa nye bar gzhag pa shin tu rnam par dag pa la gnas med cing mi dmigs so/ /de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i tshig gi don med cing mi dmigs so/ /de bzhin du yang dag par spong ba dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa dang / dbang po dang / stobs dang / byang chub kyi yan lag rnams dang / 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa dang / 'phags pa'i bden pa dang / bsam gtan dang / tshad med pa ①dang / gzugs med pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams dang / mngon par shes pa rnams dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu dang / mi 'jigs pa bzhi dang / so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams shin tu rnam par dag pa la gnas med cing mi dmigs so/ /rab 'byor de bzhin du byang chub 50—433

sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i tshig gi don med cing mi dmigs so/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ bdag med pa'i phyir bdag shin tu ①rnam par dag pa la gnas med cing mi dmigs so/ /sems can dang / srog dang / gso ba dang /skyes bu dang / gang zas dang / shed las skyes dang / shed bu dang /byed pa po dang / tshor ba po dang / shes pa po dang / mthong ba po med pa'i phyir/ sems can dang / srog dang / gso ba dang / skyes bu dang /gang zag dang / shed las skyes dang / shed bu dang / byed pa po dang /tshor ba po dang / shes pa po dang / mthong ba po rnams kyi shin tu rnam par dag pa la gnas med cing mi dmigs so/ /rab 'byor de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i tshig gi don med cing mi dmigs so zhes bya ba ni bsgom pa'i lam gyi rten yin no / /②rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor mngon par 'char ba'i 'od la mun pa'i gnas med cing mi dmigs so/ /rab 'byor de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i tshig gi don med cing mi dmigs so zhes bya ba ni gnyen po'i phyogs kyi rten yin no / /①rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ bskal pa'i dume 'bar ba'i tshe 'du 50—434

byed kyi rnam pa thams cad kyi gnas med cing mi dmigs so/ /rab 'byor de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i tshig gi don med cing mi dmigs so zhes bya ba ni mi mthun pa'i phyogs spong ba'i rten yin no / /①rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi tshul khrims la tshul khrims ngan pa'i gnas med cing mi dmigs so/ /rab 'byor de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i tshig gi don med cing mi dmigs so/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi ting nge 'dzin la rnam par g.yeng ba'i gnas med cing mi dmigs so/ /rab 'byor de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i tshig gi don med cing mi dmigs so/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi shes rab la shes rab 'chal pa'i gnas med cing mi dmigs so/ /rab 'byor de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i tshig gi don med cing mi dmigs so/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi rnam par grol ba la ①rnam par ma grol ba'i gnas med cing mi dmigs so//50—435

rab 'byor de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i tshig gi don med cing mi dmigs so/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi rnam par grol ba'i ye shes gzigs pa la rnam par grol ba'i ye shes ma gzigs pa'i gnas med cing mi dmigs so/ /rab 'byor de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i tshig gi don med cing mi dmigs so zhes bya ba ni gnyen po dang mi mthun pa'i phyogs kyi rnam par rtog pa spong ba'i rten yin no / /①rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ nyi ma dang zla ba'i 'od la gnas med cing mi dmigs so/ /rab 'byor de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i tshig gi don med ②cing mi dmigs so zhes bya ba ni shes rab dang snying rje'i rten yin no / /①rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang / gza' dang / skar ma dang / nor bu rin po che dang / glog gi 'od la gnas med cing mi dmigs so/ /rab 'byor de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i tshig gi don med cing mi dmigs so zhes bya ba ni thun mong ma 50—436

yin pa'i yon tan gyi rten yin no / /①rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ rgyal chen bzhi'i ris kyi lha rnams kyi 'od la gnas med cing mi dmigs so/ /sum cu rtsa gsum kyi lha rnams dang /'thab bral dang / dga' ldan dang / 'phrul dga' dang / gzhan 'phrul dbang byed dang / tshangs ris dang / tshangs pa'i ②mdun na 'don dang /tshangs 'khor dang / tshangs chen dang / 'og min gyi bar gyi lha rnams kyi 'od la gnas med cing mi dmigs so/ /rab 'byor de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i tshig gi don med cing mi dmigs so zhes bya ba ni gzhan gyi don gyi go rims kyi ①rten yin no / /durab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi 'od la gnas med cing mi dmigs so/ /rab 'byor de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i tshig gi don med cing mi dmigs so/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor 'di ltar byang chub gang yin pa dang /byang chub sems dpa' dang / byang chub sems dpa'i tshig gi don gang yin pa'i chos de dag thams cad ⑤kyang ldan pa ma yin mi ldan pa rjom yin te/ gzugs med pa dang / bstan du med pa dang / thogs pa med pa/ mtshan nyid gcig pa ste⑦/ 'di ltar mtshan nyid med pa'o/ /rab 'byor byang chub sems dpa' 50—437

sems dpa' chen pos ni/ rtog pa med pa dang / rnam par rtog pa med pa'i phyir chos thams cad kyi chags pa med pa nyid dang / yod par gyur pa ma yin pa nyid la bslab par bya'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos chos thams cad rtogs par bya'o zhes bya ba ni ye shes lhun byis grub par 'jug pa'i rten yin no / / 'di dag gis ni sgrub pa'i rten bstan to/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das chos thams cad ni gang lags/ bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos ji ltar chos thams cad kyi yod par gyur pa ma yin pa nyid la bslab par bgyi/ bcom ldan 'das ji ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos chos thams cad rtogs par bgyi / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor chos thams cad ces bya ba ni/ dge ba dang / mi dge ba dang / lung du ma bstan pa dang /'jig rten pa dang / 'jig rten las 'das pa dang / zag pa dang bcas pa dang / zag pa med pa dang / 'dus byas dang / 'dus ma byas dang /kha na ma tho ba dang bcas pa dang / kha na ma tho ba med pa dang / thun mong ba dang / thun mong ma yin pa dag ste/ rab 'byor de dag ni chos thams cad ces bya ste①/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos kyang / chos de dag thams cad kyi yod par gyur pa ma yin pa nyid la basbab par bya'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos chos 'di dag rtogs par bya'o zhes bya ba ni dmigs pa'i rang gi ngo bo yin no / /④gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'jig rten pa'i dge ba'i chos gang lags/50—438

bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor 'jig rten pa'i chos dge ba zhes bya ba ni phar shes pa dang / mar shes pa dang / dge spyong du shes pa dang /bram zer shes pa dang / rigs kyi rgan pa la rim gror byed pa dang / sbyin pa las byung ba'i bsod nams bya ba'i dngos po dang / tshul khrims las byung ba'i bsod nams bya ba'i dngos po dang / bsgoms pa las byung ba'i bsod nams bya ba'i dngos po dang / nyams su blang ba dang ldan pa'i dngos po dang /thabs mkhas pa dang / dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam rnams dang / 'jig rten pa'i 'du shes dgu ste/ 'di lta ste/ rnam par bam pa'i 'du shes dang /rnam par 'bus gzhigs pa'i 'du shes dang / rnam par rnags pa'i 'du shes ①dang / rnam par dmar ba'i 'du shes dang / rnam par bsngos pa pa'i 'du shes dang / rnam par zos pa pa'i 'du shes dang / rnam par 'thor ②ba pa'i 'du shes dang / rus pa pa'i 'du shes dang / rnam par tshig pa ①pa'i 'du shes dang / 'jig rten pa'i bsam gtan bzhi dang / tshad med pa bzhi dang /gzugs med pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa bzhi dang / 'jig rten pa'i mngon par shes pa lnga dang / 'jig rten pa'i rjes su dran pa bcu ste/ 'di lta ste/ sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa dang / chos rjes su dran pa dang / dge 'dun rjes su dran pa dang / tshul khrims rjes su dran pa dang / gtong ba rjes su dran pa dang / lha rjes su dran pa dang / dbugs phyi nang du rgyu ba rjes su dran pa dang / skye rjob rjes su dran pa dang / 'chi ba rjes su dran pa dang / lus kyi rnam pa rjes su dran pa dag ste/de dag ni 'jig rten pa'i dge ba'i chos zhes brjod do/ /50—439

gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'jig rten pa'i mi dge ba'i chos gang lags—/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ mi dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam dag ste/ 'di lta ste/ rab 'byor srog gcod pa ni 'jig rten pa'i chos mi dge ba'o/ /ma byen par len pa dang / 'dod pas log par g.yem pa dang / brdzun ①du smra ba dang / phra ma dang / tshig rtsub mo dang / ngag 'khyal pa dang / brnab sems dang / gnod sems dang / log par lta ba dang / khro ba dang / khon du 'dzin pa dang / 'chab pa dang / 'tshig pa dang / rnam par 'tshe ba dang / phrag dog dang / ser sna dang / nga rgyal dang / log pa'i nga rgyal te/ rab 'byor de dag ni 'jig rten pa'i mi dge ba'i chos zhes brjod do/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das lung du ma bstan pa'i chos gang lags/bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ lung du ma bstan pa'i lus kyi las dang /lung du ma bstan pa'i ngag gi las dang / lung du ma bstan pa'i yid kyi las dang / lung du ma bstan pa'i 'byung ba chen po bzhi dang / lung du ④ma bstan pa'i dbang po lnga dang / lung du ma bstan pa'i skye mched drug dang / lung du ①ma bstan pa'i gzugs med pa dang / lung du ma bstan pa'i phung po dang khams dang skye mched rnams dang / rnam par smin pa thams cad de/ de dag ni lung du ma bstan pa'i chos zhes brjod do/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'jig rten pa'i chos gang lags/50—440

bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' pa pa/ rab 'byor phung po lnga dang / skye mched bcu gnyis dang / khams bco brgyad dang / dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam dang / bsam gtan bzhi dang / tshad med pa bzhi dang / gzugs med pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa bzhi dang / mngon par shes pa lnga dang / dang ①/'jig rten pa'i chos gzhan gang / gzhan yang 'jig rten pa'i chos gang dag yin pa ste/ 'di dag ni 'jig rten pa'i chos zhes brjod do④/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'jig rten las 'das pa'i chos gang lags—/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' pa pa/ rab 'byor dran pa nye bar gzhag pa bzhi dang / yang dag par spong ba bzhi dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi ①rkang pa bzhi dang / dbang po lnga dang / stobs lnga dang / byang chub kyi yan lag bdun dang / 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa dang / rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / rnam par thar pa'i sgo mtshan ma med pa dang /rnam par thar pa'i sgo smon pa med pa dang / mi shes pa kun shes par byed pa'i dbang po dang / kun shes pa'i dbang po dang / kun shes pa dang ldan pa'i dbang po dang / rtog pa dang bcas pa rjodapyod pa dang bcas pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang / rtog pa med la dpyod pa tsam byi ting nge 'dzin dang / rtog pa med cing dpyod pa med pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang / rig pa dang / rnam par grol ba dang / dran pa dang / shes bzhin dang / tshud bzhin yid la byed pa dang / rnam par thar pa brgyad de/ brgyad gang zhe na/ gzugs can gzugs la lta ba 'di ni rnam par thar pa dang po'o/ /nang gzugs med par 50—441

'du shes pas phyi rol gyi gzugs rnams la lta ba 'di ni rnam par thar pa gnyis pa'o—/ /sdug par mos pa 'di ni rnam par thar pa gsum pa'o/ /gzugs kyi 'du shes ①las yang dag par 'das te/ thogs pa'i 'du shes rnams nub par gyur cing sna tshogs kyi 'du shes rnams yid la mi byed pas nam mkha' mtha' yas so zhes te/ nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched nye bar bsgrubs te gnas pa 'di ni rnam par thar pa bzhi pa'o/ /de rnam pa thams cad du nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched las yang dag par 'das te/ rnam par shes pa mtha' yas so zhes rnam shes mtha' yas skye mched nye bar bsgrubs te gnas pa 'di ni rnam par thar pa lnga pa'o/ /de rnam pa thams cad du rnam shes mtha' yas skye mched las yang dag par 'das te/ cung zad med do snyam pas ci yang med pa'i skye mched nye bar bsgrubs te gnas pa 'di ni rnam par thar pa drug pa 'o/ /de rnam pa thams cad du cung zad med pa'i skye mched las yang dag par 'das te/ 'du shes med 'du shes med min skye mched nye bar bsgrubs te gnas pa 'di ni rnam par thar pa bdun pa'o/ /de rnam pa thams cad du 'du shes med 'du shes med min skye mched las yang dag par 'das te/ 'du shes dang / tshor ba 'gog pa nye bar bsgrubs ②te gnas pa 'di ni rnam par thar pa brgyad pa ste/ 'di dag ni rnam par thar pa brgyad do/ /mthar byis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu ste—/ dgu gang zhe na 'di lta ste/ 'dod pas dben pa spyig to mi dge ba'i chos kyis ①dben pa/ rtog pa dang bcas/ dpyod pa dang bcas/ dbe+en pa las skyes pa'i dga' ba dang bde ba can bsam gtan dang po nye bar bsgrubs te gnas pa dang / de rnam par rtog pa dang rnam par dpyod pa nye bar zhi nas 50—442

nang yongs su dang ste/ sems kyi rgyud gcig tu gyur pas rnam par rtog pa med pa rnam par dpyod pa med pa/ ting nge 'dzin las ①skyes pa'i dga' ba dang bde ba can bsam gtan gnyis pa nye bar bsgrubs te gnas pa dang / de dga' ba las 'dod chags dang bral bas dran pa dang ldan zhing shes bzhin du btang snyoms su gnas te/ bde ba lus kyis myong la 'phags pa rnams kyis de la dran pa dang ldan pa bde ba la rnam par spyod ②pa btang snyoms pa'o zhes brjod pa dga' ba med pa'i bsam gtan gsum pa nye bar bsgrubs te gnas pa dang /de bde ba yang spangs sdug bsngal ba yang spangs shing yid bde ba dang yid mi bde ba snga nas kyang nub pas bde ba yang med/ sdug bsngal ba yang med/ btang snyoms dang dran pa yongs su dag pa'i bsam gtan bzhi pa nye bar bsgrubs te gnas pa dang / de rnam pa thams cad du gzugs kyi 'du shes las yang dag par 'das te/ thogs pa'i 'du shes rnams nub par gyur cing sna tshogs kyi 'du shes yid la mi byed pas nam mkha' mtha' yas so snyam ste/ nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched nye bar bsgrubs te gnas pa dang / de rnam pa thams cad du nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched las yang dag par 'das te/ rnam par shes pa mtha' yas so snyam pas/ rnam shes mtha' yas skye mched nye bar bsgrubs te gnas pa dang / de rnam pa thams cad du rnam shes mtha' yas skye mched las yang dag par 'das te/ cung zad med do snyam pas cung zad med pa'i skye mched nye bar bsgrubs te gnas pa dang / de rnam pa thams cad du cung zad med pa'i skye mched las yang dag par 'das te/ 'du shes med 'du shes med min skye mched nye bar bsgrubs te gnas pa dang / de rnam pa thams cad du 50—443

'du shes med 'du shes ①med min skye mched las yang dag par 'das te/ 'du shes dang tshor ba 'gog pa nye bar bsgrubs te gnas pa ste/ 'di dag ni mthar gyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu'o/ /nang stong pa nyid dang / phyi stong pa nyid dang / phyi nang stong pa nyid dang / dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi bar dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu dang / mi 'jigs pa bzhi dang /so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bco brgyad dag ste/ de dag ni 'jig rten las 'das pa'i chos zhes bya'o/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das zag pa dang bcas pa'i chos gang lags/bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor phung po lnga dang / skye mched bcu gnyis dang / khams bco brgyad dang / bsam gtan bzhi dang /tshad med pa bzhi dang / gzugs med pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa bzhi ste/ de dag ni zag pa dang bcas pa'i chos zhes bya'o/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das zag pa ma mchis pa'i chos gang lags/bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' cad pa/ rab 'byor dran pa nye bar gzhag pa bzhi dang / yang dag par spong ba bzhi dang / rdzu 'phrul rmi rkang pa bzhi dang /dbang po lnga dang / stobs lnga dang / byang chub kyi yan lag bdun dang /'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu dang / mi 'jigs pa bzhi dang / so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi dang /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bco brgyad kyi bar dag ste/ de dag ni zag 50—444

pa med pa'i chos zhes bya'o/ / gsol pa/① bcom ldan 'das 'dus byas kyi chos gang lags/bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' byed pa/ rab 'byor 'dus byas kyi chos zhes bya ba ni/ 'dod pa'i khams dang / gzugs kyi khams dang / gzugs med pa'i khams dang / gzhan yang khams gsum par ma ②gtogs pa'i chos gang cung zad yod pa rnams dang / byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun dang /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bco brgyad kyi bar dag ste/ de dag ni 'dus byas kyi chos zhes bya'o/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'dus ma byas kyi chos gang lags/bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' byed pa/ rab 'byor gang la skye ba med cing 'jig pa med pa dang / gnas pa las gzhan du 'gyur ba mi mngon pa ste/'di lta ste/ 'dod chags zad pa/ zhe sdang zad pa/ gti mug zad pa/de bzhin nyid ma nor ba de bzhin nyid/ gzhan ma yin pa de bzhin nyid/chos nyid/ chos kyi dbyings/ chos gnas pa nyid①/ chos nges pa nyidabu/bsam kyis mi khyab pa'i dbyings dang yang dag pa'i mtha' ste/ rab 'byor de dag ni 'dus ma byas kyi chos zhes bya'o/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das thun mong gi chos gang lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' byed pa/ rab 'byor bsam gtan bzhi dang / tshad 50—445

med pa bzhi dang / gzugs med pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa bzhi dang /mngon par shes pa lnga dag ste/ de dag ni byis pa so so'i ①skye bo rnams dang thun mong gi chos zhes bya'o/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das thun mong ma lags pa'i chos gang lags/bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu dang / mi 'jigs pa bzhi dang / so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bco brgyad kyi bar dag ste/ de dag ni thun mong ma yin pa'i chos zhes bya'o/ /de la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pas ni rtog pa med cing rnam par rtog pa med pa'i phyir rang gi mtshan nyid kyis stong pa'i chos thams cad la chags par mi bya zhing / chos thams cad ni sdeganyis su med pa'i tshul du rtogs par bya'o zhes bya ba ni sgrub pa'i dmigs pa bstan pa yin no / /①de nas tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor gyis bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po zhes bgyi ba gang brjod pa ci'i slad du/ bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po zhes bgyi/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' sprul pa/ rab 'byor 'di la sems can gyi phung po chen po dang sems can gyi sde chen po'i mchog nyid du byed par 'gyur ba de'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 50—446

zhes bya'o/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gang gi mchog nyid du byed par 'gyur ba sems can gyi phung po chen po dang / sems can gyi sde chen po de gang lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor sems can gyi phung po chen po dang / sems can kyi sde chen po zhes bya ba ni 'di lta ste/ rigs kyi sa dang / brgyad pa dang /rgyun du zhugs pa dang / lan cig phyir 'ong ba dang / phyir mi 'ong ba dang /dgra bcom pa dang / rang sangs rgyas dang / sems bskyed pa'i byang chub sems dpa' dang / phyir mi ldog pa'i sa la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i bar dag ste/ rab 'byor de ni sems can gyi phung po chen po dang / sems can gyi sde chen po zhes bya ste/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni de'i phul byed par 'gyur ro/ /de la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos rdo rje lta bu'i sems bskyed do/ /sems can gyi phung po chen po dang / sems can gyi sde chen po'i mchog tu 'gyur bar bya'o/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje lta bu'i sems bskyed pa gang lags/bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor 'di la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos 'di snyam du bdag gis 'khor ba dpag tu med pa sems can thams cad kyi don du go cha bgos nas bdog pa thams cad yongs su gtang bar byas sosde/ /bdag gis sems can thams cad la sems mnyam pa nyid bskyed par bya'o/ /bdag gis sems can thams cad theg pa gsum gyes yongs su ⑤mya ngan las bzla bar bya'o/ /bdag gis sems can thams cad yongs su mya ngan las 'das ①kyang sems can gang yang yongs su mya ngan 50—447

las 'das par 'gyur ba med de/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ bdag gis chos thams cad skye ba med par rtogs par bya ba yin no/ /bdag gis rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi sems ma 'dres pas pha rol tu phyin pa drug la spyad par bya'o//bdag gis chos thams cad rjes su rtogs pa thams cad du song ①ba la basbab par bya'o/ /bdag gis chos rnams kyi tshul gcig tu mngon par sgrub pa rtogs par bya'o/ /bdag gis pha rol tu phyin pa mngon par sgrub pa rtogs par bya ba'i don du chos rnams la bslab par bya'o/ /bdag gis byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun mngon par sgrub pa rtogs pa'i don du chos rnams la bslab par bya'o—/ /bdag gis bsam gtan dang / tshad med pa dang / gzugs med pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dang / mngon par shes pa mngon par sgrub pa rtogs par bya ba'i don du chos rnams la bslab par bya'o/ /bdag gis stobs bcu dang / mi 'jigs pa bzhi dang / so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi dang /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bco brgyad mngon par sgrub pa rtogs par bya ba'i don du chos rnams la basbab par bya'o snyam du sems bskyed de/ rab 'byor 'di ni gang la gnas nas/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams sems can gyi tshogs chen po dang / sems can byi sde chen po'i mchog nyid du mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis byed par 'gyur ba rdo rje lta bu'i sems bskyed pa yin no/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos 'di snyam du sems can dmyal ba pa dang / byol song gi skye gnas pa dang / gshin rje'i 'jig rten pa'i sems can ji snyed cig gis sdug bsngal byi tshor ba nyams su spyong bar 'gyur ba de dag gi don du sdug bsngal gye tshor ba de bdag gis nyams su 50—448

myong bar bya'o snyam du sems bskyed do/ /de la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos sems bskyed par bya ba ni/ 'di ltar ji srid du/ sems can de dag phung po lhag ma med par yongs su mya ngan las 'das kyi bar du bdag gis sems can re re'i don du yang bskal pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong mang por de dag phung po lhag ma med pa'i dbyings su mya ngan las 'das kyi bar du ①sems can dmyal ba dang / dud 'gro'i skye gnas dang / gshin rje'i 'jig rten pa'i sdug bsngal nyams su myong bar bya'o snyam zhing tshul 'di nyid kyis ④sems can thams cad phung po ma lus pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i dbyings su yongs su mya ngan las 'das kyi bar du sems can thams cad kyi don du sems can dmyal ba la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal de dag thams cad nyams su myong bar byas te/ de nas gdod bdag gi don du dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed de/ bskal pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong du mas byang chub kyi tshogs bsags nas bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar bya'o snyam du sems bskyed par bya ste/ rab 'byor 'di ni gang gis sems can gyi tshogs chen po dang / sems can gyi sde chen po'i mchog nyid du byed par 'gyur ba rdo rje lta bu'i sems bskyed pa yin no/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos sems bskyed pa gang gis sems can thams cad kyi mchog tu 'gyur bar bya ba rlabs po che'i sems su bya'o/ /de la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i sems rlabs po che ni 'di yin te/ sems dang po bskyed pa nas nye bar bzung 1nas 'dod chags kyi sems mi bskyedabu/ zhe sdang gi sems mi bskyedarjo/ gti mug gi sems mi bskyedadu/ brtse ⑦ba'i sems mi 50—449

bskyed①—/ nyan thos kyi sems dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi sems kyang mi bskyed ④pa gang yin pa ste/ rab 'byor 'di ni gang gis sems can thams cad kyi mchog nyid du byed kyang des rlom sems su mi byed pa byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i sems rlabs po che'o/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos mi sgul ba'i sems dang ldan par bya ste/ de la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i sems mi sgul ba nyid ni 'di yin te/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa yid la byed cing / des ①zlos sems su mi byed pa gang yin pa ste/ rab 'byor 'di ni gang gis sems can thams cad kyi mchog nyid du 'gyur ba byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i sems mi rjosgul ba'o/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos sems can thams cad la phan pa dang bde ba'i sems bskyed par bya'o/ /de la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i phan pa dang / bde ba'i sems ni 'di yin te/ sems can thams cad skyob cing sems can thams cad yongs su mi gtong ba gang yin pa des kyang rlom sems su 'gyur ba med pa gang yin pa ste/ rab 'byor 'di ni gang la gnas na sems can gyi tshogs chen po dang / sems can byi sde chen po'i mchog tu de mi dmigs pa'i tshul kyis byed par 'gyur ba'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i phan pa dang / bde ba'i sems so/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos ni chos la dga' ba dang / chos la kun dga' ba'i rnal 'byor la brtson par bya'o/ /de la chos gang zhe na/ chos thams cad dbyer med pa gang yin pa ste/ 'di ni chos zhes bya'o/ /de la 50—450

chos la dga' ba gang zhe na/ chos la mngon par dga' ba gang yin pa ste/'di ni chos la dga' ba zhes bya'o/ /de la chos la kun dga' ba gang zhe na/chos sgom zhing mang du byed pa gang yin pa ste/ 'di ni chos la kun dga' ba zhes bya'o/ /de la chos la dga' ba dang / kun dga' ba'i rnal 'byor la brtson pa gang zhe na/ mngon par sbyor ba ste/ 'di ni chos la dga' ba dang /chos la kun dga' ba'i rnal 'byor la brtson pa zhes bya'o/ /rab 'byor de ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ①shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pas sems can gyi phung po chen po dang / sems can gyi sde chen po'i mchog nyid du 'gyur ba sdede mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis bya'o/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pas nang stong pa nyid la gnas/ phyi stong pa nyid la gnas/ phyi nang stong pa nyid la gnas④/ dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi bar la gnas te/sems can gyi phung po chen po dang / sems can kyi sde chen po'i mchog tu 'gyur bar mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis bya'o/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pas/ byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos rnams la gnas/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu dang /mi 'jigs pa bzhi rnams dang / so so yang dag par rig pa rnams dang /byams pa chen po dang / snying rje chen po dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bco brgyad la gnas te/ sems can gyi phung po chen po dang / sems can gyi sde chen po'i mchog tu 'gyur bar mi dmigs pa'i tshul kyis bya'o/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha 50—451

rol tu phyin pa la spyod pas/ dpa' bar 'gro ba'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas/nam mkha' ltar chags pa ①med pas/ rnam par grol zhing gos pa med pa'i ting nge 'dzin gye bar la gnas te/ sems can kyi phung po chen po dang /sems can gyi sde chen po'i mchog nyid du 'gyur bar mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis bya ste④—/ rab 'byor chos ④de dag la gnas shing byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pas/ chos 'di dag la gnas te/ sems can gyi tshogs chen po dang / sems can gyi sde chen po'i mchog nyid du 'gyur bar bya ba yin no/ /des na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po zhes brjod do zhes bya ba ni/ sems can thams cad kyi mchog nyid du sems dpa'i dusems chen po nyid do/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bus/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das don gang gi be+ed du/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po zhes bgyi ba de la bdag kyang spobs so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' zad pa/ shā ri'i bu don gang gis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po zhes brjod pa la khyod spobs par byos shig /shā ri'i bus gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das bdag tu lta ba dang / sems can du lta ba dang /srog tu lta ba dang / skye ba por lta ba dang / gso bar lta ⑤ba dang / byes bur lta ba dang / gang zag dang / shed las skyes dang / shed bu dang /byed pa po dang / tshor ba po dang / shes pa po dang / mjong ba por lta ba dang / chad par lta ba dang / rtag par lta ba dang / yod par lta ba dang /50—452

med par lta ba dang / phung por lta ba dang / khams su lta ba dang / skye mched du lta ba dang / rten cing 'brel par 'byung bar ①lta ba dang / pha rol tu phyin par lta ba dang / byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos su lta ba dang / stobs dang / mi 'jigs par lta ba dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa'i bar du lta ba dang / sems can yongs su smin par bya bar ②lta ba dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su sbyong bar lta ba dang / byang chub rnam par rtog ④par lta ba dang / sangs rgyas su lta ba dang / chos su lta ba dang / dge 'dun du lta ba dang / chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar lta ba rnams te/ lta ba 'di dag thams cad rab tu spang ba'i sbad du/ sems can rnams la chos ston par bgyid kyang de mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis barmid de/ de'i sbad du/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po zhes bgyi'o/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor gyis/ tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu la 'di skad ces smras so/ /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu ci'i phyir na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rjogazugs su lta bar 'gyur ba yin/ tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed rnams dang / rnam par shes par lta bar 'gyur ba nas/ chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i bar du lta bar 'gyur ba yin/ smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor 'di la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod cing / thabs mi mkhas pas gzugs su dmigs shing /dmigs pa'i tshul gyis lta ba bskyed do/ /tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang /'du byed rnams dang / rnam par shes par dmigs shing dmigs pa'i tshul gyis lta ba bskyed dorjo/ /de bzhin du rgya cher skye mched dang / khams dang / rten 50—453

cing 'byel par 'byung bar so so ba dang / bsdus pa'i bar du dmigs shing dmigs pa'i tshul kyis lta ba bskyed do/ /de bzhin du dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams dang / yang dag par spong ba rnams dang / rdzu 'phrul kyi rkang pa rnams dang / dbang po rnams dang / stobs rnams dang / byang chub kyi yan lag rnams dang / 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa dang / pha rol tu phyin pa rnams dang / yi ge rnams dang / bsam gtan rnams dang / tshad med pa rnams dang / gzugs med pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams su dmigs shing dmigs pa'i tshul gyis lta ba bskyed do/ /rnam par thar pa dang / mthar gyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu dang / stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma med pa dang / smon pa med pa dang / mngon par shes pa dang / ting nge 'dzin dang / gzungs kyi sgo dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu dang /mi 'jigs pa bzhi ①dang / so so yang dag par rig pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres par dmigs shing dmigs pa'i tshul gyis lta ba bskyed do/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i bar du dmigs ②shing dmigs pa'i tshul gyis lta ba bskyed do—/ /tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor de'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gzugs su lta bar 'gyur ba yin/ tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang /'du byed rnams dang / rnam par shes par lta bar 'gyur ba yin/ chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i bar du lta bar 'gyur ba yin te/ de la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/thabs mkhas pas/ lta ba'i rnam pa de dag spang ba'i phyir/ mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis chos ston to zhes bya ba ni spong ba chen po nyid do/ /50—454

de nas tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor gyis bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das don gang gi be+ed du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po zhes bgyi ba de la bdag kyang spobs so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor khyod kyis spobs pa skyed ①cig /rab 'byor gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das byang chub kyi sems dang ②mi mnyam pa dang / mnyam pa'i sems nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas thams cad dang thun mong ma lags pa'i sems/ zag pa ma mchis shing khams gsum du ma gtogs pa'i sems gang lags pa de la yang rang bzhin gyis stong pa'i slad du/ chags pa ma mchis pa de'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po zhes bgyi ba'i grangs su mchi'o/ /de ci'i sbad du zhe na/ 'di ltar sems de ni sems ma lags te/ des na de la chags pa ma mchis so/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bus/ tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor la 'di skad ces smras so/ /tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i sems mi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas thams cad dang thun mong ma yin pa'i sems gang yin/ rab 'byor gyis smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu 'di la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos ni sems dang po bskyed pa nas nye bar bzung ④ste/ chos 'ga' yang skye ba'am/ 'gag par yang dag par rjes su mi mthong ngo / /'phel ba 'am/ 'grib pa 'am 'ong ba 'am/'gro ba 'amarjo/ kun nas nyon mongs pa dang / rnam par byang bar yang dag par rjes su mi mthong ste/ tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu gang la skye ba med cing 50—455

'gag pa med pa dang / 'phel ba med cing 'grib pa med pa dang / 'ong ba med cing 'gro ba med pa dang / kun nas nyon mongs pa med cing rnam par byang ba med pa de la nyan thos kyi sems med do/ /rang sangs rgyas kyi sems med do//tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ①sems mi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa ste/ nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas thams cad dang thun mong ma yin pa'i sems so/ /smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor gang khyod kyis 'di skad du/ thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi sems zag pa med pa khong du chud pa med pa'i sems de la yang chags pa med do zhes gang smras pa—/ tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor rang bzhin gyis stong pa nyid kyi phyir gzugs la ④chags pa med pa yin nam/ tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed rnams dang / rnam par shes pa la ①yang chags pa med pa yin nam/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi bar yang chags pa med pa yin nam/ smras pa/tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu de de bzhin te/ gzugs kyang chags pa med pa'o/ /tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed rnams dang / rnam par shes pa yang chags pa med pa'o/ /skye mched dang / khams dang / rten cing 'byel par 'byung ba'i bar yang chags pa med pa'o/ /bsam gtan dang / tshad med pa dang / gzugs med pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa yang chags pa med do④/ /byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos rnams kyi bar yang chags pa med pa'o/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bco brgyad kyi bar yang chags pa med pa'o/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi bar yang chags pa med pa'o/ /smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor khyod kyis 'di skad du thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi sems de yang 50—456
