zag pa med cing khong du ①chud pa med pa zhes ①gang smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor byis pa so so'i skye bo rnams kyi sems kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir zag pa med cing khongs su ma gtogs pa yin nam/ nyan thos dang /rang sangs rgyas kyi sems dang / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ṣ+pethams cad kyi sems kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir zag pa med cing khongs su ma gtogs pa yin nam/ rab 'byor gyis smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu de ni de bzhin te/ byis pa so so'i skye bo rnams kyi thugs kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir zag pa med cing khongs su chud pa med do/ /nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas rnams kyi sems kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir zag pa med cing khongs su chud pa med do/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi thugs kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir zag pa med cing khongs su chud pa med do/ /smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor de ltar yin na/ gzugs kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir zag pa med cing khongs su ma gtogs pa yin nam/tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed rnams dang / rnam par shes pa yang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir zag pa med cing khongs su ma gtogs pa yin nam—/ byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu dang / mi 'jigs pa bzhi dang / so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bco brgyad kyi bar yang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir zag pa med cing khongs su chud pa med pa yin nam/rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi bar yang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir zag pa med cing khongs su chud pa med pa yin nam/ rab 'byor gyis smras pa/ tshe 50—457

dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu ji skad smras pa de bzhin te/ gzugs kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir zag pa med cing khongs su chud pa med do/ /tshor ba dang /'du shes dang / 'du byed rnams dang / rnam par shes pa yang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir zag pa med cing khongs su chud pa med do/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams kyi bar yang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir zag pa med cing khongs su chud pa med do/ /smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor gang yang khyod kyis 'di skad du sems med pa'i phyir sems de la yang chags pa med do zhes smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor gzugs kyang gzugs med pa la chags pa med pa yin nam/ tshor ba yang tshor ba med pa la chags pa med pa yin nam/ 'du shes kyang 'du shes med pa la chags pa med pa yin nam/'du byed rnams kyang 'du byed med pa la chags pa med pa yin nam/ rnam par shes pa yang rnam par shes pa med pa la chags pa med pa yin nam/ byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos rnams kyi bar yang ①byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos rnams med pa la chags pa med pa yin nam/ sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams kyi bar yang sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams med pa la chags pa med pa yin nam/rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi bar yang rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid med pa la chags pa med pa yin nam/ smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu ji skad smras pa de ⑤de bzhin te/ tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu gzugs kyang gzugs med pa la chags pa med pa yin no④/ /tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang /'du byed rnams dang / rnam par shes pa yang rnam par shes pa rjol chags pa med do/ /de bzhin du khams dang / skye mched dang / rten cing 'byel par 50—458

'byung ba so so ba dang / bsdus pa rnams dang / bsam gtan dang / tshad med pa dang / gzugs med pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dang / rnam par shes pa yang rnam par shes pa med pa la chags pa med do/ /pha rol tu phyin pa dang /mngon par shes pa dang / byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos dang / stobs dang /mi 'jigs pa dang / so so yang dag par rig pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams kyang sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams med pa la chags pa med do/ /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa ni byang chub kyi sems mi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa'i sems nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas thams cad dang thun mong ma yin pa'i sems des kyang chos thams cad la mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis zlas sems su 'gyur ba med mngon par chags par 'gyur ba med de/ de'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po zhes bya'o zhes bya ba ni rtogs pa chen po nyid do/ /'di dag gis ni sgrub pa'i ched du bya ba bstan to / /①de nas tshe dang ldan pa byams ma'i bu gang pos bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das don gang gi slad du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po zhes bgyi ba de la bdag kyang spobs so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gang po khyod kyis spobs pa skyed cig /gang pos gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de ni go cha chen po bgos pa'i sems can lags te/ bcom ldan 'das de ni theg pa chen po la yang dag par zhugs pa'i sems can lags la/ de ni theg pa chen por yang dag par gnas pa'i sems 50—459

can lags te/ de'i slad du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po zhes bgye'oske/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bus tshe dang ldan pa byams ma'i bu gang po la 'di skad ces smras so/ /tshe dang ldan pa gang po ji tsam gyis na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos go cha chen po bgos zhes bya/ gang pos smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu 'di la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni byang chub kyi don du spyod pa na sems can nyung zad nyi tshe zhig gi don du sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la gnas shing sbyin pa yongs su gtong ba ma yin gyi/sems can thams cad kyi don du sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la gnas nas sbyin pa yongs su gtong ngo / /de bzhin du byang chub kyi don du spyod pa na sems can nyi tshe ba zhig gi don du tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang / brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la gnas shing shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa sgom pa ma yin gyi 'on kyang sems can thams cad kyi don du shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la gnas nas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa sgom ①par byed do/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni sems can 'di snyed cig ni phung po ma lus pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i dbyengs su yongs su mya ngan las bzla bar bya'o/ /sems can 'di snyed cig ni yongs su mya ngan las bzla bar mi bya'o zhe'am/ sems can 'di snyed cig ni byang chub tu dgod par bya'o/ /sems can 'di snyed cig ni byang chub tu ②dgod par mi bya'o zhes sems can yongs su bcad pas go cha mi gyon gyi/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni sems can thams cad kyi don du go cha chen po gyon 50—460

to—/ /de 'di snyam du sems te/ bdag gis kyang sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs par bya'o/ /sems can 'di dag kyang sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la sbyar bar bya'o/ /bdag gis kyang tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang /bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang / brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang /bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs par bya'o/ /sems can thams cad kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la sbyar bar bya'o/ /de bzhin du bdag gis kyang byang chub kyi chos rnams dang /bsam gtan dang / tshad med pa dang / gzugs med pa'i stoms par 'jug pa bsgom par bya/ gzhan yang de dag la dgod par bya'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu dang / mi 'jigs pa bzhi dang / so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bco brgyad la gnas par bya'o/ /sems can thams cad kyang sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bco brgyad la sbyar bar bya'o zhes bya bar sems bskyed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu de tsam gyis na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po go cha chen po bgos pa ①zhes bya ba ni bsgrub pa'i rang gi ngo bo yin no// //bam po bcu bzhi pa/ tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/sbyin pa gang yongs su gtong ba de dag rnam pa thams cad mar+ṣa pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas yongs su gtong ste/ dge ba'i rtsa ba de yang sems can thams cad dang thun mong du byas shing bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yongs su bsngo ste/ 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 50—461

shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod cing sbyin pa yongs su gtong ba'i sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i go cha'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas sbyin pa yongs su gtong zhing / nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi sa yid la byed pa spong ba 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod cing sbyin pa yongs su gtong ba'i tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i go cha'o / /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ sbyin pa gtong ba na rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas chos de dag la brjod pa dang / mos pa dang / rtog pa 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod cing / sbyin pa yongs su gtong ba'i bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i go cha'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas/ brtson 'grus mi gtong ba 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod cing sbyin pa yongs su gtong ba'i brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i go cha'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ sbyin pa yongs su gtong ba na 'di ltar rnam pa thams cad mdon pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas sems rtse gcig tu byed cing de la dmigs 50—462

pa gcig pas nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang ldan pa'i sems bskyed pa rnams kyi go mi 'byed pa 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod cing sbyin pa yongs su gtong ba'i bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i go cha'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod cing sbyin pa yongs su gtong ba'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas chos thams cad sgyu mar byas pa'i 'du shes nye bar gnas te/ sbyin pa po yang mi dmigs/ len pa po yang mi dmigs/ sbyin par bya ba yang mi dmigs pa gang yin pa 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod cing sbyin pa yongs su gtong ba'i shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i go cha'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu nam byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas pha rol tu phyin pa de dag la mtshan mar mi byed cing mi dmigs ①pa de'i tshe/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen bo shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i go cha chen po bgos par shes par bya'o zhes bya ba ni sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa drug po'i go cha ste dang po'o / /④tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod cing rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas sbyin pa gang yongs su gtong ba de dag sems can thams cad dang thun mong du byas shing bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i 50—463

byang chub tu mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis yongs su bsngo ba 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod cing / nyan thos dang /rang sangs rgyas kyi sa la yang mos pa mi bskyed ①na/ so so'i skye bo'i sa la lta smos kyang ci dgos ④pa 'di ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod cing / chos de dag la bzod pa dang / mos pa dang /rtog pa 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod cing brtson 'grus nyams par mi byed pa 'di ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod cing gnas pa'i tshe/ nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi sems kyi go mi 'byed cing dge ba'i rtsa ba de 50—464

yang sems can thams cad dang ①thun mong du byas te/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yongs su bsngo ba 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ chos thams cad sgyu mar byas pa'i 'du shes nye bar gnas shing / tshul khrims des rlom sems su mi byed de/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ tshul khrims de yang mi dmigs shing / dge ba'i rtsa ba des sems can thams cad dang thun mong du byas te/bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub —tu yongs su bsngo ba 'di ni/byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la de ltar spyod pa ni/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug bo thams cad yongs su 'dzin te/ de'i phyir go cha chen po bgos zhes bya'o zhes bya ba ni tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa drug po'i go cha ste gnyis pa'o / /④tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod cing / rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas sbyin pa gtong zhing dge ba'i rtsa ba de yang sems can thams cad dang thun mong du byas shing / bla na med pa yang dag par 50—465

rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yongs su bsngo ba 'di ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod cing / nyan thos dang /rang sangs rgyas dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas ma yin byi/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas tshul khrims yongs su bsrung zhing /dge ba'i rtsa ba de yang sems can thams cad dang thun mong du byas te/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yongs su bsngo ba 'di ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod cing /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas chos de dag la bzod pa dang nges ①pa dang / rtog pa 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas ma yin gyi/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod cing / brtson 'grus nyams par mi byed pa 'di ni/byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po nyan thos dang / rang sangs 50—466

rgyas dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas ma yin gyi/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas/ bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod cing sems rtse gcig tu byed pa 'di ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o//tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas ma yin gyi/rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod cing chos thams cad sgyu mar byas pa'i 'du shes nye bar gnas te/bzod pa des rlom sems su mi byed cing / bzod pa mi dmigs pa 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyinapa la de ltar spyod pa ni—/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug po thams cad yongs su 'dzin te/ de'i phyir go cha chen po bgos ①zhes bya'o zhes bya ba ni bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa drug pa'i go cha ste gsum pa'o / /⑤tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod cing / nyan thos dang /rang sangs rgyas dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas ma yin gyi/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas sbyin pa yongs su gtong zhing / dge ba'i rtsa ba de yang sems can thams cad dang thun mong du byas te/ bla na med 50—467

pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yongs su bsngo ba 'di ①ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod cing ②sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod cing /nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas ma yin gyi/rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas tshul khrims bsrung zhing dge ba'i rtsa ba de yang sems can thams cad ①dang thun mong du byas te/bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yongs su bsngo ba 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen bo nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas ma yin gyi/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod cing / chos de dag la de ltar bzod pa dang / mos pa dang / rtog pa 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i bzod pa'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas ma yin gyi/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod cing / sems can thams cad kyi don du brtson 'grus nyams par mi byed cing / brtun mi ngas pa 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i 50—468

brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas ma yin gyi/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas sems rtse gcig tu byed pa 'di ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe—/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa na nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas ma yin gyi/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas chos thams cad ①sgyu mar byas pa'i 'du shes nye bar gnas te/ brtson 'grus des rlom sems su mi byed cing / brtson 'grus de yang mi dmigs te/ dge ba'i rtsa ba de yang sems can thams cad dang thun mong du byas shing / bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yongs su bsngo ba 'di ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de ltar brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa ni/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug po thams cad yongs su 'dzin te/ de'i phyir go cha chen po bgos zhes bya'o ②zhes bya ba ni brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa drug po'i go cha ste bzhi pa'o / /①tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' 50—469

chen po ①bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod cing / nyan thos dang /rang sangs rgyas dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas ma yin byi/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas sbyin pa yongs su gtong zhing dge ba'i rtsa ba de yang sems can thams cad dang thun mong du byas te/ bla na med pa yang dag par sdogs pa'i byang chub tu yongs su bsngo ba 'di ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po bsam gtan gye pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod cing /nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas ma yin kyi/rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas tshul khrims bsrung zhing dge ba'i rtsa ba de yang sems can thams cad dang thun mong du byas te/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yongs su bsngo ba 'di ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po bsam gtan byi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshul khyems kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod cing / nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas ma yin gyi/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas bzod pa yongs su bsgom ste/ dge ba'i rtsa ba de yang sems can thams cad dang thun mong du byas shing / bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yongs su bsngo ba 'di ni/ byang chub secha/sa dpa' sems dpa' chen po bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /50—470

tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas ma yin gyi/rnam pa thams cad mdon pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod cing / brtson 'grus nyams par mi byed de/ de'i dge ba'i rtsa ba de yang sems can thams cad dang thun mong du byas te/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yongs su bsngo ba 'di ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod cing / rnam pa thams cad mdon pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas sems rtse gcig tu byed de/ de la dmigs pa gcig pa'i phyir nyan thos dang /rang sangs rgyas dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba rnams kyi go mi dbyed cing / dge ba'i rtsa ba de yang sems can thams cad dang thun mong du byas te/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yongs su ①bsngo ba 'di ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin ①pa'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa sgom par byed na/ nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas ①ma yin gyi/ rnam pa thams cad mdon pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la byed pas/ chos thams cad sgyu ma'i rnam pa'i 'du shes nye bar gnas te/ bsam gtan des kyang pas sems 50—471

su mi byed cing / bsam gtan de yang mi dmigs te/ dge ba'i rtsa ba de yang sems can thams cad dang thun mong du byas shing / bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yongs su bsngo ba 'di ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po bsam gtan gye pha rol tu phyin pa la de ltar spyod pa ni/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug po thams cad yongs su 'dzin te/ de'i phyir go cha chen po bgos zhes bya'o zhes bya ba ni bsam gtan gye pha rol tu phyin pa drug po'i go cha ste lnga pa'o / /①tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod cing / nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas ma yin gyi/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas 'khor gsum yongs su dag pas sbyin pa yongs su gtong zhing / dge ba'i rtsa ba de yang sems can thams cad dang thun mong du byas shing / bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yongs su bsngo ba 'di ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod cing / nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas ma yin gyi/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas tshul khrims yongs su bsrung zhing / dge ba'i rtsa ba de yang sems 50—472

can thams cad dang thun mong du byas te/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yongs su bsngo ba 'di ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod cing / nyan thos dang /rang sangs rgyas dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas ma yin gyi/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas chos de dag la de ltar bzod la ①mos shing rtog pa ④ste/ dge ba'i rtsa ba de yang sems can thams cad dang thun mong du byas shing / bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yongs su bsngo ba 'di ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod cing / nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas ma yin gyi/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas brtson 'grus nyams par mi byed cing / dge ba'i rtsa ba de yang sems can thams cad dang thun mong du byas nas/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yongs su bsngo ba 'di ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod cing / nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas ma yin gyi/ rnam 50—473

pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas sems rtse gcig tu byed cing dge ba'i rtsa ba de yang sems can thams cad dang thun mong du byas te/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yongs su bsngo ba 'di ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa sgom par byed de/ de yang nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas ①ma yin gyi/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas ①pha rol tu phyin pa thams cad dang / chos thams cad la sgyu ma dang / rmi lam dang / mig yor dang /brag ca dang / gzugs brnyan dang / sprul pa'i 'du shes nye bar gnas par 'gyur la/ dge ba'i rtsa ba de yang sems can thams cad dang thun mong du byas shing / bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yongs su bsngo ba 'di ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ste/ tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu nam byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i sems kyi ④pha rol tu phyin pa drug po 'di dag dang / sems can dang / byang chub la mtshan mar mi byed/ mi dmigs pa de ltar na/ tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa ni/ go cha chen po bgos par 'gyur ba yin no/ /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu de ltar na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po pha rol tu 50—474

phyin pa re res gnas nas pha rol tu phyin pa drug yongs su rdzogs par byed pa yin no zhes bya ba ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa drug pa'i go cha ste drug pa'o / /7tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po bsam gtan rnams la snyoms par 'jug par byed kyang bsam gtan rnams kyi ro myong bar mi byed/ de dag gis 'phrog par yang mi 'gyur ④te/de dag gi dbang gis skye ba yang ma yin/ de bzhin du tshad med pa dang /gzugs med pa'i ①snyoms par 'jug par byed kyang de dag gi ro pyong ④bar mi byed—/ de dag gis 'phrog par yang mi 'gyur/ de dag gi dbang gis skye ba yang ma yin pa 'di ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i thabs mkhas pa dang ldan pa'i shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang ldan par rig par bya'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po bsam gtan dang / tshad med pa dang / gzugs med pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dag la stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma med pa dang / smon pa med pa mthong bas gnas kyang yang dag pa'i mtha' sngon ⑤du byed pa ma yin pa 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i thabs mkhas pa'i go cha chen po ste/ tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po go cha chen po bgos pa des na sems dpa' chen po zhes brjod do/ /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de ltar go cha chen po bgos pa la phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ched du brjod pa ched du brjod cing / ming rjoyongs su sgogs par ⑦mdzad de/ 'jig rten gye khams che ge mo zhig na/ byang chub sems dpa' 50—475

sems dpa' chen po go cha chen po bgos pa 'di lta bu zhig sems can yongs su smin par byed do/ /sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag par byed do/ /rdzu 'phrul gyis rnam par rtse'o zhes sgra brjod pa mdzad cing dbyangs rjes su sgog go zhes bya ba ni drug pa'i go cha'i mjug bsdu ba'o/ /go cha'i sgrub pa bstan zin to// //shā ri'i bus smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa gang po ci tsam byus na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po theg pa chen po la yang dag par 'jug pa dang / theg pa chen po la 'dzeg par 'gyur ba yin/ gang pos smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu 'di la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sbyin pa'i nyupha rol tu phyin pa la spyod cing 'dod pas dben pa ①sdig to mi dge ba'i chos kyis ①dbe+en pa rtog pa dang bcas dpyod pa dang bcas pa/ dben pa las skyes pa'i dga' ba dang / bde ba can bsam gtan dang po la rjonye bar bsgrubs te gnas so/ /de bzhin du bsam gtan gnyis pa dang / gsum pa dang /bzhi pa la ⑤nye bar bsgrubs te gnas so/ /de bzhin du nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched dang / rnam shes mtha' yas skye mched dang / ci yang med pa'i skye mched dang / 'du shes med 'du shes med min skye mched la snyoms par 'jug pa ste/'di dag ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i bsam gtan dang gzugs med pa'o/ /gang gi tshe byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po bsam gtan dang / gzugs med pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa 'di dag gis sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa na/ nam mkha'i rnam pa dang / rtags dang /mtshan mas mnyam par 'jog cing ldang ba na dge ba'i rtsa ba de yang bla na med pa 50—476

yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yongs su sngo ①bar byed pa 'di ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /de bzhin du tshal khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang / brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa la yang brjod par bya'o/ /shā ri'i bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa ni/ bsam gtan bzhi la snyoms ②par 'jug par byed/ gzugs med pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa bzhi la yang snyoms par 'jug par byed/ gang gi tshe byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po bsam gtan 'di dag dang / gzugs med pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa 'di dag gis gnas shing / de bsam gtan dang / gzugs med pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa 'di dag la snyoms par 'jug pa dang ldan pa na/nam mkha'i rnam pa dang / rtags dang / mtshan ma yid la byed pas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod cing dge ba'i rtsa ba de dang gzhan yang rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la byed pas/ sems can thams cad dang thun mong du byas nas bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yongs su sngo bar byed pa 'di ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /shā ri'i bu de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po pha rol tu phyin pa drug la spyod pa ni/ theg pa chen po la rab tu zhugs pa yin no/ /sems can rnams kyang yongs su smin par byed do—/ /sangs rgyas kyi zhing yang yongs su dag par byed do zhes bya ba ni bsam gtan dang / gzugs med pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa la snyoms par 'jug pa 50—477

dang ldan pa'i 'jug pa yin no / /①shā ri'i bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de rnam pa thams cad mdon pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la byed pas ②sems can thams cad kyi nyon mongs pa rab tu spang ba'i phyir chos bstan par bya'o snyam pa 'di ni/byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /nam byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnam pa thams cad mdon pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba de dag gis ①bsam gtan dang / tshad med pa dang / gzugs med pa'i snyems par 'jug pa de dag la snyoms rjopar gzhog cing rnam par ldang ba ⑤yang 'di lta ste/ nyan thos sam/ rang sangs rgyas kyi sems sam/ sems bskyed pa gzhan gyi go mi 'byed pa 'di ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa mchog tu 'dzin pa med pa'o/ /nam byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnam pa thams cad mdon pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas bsam gtan dang /tshad med pa dang / gzugs med pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa de dag gis bye gnas pa na 'di snyam ste/ sems can thams cad kyi nyon mongs pa zad par bya ba'i phyir chos ston to snyam du sems shing yid la byed pa de dag la 'dod pa dang /bzod pa dang / nye bar rtog pa dang / rtogs pa dang / nges par sems par byed pa 'di ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /nam byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de rnam pa thams cad mdon pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas bsam gtan dang /50—478

tshad med pa dang / gzugs med pa'i snyems par 'jug pa de dag gis rnam par spyod pa'i tshe/ sems can thams cad kyi don dang / phan pa dang /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi phyir/ brtson 'grus mi gtong ba 'di ni/byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /nam byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas bsam gtan dang / gzugs med pa la snyems par 'jug kyang / mi dmigs pa 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /nam byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnam pa thams cad mdon pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas bsam gtan dang po'i yan lag dang / bsam gtan gnyis pa dang /gsum pa dang / bzhi pa'i yan lag rnams la mi rtag pa'i rnam pa dang /snyug bsngal ba'i rnam pa dang / bdag med pa'i rnam pa dang / zhi ba'i rnam pa dang / stong pa'i rnam pa dang / mtshan ma med pa'i rnam pa dang / smon pa med pa'i rnam par rab tu rtogs kyang / bsam gtan dang / tshad med pa dang / gzugs med pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa de dag mi dmigs shing de dag gis rlom sems su mi byed pa 'di ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ste/ tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu 'di ni/byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po pha rol tu phyin pa drug la spyod pa'i theg pa chen po'o zhes bya ba ni pha rol tu phyin pa drug gi 'jug pa yin no / /① tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu gzhan yang / byang chub sems dpa' sems 50—479

dpa' chen po'i theg pa chen po ni rnam pa thams cad du byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun sgom ①pa dang / rnam pa thams cad du rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma med pa dang / smon pa med pa sgom ②pa dang / rnam pa thams cad du de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu dang /mi 'jigs pa bzhi dang / so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams sgom par byed pa 'di ni/ tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i theg pa chen po'o zhes bya ba ni 'phags pa'i lam la 'jug pa'o / /①tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de rjobyams pa dang ldan pa'i rjosems yangs pa/ rgya chen por gyur pa/mi gnyis pa/ tshad med pa/ khon med pa/ 'gran zla med pa/ sgrib pa med pa/ gnod pa med pa/ thams cad du song ba shin tu bsgoms pas phyogs gcig gi 'jig rten chos kyi dbyings kyis klas pa/ nam mkha'i mthas gtugs pa ④thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'jig rten khyab par byas shing / nye bar bsgrubs nas gnas pa nas/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi bar du khyab par byas shing nye bar bsgrubs nas gnas so/ /de snying rje dang ldan pa dang /dga' ba dang ldan pa dang / btang snyoms dang ldan pa'i sems yangs pa/rgya chen por gyur pa/ mi gnyis pa/ tshad med pa/ khon med pa/ 'gran zla med pa/ sgrib pa med pa/ gnod pa med pa/ thams cad du song ba shin tu bsgoms pas phyogs gcig gi 'jig rten chos kyi dbyings kyis klas pa/ nam 50—480

mkha'i mthas gtugs pa thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'jig rten khyab par byas shing /nye bar bsgrubs nas gnas pa nas/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi bar du khyab par byas shing nye bar bsgrubs nas gnas so/ /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu gzhan yang ①byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po byams pa'i ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par 'jog cing bdag gis sems can thams cad yongs su bskyab par bya'o zhes de la gzhol bar byed/ snying rje'i ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par 'jog cing / sems can rnams la snying rje ba dang / snying brtse ba la gzhol bar byed/dga' ba'i ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par 'jog cing / bdag nyid kyis ①sems can dga' bar bya'o zhes sems can rnams la gzhol bar byed/ btang snyoms kyi ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par 'jog cing / sems can rnams zag pa zad pa la rab tu gzhol bar byed de/ 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po tshad med pa rnams la spyod pa'i sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /nam byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po bsam gtan dang / tshad med pa rnams kyi rnam pa dang / rtags dang mtshan ma la mnyam par gzhog cing /rnam par ldang ①yang rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du bsngo ba ma gtogs par nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi sar yongs su mi bsngo ba 'di ni/byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po tshad med pa rnams la spyod pa'i tshul khyems kyi pha rol tu phyin pa mchog tu 'dzin pa med pa'o/ /nam byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po bsam gtan dang / tshad med pa dang /gzugs med pa'i stoms par 'jug pa de dag gis ma du'adres par rnam par spyod cing / sa gnyis po nyan thos kyi sa'am/ rang sangs rgyas kyi sar 'dod 50—481

pa mi bskyed ①kyi/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du bzod pa dang / 'dod pa 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po tshad med pa rnams la spyod pa'i bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /nam byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i sems bskyed pas mi dge ba'i chos rnams rab tu spang ba dang / dge ba'i chos phun sum tshogs par bya ba'i don du brtson 'grus mi gtong bas rnam par spyod pa 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po tshad med pa rnams la spyod pa'i brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /nam byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po bsam gtan dang / tshad med pa dang / gzugs med pa'i snyems par 'jug pa de dag la yang mnyam par 'jog la/ bsam gtan dang / tshad med pa dang / gzugs med pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa'i dbang gis kyang ②mi skye zhing / de dag gi ro myong bar byed pa yang med la/ de dag gis 'phrogs par yang mi 'gyur ba 'di ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po tshad med pa rnams la spyod pa'i bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /nam byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas bsam gtan dang / tshad med pa dang / gzugs med pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa de dag la yang mnyam par 'jog cing / rnam par ldang ba lanu/ de dag la mi rtag pa'i rnam pa dang / sdug bsngal ba'i rnam pa dang / bdag med pa'i rnam pa dang / zhi ba'i rnam pa dang / stong pa'i rnam pa dang / mtshan ma med pa'i rnam pa dang / smon pa med pa'i rnam par rab tu rtog kyang nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi skyon med par 'jug par 50—482

mi byed pa 'di ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i tshad med pa rnams la spyod pa'i shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ste/ tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i theg pa chen po'o zhes bya ba ni tshad med pa la 'jug pa'o / /①tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i be+eg pa chen po ni/ gang ②nang stong pa nyid shes kyang dmigs pa'i tshul gyis ma yin/ phyi stong pa nyid shes kyang dmigs pa'i tshul gyis ma yin pa dang / phyi nang stong pa nyid dang / dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi bar du shes kyang dmigs pa'i tshul gyis ma yin pa gang yin pa ste/ tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i theg pa chen po'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i theg pa chen po ni/ chos thams cad la sems rnam par g.yeng ba med par mnyam par gzhag ①pa'i shes pa gang yin pa ste/ tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i theg pa chen po'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i theg pa chen po ni rtag ces bya bar shes pa mi 'jug /mi rtag pa dang /bde ba dang / sdug bsngal ba dang / bdag dang / bdag med pa dang /zhi ba dang / ma zhi ba zhes bya ba dang / stong pa dang / mi stong pa dang /mtshan ma yod pa dang / mtshan ma med pa dang / smon pa yod pa dang /sgon pa med ces bya bar shes pa mi 'jug pa ste/ tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu 50—483

'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i theg pa chen po'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen ngo 'i theg pa chen po ni gang 'das pa'i dus la shes pa mi 'jug /ma 'ongs pa dang /da ltar gyi dus la shes pa 'jug par mi byed de/ de gsum po 'di gsum 'a mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyes shes pa mi 'jug pa 'di ni/ tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i theg pa chen po'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i jes pa chen po ni 'dod pa'i khams su shes parngu'ajug par mi byed/ gzugs ngang gzugs med pa'i khams su shes pa 'jug par mi byed de/ 'dod pa dang /gzugs dang / gzugs med pa'i khams la de mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis shes pa 'jug pa gang yin pa 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i theg pa chen po'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dang 'a sems dpa' chen po'i zeg pa chen po ni 'jig rten pa dang / 'jig rten 'a/sa 'das pa'i chos dang / zag pa dang bcas pa dang / zag pa med pa dang /'dus byas dang / 'dus ma byas kyi chos la shes pa 'jug par mi byedange/de 'jig rten pa dang / 'jig rten las 'das pa'i chos mi shes pa yang meng/zag pa dang bcas pa dang / zag pa med pa dang / 'dus byas dang /'dus ma byas kyi chos rnams la de mi dmigs pa'i tshul kyis shes pa mi 'jugang/ 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i theg pa chen po'o zhesabyab ni mi dmigs pa la sbyor ba'i 'jug pa'o / /④50—484

shā ri'i bus smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa gang po ci tsam gyis na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po theg pa chen po la zhugs pa zhes bya/gang pos smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu 'di la byang chub sems dpa' se mas dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la 'dzeg kyang / des sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa mi dmigs bye / sbyin pa po dang / len pa po dang / sbyin pa rnams mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis dmigs su med pa de lta na tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu byang chub sems dang/'a sems dpa' chen po theg pa chen po la 'dzeg pa zhes bya'o/ /de bzhin du shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang / brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin nga dang / bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa la 'dzeg kyang de mi dmigs pa dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la 'dzeg kyang des shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa mi dmigs①/ byang jub sems dpa' midamigs②/ yid la byed pa mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis dmigs su med pa de ltar na tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu/ byang chub sems dpa' se ma/sa dpa' chen po theg pa chen po la 'dzeg pa zhes bya'o zhes bya ba ni 'khor sasu/ma yongs su dag pa la 'jug pa'o / /①tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' tshenapo rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba ma 'dres pa sa sgom pa rnam par gzhig pa'i don du/ byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa 50—485

bdun mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis sgom par byed de/ shā ri'i bu de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po theg pa chen po la 'dzeg pa zhes bya'o/ /shā ri'i bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la byed pa ma 'dres pas sgom pa rnam par gzhig pa'i don du stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma med pa dang / smon pa med pa'i ting nge 'dzin rnams de mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis sgom par byed de/ shā ri'i bu de ltar na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po theg pa chen po la 'dzeg pa zhes bya'o/ /shā ri'i bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba ma 'dres pas sgom pa rnam par gzhig pa'i don du de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu dang / mi 'jigs pa bzhi dang / so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi dang /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bco brgyad rnams de mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis sgom par byed de/ shā ri'i bu de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po theg pa chen po la 'dzeg pa zhes bya'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos byang chub sems dpa' dmigs su med pa'i phyir 'di ni tha snyad tsam ste/ 'di lta ste①/ byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya'o zhes bya ba de ltar shes so/ /gzugs ④dmigs su med pa'i phyir 'di ni tha snyad tsam ste/ 'di lta ste/ gzugs zhes bya bar shes so/ /tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed rnams dang / rnam par shes pa dmigs su med pa'i phyir 'di ni tha snyad tsam ste/ 'di lta ste/ rnam par shes pa zhes bya'o zhes bya bar de ltar shes so/ /skye mched dang / khams dang /50—486

rten cing 'byel par 'byung ba dmigs su med pa'i phyir/ 'di ni tha snyad tsam ste—/ 'di lta ste/ rten cing 'byel par 'byung ba zhes bya bar shes so/ /sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dmigs su med pa'i phyir 'di ni tha snyad tsam ste/'di lta ste/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa zhes bya bar de ltar shes so/ /tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang /brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ①dmigs su med pa'i phyir 'di ni tha snyad tsam ste/ 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zhes bya bar shes so//byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos rnams dmigs su med pa'i phyir 'di ni tha snyad tsam ste/'di lta ste/ byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos rnams zhes bya bar shes so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams dang / mi 'jigs pa bzhi dang / so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams dmigs su med pa'i phyir 'di ni tha snyad tsam ste/ 'di lta ste/ sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bco brgyad ces bya bar shes so/ /nang stong pa nyid dmigs su med pa'i phyir 'di ni tha snyad tsam ste/ 'di lta ste/ nang stong pa nyid ces bya bar shes so/ /phyi stong pa nyid dmigs su med pa'i phyir 'di ni tha snyad tsam ste/'di lta ste/ phyi stong pa nyid ces bya bar shes so/ /phyi nang stong pa nyid dmigs su med pa'i phyir 'di ni tha snyad tsam ste/ 'di lta ste/ phyi nang stong pa nyid ces bya bar shes so/ /dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi bar du dmigs su med pa'i phyir 'di ni tha snyad tsam ste/ 'di lta ste/ dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid ces bya bar shes so/ /de bzhin nyid dmigs 50—487

su med pa'i phyir 'di ni tha snyad tsam ste/ 'di lta ste/ de bzhin nyid ces bya bar shes so/ /ma nor ba de bzhin nyid dang / gzhan ma yin pa de bzhin nyid dang / chos nyid dang / chos kyi dbyings dang / chos kyi gnas nyid dang / chos nges pa nyid dang / yang dag pa'i mtha' dmigs su med pa'i phyir 'di ni tha snyad tsam ste/ 'di lta ste/ yang dag pa'i mtha' zhes bya bar shes so//byang chub dmigs su med pa'i phyir 'di ni tha snyad tsam ste/ 'di lta ste/ byang chub ces bya bar shes so/ /sangs rgyas dmigs su med pa'i phyir/ 'di no tha snyad tsam ste—/ 'di lta ste/ sangs rgyas zhes bya bar yang dag par shes te/ tshe dang ldan pa khye shā ri'i bu de ltar na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po theg pa chen po la 'dzeg pa zhes bya'o zhes bya ba ni ched du bya ba la 'jug pa'o / /④tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sems dang po bskyed pa nas ①nye bar bzung ste/ snying po byang chub la 'dug gi bar du mngon par shes pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i phyir na sems can yongs su smin par byed do/ /sangs rgyas kyi zhing dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing du sangs rgyas gang la mchod pa dang bkur ste gang bya bar ④'os pa'i mchod pas/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la bkur ster byed/ bla mar byed/ ri mor byed/ mchod par byed do/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag las kyang chos nyan te/ 'di lta ste/ theg pa chen po 'di nyid do//de byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa de la 'dzegs skyenas/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing du 'gro zhing / sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag par 50—488

byed—/ sems can rnams yongs su smin par byed kyang / de la sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi 'du shes kyang mi 'byung / sems can gyi 'du shes kyang mi 'byung /sangs rgyas kyi 'du shes kyang mi 'byung ngo / /de gnyis su med pa'i sa la gnas shing / lus ji lta bus sems can rnams kyi don bya ba'i mthu yod pa de lta bu'i lus ched du bsam zhing ①yongs su 'dzin to/ /de rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi ye shes thob par ma gyur gyi bar du theg pa chen po de dang nam yang mi 'bral lo zhes bya ba ni mngon par shes pa la 'jug pa'o / /④/des rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi ye shes thob nas kyang / nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas thams cad dang / lha dang / klu dang /gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang /mi 'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po dang / mi dang / mi ma yin pa dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten gyis bskor bar mi nus pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor ro//de bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas nas/ shar phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag na/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das bzhugs pa rnams yon tan brjod pa mdzad cing / 'jig rten gyi khams che ge mo zhig tu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po che ge mo zhes bya ba zhig theg pa chen po bla na med pa'i theg pa theg pa'i ①mchog la 'dzegs nas rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid thob bo/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid thob nas kyang chos kyi 'khor lo skor ④bar byed do zhes grags pa sgog ducing dbyangs su brjod pa mdzad do/ /de bzhin du lho 50—489

dang / nub dang / byang dang / byang shar dang / shar lho dang / lho nub dang /nub byang dang / 'og dang / steng gi phyogs kyi phyogs re re zhing / 'jig rten gyi khams gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag na/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das bzhugs pa rnams yon tan brjod pa mdzad cing / 'jig rten gyi khams che ge mo zhig tu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po che ge mo zhes bya ba zhig /theg pa chen po bla na med pa'i theg pa theg pa'i mchog la 'dzegs nas rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid thob bo/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid thob nas kyang chos kyi 'khor lo skor ①bar byed do zhes grags pa sgrog cing dbyangs su brjod pa mdzad do/ /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po theg pa chen po la yang dag par 'dzeg ④pa zhes bya'o zhes bya ba ni rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid la 'jug pa'o / /④'di dag gis ni 'jug pa'i sgrub pa bstan to// //de nas tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor gyis/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das go cha chen po bgos pa/ go cha chen po bgos pa zhes brjod pa/ bcom ldan 'das ji tsam gyis na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos go cha chen po bgos zhes bgyi ba lags/ de skad ces gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /rab 'byor 'di la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos theg pa chen po'i go cha 'di lta ste/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i go cha dang / tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i go cha dang / bzod pa'i pha 50—490

rol tu phyin pa'i go cha dang / brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i go cha dang /bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i go cha dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i go cha bgos/ nang stong pa nyid kyi go cha bgos/ phyi stong pa nyid kyi go cha bgos—/ phyi nang stong pa nyid kyi go cha bgos/ dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi bar gyi go cha bgos/ dran pa nye bar gzhag pa'i go cha bgos/yang dag par spong ba dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa dang / dbang po dang /stobs dang / byang chub kyi yan lag dang / lam gyi go cha bgos/ bsam gtan dang / tshad med pa dang / gzugs med pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa'i go cha bgos/ mngon par shes pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs dang /mi 'jigs pa dang / so so yang dag par rig pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bco brgyad kyi go cha bgos/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi ⑨go cha bgos/ sangs rgyas kyi sku'i go cha bgos nas/ stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di snang bas rgyas par bkang ste/ shar phyogs kyi ② 'jig rten gyi khams gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed snang bas rgyas par 'gengs so/ /lho phyogs dang / nub phyogs dang / byang phyogs dang / byang shar dang /shar lho dang / lho nub dang / nub byang dang / 'og dang / steng gi phyogs kyi phyogs re re zhing 'jig rten byu khams gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed snang bas rgyas par 'gengs so/ /stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gye khams 'di rnam par 'gyur ba drug tu rab tu bskyod do/ /shar phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed rnam par 'gyur ba drug tu rab tu bskyod do/ /lho phyogs dang / nub phyogs dang / byang phyogs dang / byang shar dang /50—491

shar lho dang / lho nub dang / nub byang dang / 'og dang steng gi phyogs kyi phyogs re re zhing 'jig rten gyi khams gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed rnam par 'gyur ba drug tu stirab tu bskyod do/ /des stong gsum kyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di na sems can dmyal ba'i me'i phung po ji snyed cig ④yod pa de dag thams cad zhi bar byas shing sems can dmyal ba pa rnams kyi sdug bsngal rab tu bcil nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo zhes bya ba'i sgra brjod do/ /dbyangs sgog go/ /de'i tshe sems can dmyal ba pa'i ①sems can de dag kyang sangs rgyas kyi sgra de thos nas/ dga' ba dang / bde ba thob ste/ de dag dga' ba dang bde ba des sems can dmyal ba de dag nas rnam par ldang ngo / /de dag sems can dmyal ba de dag nas rnam par langs nas/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing gang dang gang nas4—/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams bzhugs shing 'tsho skyong ba dang / de dang de dag tu skyes te⑤/ lha dang mi'i skye ba yongs su 'dzin to/ /de bzhin du byol song gi skye gnas pa'i sems can rnams dang / gshin rje'i 'jig rten pa'i sems can de dag nas rnam par ldang ngo / /de dag byol song gi skye gnas dang / 'jig rten de dag nas rnam par langs nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing gang dang gang na dusangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams bzhugs shing 'tsho skyong ba de dang de dag tu skye ste/ lha dang mi'i skye ba yongs su 'dzin to/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ sgyu ma'i mkhan po'am/ sgyu ma'i mkhan po'i mchan bu mkhas pa zhig ⑦lam po che'i bzhi mdor 'dug ste/ skye bo mang po'i tshogs kyi mdun du sems can dmyal ba ④dang / byol song gi skye gnas dang /50—492

gshin rje'i 'jig rten dag cig mngon par sprul la/ de ltar mngon par sprul nas ngan song gi sems can de dag la sangs rgyas kyi sgra dang / chos kyi sgra dang /dge 'dun gyi sgra sgogs par gyur te/ de nas sprul pa de dag sangs rgyas kyi sgra dang / chos kyi sgra dang / dge 'dun gyi sgra des sems can dmyal ba dang /byel song gi skye gnas ② dang / gshin rje'i 'jig rten de dang de dag las rnam par langs par gyur na/ rab 'byor de la ji snyam du sems/ sgyu ma'i mkhan po dang / sgyu ma'i mkhan po'i mchan bu de tsa sems can gang yang / sems can dmyal ba dang / byol song gi skye gnas dang / gshin rje'i 'jig rten de dag nas rnam par blang ⑦ba yod dam/ gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de ni ma mchis so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de bzhin du—/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams tshad med grangs med pa'i sems can rnams ngan song gsum las yongs su bkrol ④yang sems can gang yang yongs su grol bar byas pa med do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor sgyu ma'i chos nyid nye bar bzung na chos rnams kyi chos nyid kyis ⑤de bzhin pa'i phyir te/ rab 'byor de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po go cha chen po bgos zhes bya'o zhes bya ba ni snying rje'i tshogs so / / pyarab 'byor gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po go cha chen po bgos pa ni/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la gnas shing stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams bai ḍūr+ya'i rgyu las byung ba mngon par sprul par byed do/ /de ltar bai ḍūr+ya'i rgyu las byung ba mngon par sprul nas/ 'khor los 50—493

sgyur ba'i bkod pa mngon par sprul par byed do/ /de ltar 'khor los sgyur ba'i bkod pa mngon par sprul nas/ zas 'dod pa rnams la zas kyi sbyin pa byed do//skom 'dod pa rnams la skom/ bzhon pa 'dod pa rnams la bzhon pa/ gos 'dod pa rnams la tugos/ me tog 'dod pa rnams la me tog /phreng ba 'dod pa rnams la phreng ba/ spos 'dod pa rnams la spos/ byug pa 'dod pa rnams la byug pa/ mal cha 'dod pa rnams la mal cha/ khyem 'dod pa rnams la khyem/ 'tsho ba 'dod pa rnams la 'tsho ba/ yo byad 'dod pa rnams la yo byad—/ nad kyi rkyen rtsi dang yo byad 'dod pa rnams la nad kyi rkyen ④rtsi dang yo byad kyi sbyin pa byed do/ /nor bu dang / mu tig dang / be+e ḍūr+ya dang / dung dang /① man shel dang / byi buru dang / gser dang dngul 'dod pa rnams la nor bu dang / mu tig dang / bai ḍūr+ya dang / dung dang / man shel dang / bye ⑤ru dang / gser dang dngul gyi sbyin pa byed cing / mi'i yo byad gang ci yang rung ba'i bar du sbyin par byed ④/ des de ltar zas 'dod pa rnams la zas byin/ mi'i yo byad gang ci yang rung ba'i bar du sbyin ⑦nas/sems can de dag la chos ston pa ni 'di lta ste/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug dang ldan pa'i chos bstan pa 'di nyid ston to/ /sems can de dag gis kyang chos bstan pa de thos nas bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sangs ma rgyas kyi bar du pha rol tu phyin pa drug dang nam yang 'bral bar mi 'gyur ro/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ sgyu ma'i mkhan po 'am/ sgyu ma'i mkhan po'i mchan bu mkhas pa zhig gis lam po che'i bzhi mdor 'dug ste/ skye bo mang po'i tshogs kyi mdun du/ skye bo mang po'i tshogs shig mngon par sprul te/ zas 50—494

'dod pa rnams la zas sbyin/ mi'i yo byad gang ci yang rung ba'i bar du byen na/rab 'byor de la ①ji snyam du sems/ ci sgyu ma'i mkhan po'am/ sgyu ma'i mkhan po'i mchan bu mkhas pa des/ sems can gang la yang ci yang sbyin ②pa yod dam/ gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de ni ma mchis so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de bzhin du/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos ①'khor los sgyur ba'i bkod pa mngon par sprul te/ zas 'dod pa rnams la zas byin/ mi'i yo byad gang ci yang rung ba'i bar du byin yang /sems can gang la rjoci yang byin pa med do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor de ni sgyu ma'i chos nyid nye bar bzung na/ chos rnams kyi chos nyid kyis de bzhin pa'i phyir te/ rab 'byor de lta bu'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni go cha chen po bgos pa zhes bya'o zhes bya ba ni sbyin pa'i tshogs so / /durab 'byor gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la gnas shing ched du bsams te skye ba yongs su bzung bas 'khor los sgyur ba'i rigs su skye zhing de tshu'akhor los sgyur ba'i dbang phyug de la gnas nas/ sems can rnams dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam la rab tu dgod do/ /bsam gtan bzhi dang / tshad med pa bzhi dang / gzugs mred pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa bzhi dang / byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos rnams dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu'i bar dang / mi 'jigs pa bzhi dang / so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ⑦ma 'dres pa bco brgyad la sems can rnams ⑧rab tu 'god de/ sems can de dag 50—495

kyang bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas par ma gyur gyi bar du/ chos bstan pa de dang nam yang 'bral bar mi 'gyur ro/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ sgyu ma'i mkhan po'am/ sgyu ma'i mkhan po'i mchan bu mkhas pa zhig gis/ lam po che'i bzhi mdor 'dug ste/skye bo mang po'i tshogs kyi mdun du skye bo mang po'i tshogs shig mngon par sprul te/sems can de dag dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam la bkod dam/ sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bco brgyad kyi bar la bkod na/ rab 'byor de la ①ji snyam du sems—/ sgyu ma'i mkhan po'am/ sgyu ma'i mkhan po'i mchan bu mkhas pa des sems can gang yang dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam la bkod pa yod dam/ sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bco brgyad kyi bar la bkod pa yod dam/ gsol pa/bcom ldan 'das de ni ma mchis so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/rab 'byor de bzhin du/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos sems can tshad med grangs med pa/ dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam la rab tu bkod de/sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bco brgyad kyi bar la bkod kyang / sems can gang yang de dag la bkod pa med do/ /rab 'byor de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de sgyu ma'i chos nyid nye bar bzung na/ chos rnams kyi chos nyid kyis de bzhin pa'i phyir te/ rab 'byor de lta bu'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni go cha chen po bgos zhes bya'o zhes bya ba ni tshul khrims kyi tshogs so// //bam po bco lnga pa/ rab 'byor gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la gnas shing cha/ sems can 50—496

thams cad bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la sbyor zhing 'jog la rab tu 'god do/ /rab 'byor ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la gnas shing / sems can thams cad bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la sbyor zhing 'jog la rab tu 'god pa yin zhe na/ rab 'byor 'di la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sems dang po bskyed pa nas nye bar bzung ste/ 'di ltar go cha gyon te/ brgya la sems can thams cad bdag la rdo dang dbyig pa dang / khu tshur gyis rdeg cing mtshon gyis 'debs kyang de la bdag gis 'khrug pa'i sems 'ga' tsam yang bskyed par mi bya zhing sems can thams cad kyang bzod pa de dang ①'dra ba la rab tu dgod par bya'o snyam mo/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ sgyu ma'i mkhan po'am/ sgyu ma'i mkhan po'i mchan bu mkhas pa zhig gis lam po che'i bzhi mdor 'dug ste/ skye bo mang po'i tshogs kyi mdun du/ skye bo mang po'i tshogs shig mngon par sprul te/ bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la sbyar zhing gzhog la rab tu 'god pa byas na/ rab 'byor de ji snyam du sems/ sgyu ma'i mkhan po'am/ sgyu ma'i mkhan po'i mchan bu mkhas pa ⑤des sems can gang yang bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la bkod pa yod dam/ gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de ni ma mchis so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos sems can tshad med grangs med pa de snyed dag bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la bkod kyang / sems can 1yang bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la bkod pa med do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor de ni sgyu ma'i chos nyid nye bar bzung narjo/ chos rnams kyi chos nyid kyis de bzhin pa'i 50—497

phyir dang ①/ rab 'byor de lta bu'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni go cha chen po bgos pa zhes bya'o zhes bya ba ni bzod pa'i tshogs so / /①rab 'byor gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la gnas shing / sems can thams cad brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la yang dag par sbyor zhing gzhog la rab tu 'god do//rab 'byor ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la gnas shing / sems can thams cad brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la yang dag par sbyor ba dang / gzhog la rab tu 'god pa yin zhe na/ rab 'byor 'di la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i sems bskyed pas/ sems can thams cad lus dang sems kyi brtson 'grus la yang dag par sbyor zhing gzhog la rab tu 'god do/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ sgyu ma'i mkhan po'am/ sgyu ma'i mkhan po'i mchan bu mkhas pa zhig gis lam po che'i bzhi mdor 'dug ste/skye bo mang po'i tshogs kyi mdun du skye bo mang po'i tshogs shig mngon par sprul te/lus dang sems kyi brtson 'grus la bkod na/ rab 'byor de la ji snyam du sems—/ sgyu ma'i mkhan po'am/ sgyu ma'i mkhan po'i mchan bu mkhas pa ①des sems can gang yang lus dang sems kyi brtson 'grus la bkod pa yod dam/gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de ni ma bumachis so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos sems can tshad med grangs med pa de snyed pa de dag lus dang sems kyi 50—498

brtson 'grus la bkod kyang / sems can gang yang thukyelus dang sems kyi brtson 'grus la bkod pa med do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor de ni sgyu ma'i chos nyid nye bar bzung na/ chos rnams kyi chos nyid kyis de bzhin pa'i phyir te/ rab 'byor de lta bu'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni go cha chen po bgos pa zhes bya'o zhes bya ba ni brtson 'grus kyi tshogs so / /①rab 'byor gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa la gnas shing sems can thams cad bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa la yang dag par sbyor zhing gzhog la rab tu 'god do/ /rab 'byor ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa la gnas te/ sems can thams cad bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa la yang dag par ①sbyor zhing gzhog la/ rab tu 'god pa yin zhe na/rab 'byor 'di la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos thams cad kyi chos nyid mnyam pa nyid la gnas shing / chos gang la yang rnam par g.yeng ba'am rnam par mi g.yeng bar yang dag par rjes su mi mthong na/ bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa la gnas pa yin te/ de de bzhin du sems can thams cad kyang bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa la yang dag par sbyor zhing gzhog pa dang rab tu 'god pa byed de/ de ltar yang dag par spyor ba rnams kyang nam bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas par ma gyur gyi bar du nam yang bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang 'bral bar mi 'gyur ro/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ sgyu ma'i 50—499

mkhan po'am/ sgyu ma'i mkhan po'i mchan bu mkhas pa zhig gis lam po che'i bzhi mdor 'dug ste/ skye bo mang po'i tshogs kyi mdun du skye bo mang po'i tshogs shig mngon par sprul te/ bsam gtan gye pha rol tu phyin pa la bkod na/rab 'byor de ji snyam du sems/ sgyu ma'i mkhan po'am/ sgyu ma'i mkhan po'i mchan bu mkhas pa des sems can gang yang bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa la bkod pa yod dam/ gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de ni ma mchis so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos sems can thams cad bsam gtan gye pha rol tu phyin pa la bkod kyang sems can gang yang bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa la bkod pa med do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor de ni sgyu ma'i chos nyid nye bar bzung na/ chos rnams kyi chos nyid kyis de bzhin pa'i phyir te/ rab 'byor de lta bu'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni go cha chen po bgos pa zhes bya ba ni bsam gtan gyi tshogs so / /①rab 'byor gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la gnas shing sems can thams cad shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la yang dag par sbyor zhing gzhog la rab tu 'god do/ /rab 'byor ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la gnas shing / stems can thams cad shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la yang dag par sbyor ba dang / gzhog la ④rab tu 'god pa yin zhe na/rab 'byor 'di la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha 50—500

rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ chos gang yang tshu rol tam/ pha rol du mi dmigs te/ rab 'byor de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la gnas pa yin te/ de /de bzhin du sems can thams cad kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la yang dag par spyor zhing gzhog la rab tu 'god do/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ sgyu ma'i mkhan po'amaske/ sgyu ma'i mkhan po'i mchan bu mkhas pa zhig gis lam po che'i bzhi mdor 'dug ste/ skye bo mang po'i tshogs kyi mdun du/ skye bo mang po'i tshogs shig mngon par sprul te/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la yang dag par sbyar te gzhog ⑦la rab tu bkod na/ rab 'byor de la duji snyam du sems/ sgyu ma'i mkhan po'am/ sgyu ma'i mkhan po'i mchan bu mkhas pa des sems can gang yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la bkod pa yod dam/ gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de ni ma mchis so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' sprul pa/ rab 'byor de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos sems can thams cad shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la bkod kyang sems can gang yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la bkod pa med do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor de ni sgyu ma'i chos nyid nye bar bzung na/ chos rnams kyi chos nyid kyis de bzhin pa'i phyir te/ rab 'byor de lta bu'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni go cha chen po bgos pa zhes bya'o zhes bya ba ni shes rab kyi tshogs so / /④ rab 'byor gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po go cha chen po bgos shing / shar phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gang gā'i klung gi bye ma 50—501

snyed dag tu song zhing ji ltar bdag sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la gnas pa de bzhin du 'jig rten gyi khams de dag na sems can ji snyed 'khod dhipa de dag thams cad kyang sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la sbyor zhing gzhog la rab tu 'god do/ /ji ltar bdag tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang / brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / bsam gtan kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la gnas pa de bzhin du 'jig rten gyi khams de dag na/ sems can ji snyed cig 'khod pa de dag thams cad kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la yang dag par sbyor zhing gzhog la rab tu 'god do/ /chos kyang ston te/ 'di lta ste/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug dang ldan pa 'di nyid do/ /sems can de dag kyang chos de thos nas bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par sangs ma rgyas kyi bar du pha rol tu phyin pa drug dang nam yang 'bral bar mi 'gyur ro/ /lho dang / nub dang / byang dang / byang shar dang / shar lho dang / lho nub dang / nub byang dang / 'og dang / steng gi phyogs kyi phyogs re re zhing 'jig rten gyi khams gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag tu song zhing / ji ltar bdag sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la gnas pa dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i bar la gnas pa de bzhin du 'jig rten gyi khams de dag na sems can gang ji snyed cig yod pa de dag thams cad kyang sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la yang dag par sbyor zhing gzhog la rab tu 'god do/ /de bzhin du tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang / brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang /50—502

shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la yang dag par sbyor zhing gzhog la rab tu 'god dorka/ /'di lta ste/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug po 'di nyid kyi chos kyang ston to/ /sems can de dag kyang chos de thos nas/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par ⑨sangs ma rgyas kyi bar du/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug dang nam yang 'bral bar mi 'gyur ro/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ sgyu ma'i mkhan po'am/ sgyu ma'i mkhan po'i mchan bu mkhas pa zhig gis lam po che'i bzhi mdor 'dug ste/ skye bo mang po'i tshogs kyi mdun du/② skye bo mang po'i tshogs shig mngon par sprul te/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug la yang dag par sbyor zhing gzhog ④la rab tu bkod par gyur na/ rab 'byor de la ji snyam du sems—/ sgyu ma'i mkhan po'am/ sgyu ma'i mkhan po'i mchan bu mkhas pa des sems can gang yang pha rol tu phyin pa drug la yang dag par sbyor zhing gzhog ④la rab tu bkod pa yod dam/ gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de ni ma mchis so//bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos shar phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dang / lho dang / nub dang / byang dang / byang shar dang /shar lho dang / lho nub dang / nub byang dang / 'og dang / steng gi phyogs kyi phyogs re re zhing 'jig rten gyi khams gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyi sems can gang ji snyed cig yod pa de dag thams cad pha rol tu phyin pa drug la bkod kyang sems can gang yang pha rol tu phyin pa drug la bkod pa med do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor sgyu ma'i chos nyid nye bar bzung na/ chos rnams kyi chos nyid kyis de bzhin pa'i phyir te/ rab 'byor de ltar na byang chub 50—503

sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po go cha chen po bgos pa zhes bya'o/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po go cha chen po bgos pa ni/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i sems kyis gnas shing sems bskyed pa gzhan gyi go mi 'byed de/ bdag gis sems can 'di snyed cig ni sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la dgod par bya'o/ /'di snyed cig ni dgod par mi bya'o/ /bdag gis sems can 'di snyed byug ni tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang /brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la dgod par bya'o/ /'di snyed cig ni dgod par mi bya'o/ /bdag gis sems can 'di snyed cig ni byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun la dgod par bya'o/ /'di snyed cig ni dgod par mi bya'o/ /bdag gis sems can 'di snyed cig ni sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bco brgyad kyi bar la dgod par bya'o/ /'di snyed cig ni dgod par mi bya'o/ /bdag gis sems can 'di snyed cig ni rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu la dgod par bya'o/ /'di snyed cig ni dgod par mi bya'o/ /bdag gis sems can 'di snyed cig ni lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu dang / phyir mi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu dang / dgra bcom pa nyid la dgod par bya'o/ /'di snyed cig ni dgod par mi bya'o/ /bdag gis sems can 'di snyed cig ni rang byang chub la dgod par bya'o/ /'di snyed cig ni dgod par mi bya'o/ /bdag gis sems can 'di snyed cig ni rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid la dgod par bya'o//'di snyed zucig ni dgod par mi bya'o zhes bya bar sems bskyed pa'i go mi 'byed 50—504

kyi—/ de 'di snyam du sems te/ bdag gis sems can tshad med grangs med pa sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la dgod par bya'o/ /bdag gis sems can tshad med grangs med pa tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang / brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / bsam gtan kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la dgod par bya'o/ /byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun la dgod par bya'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu dang / mi 'jigs pa bzhi dang / so so yang dag par rig dang / mi 'jigs pa bzhi dang / so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bco brgyad la dgod par bya'o/ /rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu la dgod par bya'o/ /lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu dang / phyir mi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu dang / dgra bcom pa nyid la dgod par bya'o/ /rang byang chub la dgod par bya'o/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid la dgod par bya'o zhes bya bar sems bskyed do zhes bya ba ni zhi gnas kyi tshogs so / /①rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ sgyu ma'i mkhan po'am/ sgyu ma'i mkhan po'i mchan bu mkhas pa zhig gis lam po che'i khyebazhi mdor 'dug ste/skye bo mang po'i tshogs kyi mdun du/ skye bo mang po'i tshogs shig mngon par sprul te—/ 'di snyam du bdag gis sems can tshad med grangs med pa 'di dag pha rol tu phyin pa drug la dgod par bya'o/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi bar la dgod par bya'o snyam du sems bskyed par gyur na/ rab 'byor de la ji 50—505

snyam du sems/ sgyu ma'i mkhan po'am/ sgyu ma'i mkhan po'i mchan bu mkhas pa des/ sems can gang ①yang pha rol tu phyin pa drug la dgod par byas pa yod dam/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi bar la dgod par byas pa yod dam / gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de ni ma mchis so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos sems can tshad med grangs med pa pha rol tu phyin pa drug dang / rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi bar la dgod par sems bskyed kyang / sems can gang gi don du yang sems bskyed pa med do②/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor sgyu ma'i chos nyid nye bar bzung na/ chos rnams kyi chos nyid kyis de bzhin pa'i phyir te/ rab 'byor de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po go cha chen po bgos zhes bya'o/ /rab 'byor gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das bdag gis bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa'i don 'tshal te/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos ni/ rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid kyi slad du go cha ma mchis pa'i go cha bgos par rig par bgyi'o / /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ bcom ldan 'das de ni 'di ltar gzugs gzugs kyis stong ngo / /tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed rnams dang / rnam par shes pa rnam par shes pas stong ngo / /mig mig gis stong ngo //de bzhin du rna ba dang / sna dang / lce dang / lus dang / yid yid kyis stong ngo / /gzugs gzugs kyis stong ngo / /sgra dang / dri dang / ro dang /reg dang / chos chos kyis stong ngo / /mig gi rnam par shes pa mig gi rnam par shes pas stong ngo / /rna ba'i rnam par shes pa dang / sna'i rnam par shes 50—506

pa dang / lce'i rnam par shes pa dang tsho / lus kyi rnam par shes pa dang /yid kyi rnam par shes pa yid kyi rnam par shes pas stong ngo / /mig gi 'dus te reg pa mig gi 'dus te reg pas stong ngo / /rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa dang /sna'i 'dus te reg dang / lce'i 'dus te reg pa dang / lus kyi 'dus te reg pa dang / yid kyi 'dus te reg pa yid kyi 'dus te reg pas stong ngo / /mig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen gyis tshor ba mig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen gyis tshor bas stong ngo / /rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen gyis tshor ba dang / sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen gyis ②tshor ba dang / lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen gyis tshor ba dang / lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen gyis tshor ba dang / yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen gyis tshor bas stong ngo / /sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pas stong ngo / /tshul khrims kyi rol tu phyin pa dang / bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang /brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pas stong ngo / /nang stong pa nyid nang stong pa nyid kyis stong ngo / /phyi stong pa nyid phyi stong pa nyid kyis stong ngo / /phyi nang stong pa nyid phyi nang stong pa nyid kyis stong ngo / /dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi bar du dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyis stong ngo / /byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun gyis stong ngo / /de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu dang / mi 'jigs pa bzhi dang / so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bco brgyad rnams sangs rgyas kyi 50—507
